````text
    try {
      if (db && customer) {
        await db.order.deleteMany({ where: { userId: { in: [customer, otherCustomer] } } });
        await db.cart.deleteMany({ where: { userId: { in: [customer, otherCustomer] } } });
        await db.product.deleteMany({ where: { id: { in: productIds } } });
        await db.topping.deleteMany({ where: { id: toppingId } });
        await db.user.deleteMany({ where: { id: { in: [customer, otherCustomer, staffId] } } });
      }
    } finally {
      await app?.close();
      if (previousSecret === undefined) delete process.env.JWT_SECRET;
      else process.env.JWT_SECRET = previousSecret;
      if (previousOrigin === undefined) delete process.env.FRONTEND_ORIGIN;
      else process.env.FRONTEND_ORIGIN = previousOrigin;
    }
  });

  async function expectUnchanged() {
    expect(await db.order.count({ where: { userId: customer } })).toBe(0);
    const stock = await db.product.findMany({ where: { id: { in: productIds } }, orderBy: { id: 'asc' } });
    expect(stock.map(({ stock, version }) => ({ stock, version }))).toEqual([{ stock: 6, version: 1 }, { stock: 6, version: 1 }]);
  }

  it('registers through real Auth, persists PENDING/items/history and keeps cart/payment/points unchanged', async () => {
    const cart = await db.cart.upsert({ where: { userId: customer }, create: { userId: customer }, update: {} });
    await db.cartItem.create({ data: {
      cartId: cart.id, ...line(), note: '', configKey: 'task06-cart',
    } });
    const response = await post({ items: [line()] }).expect(201);
    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({ userId: customer, status: 'PENDING', subtotal: 90000, discount: 0, total: 90000 });
    expect(response.body.id).toMatch(/^[a-f0-9-]{36}$/);
    const stored = await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: response.body.id }, include: { items: { include: { toppings: true } }, statusHistory: true } });
    expect(stored).toMatchObject({ userId: customer, status: 'PENDING', inventoryHeld: true, subtotal: 90000, total: 90000 });
    expect(stored.items).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(stored.items[0]).toMatchObject({ productId: productIds[0], size: 'L', qty: 2, basePrice: 30000, sizePrice: 9000, unitPrice: 45000, lineTotal: 90000, note: 'Ít ngọt giúp mình' });
    expect(stored.items[0].toppings[0]).toMatchObject({ toppingId, name: 'Task 06 topping', extraPrice: 6000 });
    expect(stored.statusHistory).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(stored.statusHistory[0]).toMatchObject({ fromStatus: null, toStatus: 'PENDING', version: 1 });
    expect(await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productIds[0] } })).toMatchObject({ stock: 4, version: 2 });
    expect(await db.cartItem.count({ where: { cartId: cart.id } })).toBe(1);
    expect(await db.payment.count({ where: { orderId: stored.id } })).toBe(0);
    expect((await db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: customer } })).loyaltyPoints).toBe(0);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/orders/${stored.id}`).set('Cookie', otherCookie).expect(404);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/orders/me').set('Cookie', cookie).expect(200)
      .expect(({ body }) => expect(body.map((order: { id: string }) => order.id)).toEqual([stored.id]));
  });

  it('accepts uppercase UUIDs and persists canonical product/topping identifiers', async () => {
    const response = await post({ items: [{ ...line(), productId: productIds[0].toUpperCase(), toppingIds: [toppingId.toUpperCase()] }] }).expect(201);
    expect(response.body.items[0]).toMatchObject({ productId: productIds[0], toppingIds: [toppingId], unitPrice: 45000 });
  });

  it.each([
    {}, { items: [] },
    { items: [{ quantity: 2 }] },
    ...[0, -1, 1.5, '2'].map((quantity) => ({ items: [{ ...line(), quantity }] })),
  ])('rejects malformed cart %# without database side effects', async (body) => {
    await post(body).expect(400);
    await expectUnchanged();
  });

  it.each(['userId', 'total', 'status', 'discount'])('rejects client-controlled %s before any database mutation', async (key) => {
    await post({ items: [line()], [key]: key === 'status' ? 'PAID' : 1 }).expect(400);
    await expectUnchanged();
  });

  it('rejects unauthenticated, wrong-role and foreign-origin creation', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/api/orders').send({ items: [line()] }).expect(401);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/api/orders').set('Cookie', staffCookie).set('Origin', origin).send({ items: [line()] }).expect(403);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/api/orders').set('Cookie', cookie).set('Origin', 'https://foreign.example').send({ items: [line()] }).expect(403);
    await expectUnchanged();
  });

  it.each(['product', 'size', 'topping', 'duplicate topping', 'ice', 'sugar'])('rejects invalid %s configuration without reserving stock', async (scenario) => {
    const item = line();
    if (scenario === 'product') item.productId = randomUUID();
    if (scenario === 'size') await db.productSize.updateMany({ where: { productId: productIds[0], code: 'L' }, data: { available: false } });
    if (scenario === 'topping') item.toppingIds = [randomUUID()];
    if (scenario === 'duplicate topping') item.toppingIds = [toppingId, toppingId.toUpperCase()];
    if (scenario === 'ice') item.ice = 'unsupported ice';
    if (scenario === 'sugar') item.sugar = 'unsupported sugar';
    await post({ items: [item] }).expect(400);
    await expectUnchanged();
  });

  it('rolls back an earlier reservation when a later product is out of stock', async () => {
    await db.product.update({ where: { id: productIds[1] }, data: { stock: 0 } });
    await post({ items: [line(), { ...line(), productId: productIds[1] }] }).expect(409);
    expect(await db.order.count({ where: { userId: customer } })).toBe(0);
    expect(await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productIds[0] } })).toMatchObject({ stock: 6, version: 1 });
    expect(await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productIds[1] } })).toMatchObject({ stock: 0, version: 1 });
  });

  it('aggregates quantities across configurations of the same product', async () => {
    await post({ items: [{ ...line(), quantity: 3 }, { ...line(), size: 'M', quantity: 4 }] }).expect(409);
    await expectUnchanged();
  });

  it('uses the current discount provider while persisting a PENDING order', async () => {
    const response = await post({ items: [line()], promotionCode: 'WELCOME10' }).expect(201);
    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({ status: 'PENDING', subtotal: 90000, discount: 10000, total: 80000 });
    expect(await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: response.body.id } })).toMatchObject({ discountAmount: 10000, total: 80000 });
  });

  it('lets BARISTA cancel a PREPARING order with a persisted reason over HTTP', async () => {
    const created = await post({ items: [line()] }).expect(201);
    await db.$transaction((tx) => orders.transitionInTransaction(tx, created.body.id, 'PAID'));
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .patch(`/api/staff/orders/${created.body.id}/status`)
      .set('Cookie', staffCookie).set('Origin', origin)
      .send({ status: 'PREPARING' }).expect(200);
    const cancelled = await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .patch(`/api/staff/orders/${created.body.id}/cancel`)
      .set('Cookie', staffCookie).set('Origin', origin)
      .send({ reason: ' Máy pha hỏng ' }).expect(200);
    expect(cancelled.body).toMatchObject({ status: 'CANCELLED', cancelReason: 'Máy pha hỏng' });
    expect(await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: created.body.id } }))
      .toMatchObject({ status: 'CANCELLED', inventoryHeld: false, cancelReason: 'Máy pha hỏng' });
    expect(await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productIds[0] } }))
      .toMatchObject({ stock: 6 });
  });
});
````

````text
import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Get,
  Param,
  ParseUUIDPipe,
  Post,
  Req,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/jwt-auth.guard';
import { Roles } from '../auth/roles.decorator';
import { RolesGuard } from '../auth/roles.guard';
import { CreateOrderDto } from './dto/create-order.dto';
import { OrdersService } from './orders.service';

@Controller('orders')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(Role.CUSTOMER)
export class OrdersController {
  constructor(private readonly orders: OrdersService) {}

  @Post()
  create(
    @Req() req: { user: { userId: string } },
    @Body() dto: CreateOrderDto,
  ) {
    return this.orders.create(req.user.userId, dto);
  }

  @Get('me')
  mine(@Req() req: { user: { userId: string } }) {
    return this.orders.mine(req.user.userId);
  }

  @Get(':id/status')
  async status(
    @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string,
    @Req() req: { user: { userId: string } },
  ) {
    return { status: (await this.orders.get(id, req.user.userId)).status };
  }

  @Get(':id')
  get(
    @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string,
    @Req() req: { user: { userId: string } },
  ) {
    return this.orders.get(id, req.user.userId);
  }
}

````

````text
import { jest } from '@jest/globals';
import { INestApplication, ValidationPipe } from '@nestjs/common';

import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import { Role, UserStatus } from '@prisma/client';

import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';

describe('Orders HTTP (real guards, DTOs and service; database test double)', () => {
  let app: INestApplication;
  let jwt: JwtService;
  const customer = '10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
  const staff = '10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';
  const productId = '2a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
  const toppingId = '2b000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
  const orderId = '30000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
  const findFirst = jest.fn(async (_args: unknown): Promise<any> => null);
  const updateMany = jest.fn(async (_args: unknown) => ({ count: 1 }));
  const create = jest.fn(async ({ data }: { data: any }) => ({
    id: orderId,
    user: { fullName: 'Customer test' },
    ...data,
    createdAt: new Date('2026-10-15T00:00:00Z'),
    items: data.items.create.map((i: any) => ({
      ...i,
      id: 'item',
      toppings: i.toppings.create,
    })),
  }));
  const findMany = jest.fn(async (_args: unknown) => []);
  const db = {
    user: {
      findUnique: async ({ where }: { where: { id: string } }) =>
        [customer, staff].includes(where.id)
          ? {
              id: where.id,
              status: UserStatus.ACTIVE,
              role: where.id === staff ? Role.BARISTA : Role.CUSTOMER,
              sessionVersion: 0,
            }
          : null,
    },
    product: {
      findMany: async () => [
        {
          id: productId,
          name: 'Coffee',
          imageUrl: '/coffee.svg',
          price: 29000,
          stock: 5,
          version: 1,
          sizes: [{ code: 'M', extraPrice: 5000, available: true }],
          toppings: [{ toppingId, extraPrice: 6000, available: true, topping: { name: 'Kem sữa' } }],
        },
      ],
      updateMany,
    },
    order: { create, findFirst, findMany, findUnique: findFirst },
    $connect: async () => {},
    $disconnect: async () => {},
    $transaction: async (
      work: (tx: unknown) => Promise<unknown>,
    ): Promise<unknown> => work(db),
  };
  const payload = {
    items: [
      {
        productId,
        size: 'M',
        toppingIds: [],
        quantity: 2,
        ice: '70% đá',
        sugar: '50% ít ngọt',
      },
    ],
  };
  const cookie = (id = customer) =>
    `brewlite_session=${jwt.sign({ sub: id, sessionVersion: 0 })}`;
  const post = (body: object) =>
    request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/orders')
      .set('Cookie', cookie())
      .set('Origin', 'http://localhost:3000')
      .send(body);

  beforeAll(async () => {
    process.env.JWT_SECRET = 'orders-http-test-secret';
    process.env.FRONTEND_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';
    const module = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] })
      .overrideProvider(PrismaService)
      .useValue(db)
      .compile();
    app = module.createNestApplication({ logger: false });
    app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
    app.use(cookieOriginGuard);
    app.useGlobalPipes(
      new ValidationPipe({
        whitelist: true,
        forbidNonWhitelisted: true,
        transform: true,
      }),
    );
    jwt = module.get(JwtService);
    await app.init();
  });
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    updateMany.mockResolvedValue({ count: 1 });
    findFirst.mockResolvedValue(null);
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await app?.close();
  });

  it('POST returns a server-priced PENDING order using the authenticated owner', async () => {
    const response = await post(payload).expect(201);
    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({
      id: orderId,
      userId: customer,
      status: 'PENDING',
      subtotal: 68000,
      total: 68000,
      discount: 0,
    });
    expect(response.body.items[0]).toMatchObject({
      quantity: 2,
      unitPrice: 34000,
      toppingIds: [],
    });
    expect(updateMany).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('normalizes uppercase product and topping UUIDs before catalog lookup', async () => {
    const response = await post({
      items: [{ ...payload.items[0], productId: productId.toUpperCase(), toppingIds: [toppingId.toUpperCase()] }],
    }).expect(201);
    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({ status: 'PENDING', userId: customer, total: 80000 });
    expect(response.body.items[0]).toMatchObject({ productId, toppingIds: [toppingId], unitPrice: 40000 });
  });

  it.each([
    {},
    { items: [] },
    { items: null },
    { items: [null] },
    { ...payload, userId: staff },
    { ...payload, total: 1 },
    { ...payload, status: 'PAID' },
    { ...payload, discount: 99999 },
    { items: Array.from({ length: 101 }, () => payload.items[0]) },
    ...[0, -1, 1.5, '2', 100].map((quantity) => ({
      items: [{ ...payload.items[0], quantity }],
    })),
    ...[
      { unitPrice: 1 },
      { productId: 'invalid' },
      { size: 'XL' },
      { toppingIds: ['bad'] },
      { note: 'x'.repeat(121) },
      { toppingIds: [productId, productId] },
      { toppingIds: [toppingId, toppingId.toUpperCase()] },
      { toppingIds: 'not-an-array' },
      { ice: '' },
      { ice: 'unsupported ice' },
      { sugar: 'unsupported sugar' },
      { sugar: null },
      { lineTotal: 1 },
    ].map((override) => ({ items: [{ ...payload.items[0], ...override }] })),
  ])('rejects malformed/tampered cart %# before mutation', async (body) => {
    await post(body).expect(400);
    expect(create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(updateMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('returns 409 on stale inventory and does not create an order', async () => {
    updateMany.mockResolvedValue({ count: 0 });
    await post(payload).expect(409);
    expect(create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('enforces authentication, role and cookie Origin for writes', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/orders')
      .send(payload)
      .expect(401);
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/orders')
      .set('Cookie', cookie(staff))
      .set('Origin', 'http://localhost:3000')
      .send(payload)
      .expect(403);
    for (const origin of ['', 'https://foreign.example']) {
      await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .post('/api/orders')
        .set('Cookie', cookie())
        .set('Origin', origin)
        .send(payload)
        .expect(403);
    }
    expect(create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('protects reads and scopes detail/status queries to the current owner', async () => {
    for (const path of [
      '/orders/me',
      `/orders/${orderId}`,
      `/orders/${orderId}/status`,
      '/staff/orders',
      `/staff/orders/${orderId}`,
    ]) {
      await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api${path}`).expect(401);
    }
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/orders/me')
      .set('Cookie', cookie())
      .expect(200, []);
    expect(findMany).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ where: { userId: customer } }),
    );
    for (const suffix of ['', '/status']) {
      await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .get(`/api/orders/${orderId}${suffix}`)
        .set('Cookie', cookie())
        .expect(404);
      expect(findFirst).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({ where: { id: orderId, userId: customer } }),
      );
    }
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/orders/not-a-uuid')
      .set('Cookie', cookie())
      .expect(400);
  });

  it('restricts staff endpoints and never exposes payment transitions to Barista', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/staff/orders')
      .set('Cookie', cookie())
      .expect(403);
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/staff/orders')
      .set('Cookie', cookie(staff))
      .expect(200, []);
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .patch(`/api/staff/orders/${orderId}/status`)
      .set('Cookie', cookie())
      .set('Origin', 'http://localhost:3000')
      .send({ status: 'CANCELLED' })
      .expect(403);
    for (const status of [
      'PAID',
      'PENDING',
      'PAYMENT_FAILED',
      'UNKNOWN',
      'CANCELLED',
    ]) {
      await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .patch(`/api/staff/orders/${orderId}/status`)
        .set('Cookie', cookie(staff))
        .set('Origin', 'http://localhost:3000')
        .send({ status })
        .expect(400);
    }
  });

  it('returns a JSON object for status so the browser can parse it', async () => {
    findFirst.mockResolvedValue({
      id: orderId,
      userId: customer,
      user: { fullName: 'Customer test' },
      status: 'PENDING',
      subtotal: 68000,
      discountAmount: 0,
      total: 68000,
      createdAt: new Date(),
      items: [],
    });
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get(`/api/orders/${orderId}/status`)
      .set('Cookie', cookie())
      .expect('Content-Type', /json/)
      .expect(200, { status: 'PENDING' });
  });

  it.each([
    {},
    { reason: null },
    { reason: 123 },
    { reason: ['x'] },
    { reason: '' },
    { reason: ' \n\t ' },
    { reason: 'x'.repeat(301) },
    { reason: 'Hết nguyên liệu', status: 'CANCELLED' },
  ])(
    'rejects invalid cancellation payload %# before accessing an order',
    async (body) => {
      await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .patch(`/api/staff/orders/${orderId}/cancel`)
        .set('Cookie', cookie(staff))
        .set('Origin', 'http://localhost:3000')
        .send(body)
        .expect(400);
      expect(findFirst).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(updateMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    },
  );

  it('protects staff detail and cancellation with role, session and Origin', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get(`/api/staff/orders/${orderId}`)
      .set('Cookie', cookie())
      .expect(403);
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get(`/api/staff/orders/${orderId}`)
      .set('Cookie', cookie(staff))
      .expect(404);
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/staff/orders/not-a-uuid')
      .set('Cookie', cookie(staff))
      .expect(400);
    const cancel = () =>
      request(app.getHttpServer()).patch(`/api/staff/orders/${orderId}/cancel`);
    await cancel().send({ reason: 'Hết nguyên liệu' }).expect(401);
    await cancel()
      .set('Cookie', cookie())
      .set('Origin', 'http://localhost:3000')
      .send({ reason: 'Hết nguyên liệu' })
      .expect(403);
    for (const origin of ['', 'https://foreign.example']) {
      await cancel()
        .set('Cookie', cookie(staff))
        .set('Origin', origin)
        .send({ reason: 'Hết nguyên liệu' })
        .expect(403);
    }
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .patch('/api/staff/orders/not-a-uuid/cancel')
      .set('Cookie', cookie(staff))
      .set('Origin', 'http://localhost:3000')
      .send({ reason: 'Hết nguyên liệu' })
      .expect(400);
  });
});
````

````text
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { ConflictException, ValidationPipe } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import request from 'supertest';
import { AppModule } from '../app.module';
import { cookieOriginGuard } from '../auth/csrf.middleware';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import { InventoryService } from '../inventory/inventory.service';
import { OrdersService } from './orders.service';
import { PromotionDiscount } from './order-discount';
import type { CreateOrderDto } from './dto/create-order.dto';

// Opt in with a migrated, dedicated test database. Never fall back to DATABASE_URL.
const databaseUrl = process.env.ORDERS_TEST_DATABASE_URL;
const describeDatabase = databaseUrl ? describe : describe.skip;

describeDatabase('Orders PostgreSQL transactions and concurrency', () => {
  let db: PrismaService;
  let service: OrdersService;
  const userId = randomUUID();
  const productIds = [randomUUID(), randomUUID()].sort();
  const toppingId = randomUUID();
  const dto = (ids = [productIds[0]]): CreateOrderDto => ({
    items: ids.map((productId) => ({
      productId,
      size: 'M',
      toppingIds: [toppingId],
      quantity: 1,
      ice: '70% đá',
      sugar: '50% ít ngọt',
    })),
  });

  beforeAll(async () => {
    db = new PrismaService({ datasources: { db: { url: databaseUrl! } } });
    service = new OrdersService(
      db,
      new InventoryService(),
      new PromotionDiscount(),
    );
    await db.$connect();
    await db.user.create({
      data: {
        id: userId,
        email: `${userId}@orders.test`,
        fullName: 'Orders test',
        passwordHash: 'not-a-login',
      },
    });
    await db.topping.create({ data: { id: toppingId, name: 'Test topping' } });
    for (const id of productIds) {
      await db.product.create({
        data: {
          id,
          name: 'Orders test',
          price: 29000,
          imageUrl: '/test.svg',
          stock: 1,
          sizes: { create: { code: 'M', name: 'Medium', extraPrice: 5000 } },
          toppings: { create: { toppingId, extraPrice: 6000 } },
        },
      });
    }
  });
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await db.order.deleteMany({ where: { userId } });
    await db.product.updateMany({
      where: { id: { in: productIds } },
      data: { stock: 1, version: 1, price: 29000 },
    });
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    if (!db) return;
    // Only fixtures belonging to this run; no truncate/reset or deletion of seed data.
    await db.order.deleteMany({ where: { userId } });
    await db.product.deleteMany({ where: { id: { in: productIds } } });
    await db.topping.deleteMany({ where: { id: toppingId } });
    await db.user.deleteMany({ where: { id: userId } });
    await db.$disconnect();
  });

  it('allows exactly one of eight concurrent last-unit orders', async () => {
    const results = await Promise.allSettled(
      Array.from({ length: 8 }, () => service.create(userId, dto())),
    );
    expect(results.filter((r) => r.status === 'fulfilled')).toHaveLength(1);
    for (const result of results)
      if (result.status === 'rejected')
        expect(result.reason).toBeInstanceOf(ConflictException);
    expect(await db.order.count({ where: { userId } })).toBe(1);
    expect(
      (await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productIds[0] } }))
        .stock,
    ).toBe(0);
  });

  it('rolls back an earlier product decrement if a later product has no stock', async () => {
    await db.product.update({
      where: { id: productIds[1] },
      data: { stock: 0 },
    });
    await expect(service.create(userId, dto(productIds))).rejects.toThrow(
      ConflictException,
    );
    expect(await db.order.count({ where: { userId } })).toBe(0);
    expect(
      await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productIds[0] } }),
    ).toMatchObject({ stock: 1, version: 1 });
  });

  it('rolls back inventory if order persistence fails', async () => {
    await expect(service.create(randomUUID(), dto())).rejects.toThrow();
    expect(
      await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productIds[0] } }),
    ).toMatchObject({ stock: 1, version: 1 });
  });

  it('releases once under concurrent cancellation and writes only one transition', async () => {
    const order = await service.create(userId, dto());
    const results = await Promise.allSettled([
      service.staffCancel(order.id, 'Hết nguyên liệu'),
      service.staffCancel(order.id, 'Khách yêu cầu'),
    ]);
    expect(results.filter((r) => r.status === 'fulfilled')).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(
      (await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productIds[0] } }))
        .stock,
    ).toBe(1);
    expect(
      await db.orderStatusHistory.count({ where: { orderId: order.id } }),
    ).toBe(2);
  });

  it('keeps failed state if retry cannot reserve, then supports retry and the full lifecycle', async () => {
    const order = await service.create(userId, dto());
    await db.$transaction((tx) =>
      service.transitionInTransaction(tx, order.id, 'PAYMENT_FAILED'),
    );
    const competing = await service.create(userId, dto());
    await expect(
      db.$transaction((tx) =>
        service.transitionInTransaction(tx, order.id, 'PENDING'),
      ),
    ).rejects.toThrow(ConflictException);
    expect(
      await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: order.id } }),
    ).toMatchObject({
      status: 'PAYMENT_FAILED',
      inventoryHeld: false,
      version: 2,
    });
    await service.staffCancel(competing.id, 'Khách yêu cầu');
    await db.$transaction((tx) =>
      service.transitionInTransaction(tx, order.id, 'PENDING'),
    );
    await db.$transaction((tx) =>
      service.transitionInTransaction(tx, order.id, 'PAID'),
    );
    for (const status of ['PREPARING', 'READY', 'COMPLETED'] as const)
      await service.staffTransition(order.id, status);
    expect((await service.get(order.id, userId)).status).toBe('COMPLETED');
    expect(
      (await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productIds[0] } }))
        .stock,
    ).toBe(0);
    expect(
      await db.orderStatusHistory.count({ where: { orderId: order.id } }),
    ).toBe(7);
  });

  it('rolls back state, history and restored stock if the payment transaction fails', async () => {
    const order = await service.create(userId, dto());
    await expect(
      db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        await service.transitionInTransaction(tx, order.id, 'PAYMENT_FAILED');
        throw new Error('payment write failed');
      }),
    ).rejects.toThrow('payment write failed');
    expect(
      await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: order.id } }),
    ).toMatchObject({ status: 'PENDING', inventoryHeld: true, version: 1 });
    expect(
      (await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productIds[0] } }))
        .stock,
    ).toBe(0);
    expect(
      await db.orderStatusHistory.count({ where: { orderId: order.id } }),
    ).toBe(1);
  });

  it('cancels PREPARING once and restores reserved stock', async () => {
    const order = await service.create(userId, dto());
    await db.$transaction((tx) => service.transitionInTransaction(tx, order.id, 'PAID'));
    await service.staffTransition(order.id, 'PREPARING');
    const cancelled = await service.staffCancel(order.id, ' Máy pha hỏng ');
    expect(cancelled).toMatchObject({ status: 'CANCELLED', cancelReason: 'Máy pha hỏng' });
    expect(await service.get(order.id, userId)).toMatchObject({ cancelReason: 'Máy pha hỏng' });
    expect(await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productIds[0] } }))
      .toMatchObject({ stock: 1 });
    expect(await db.orderStatusHistory.count({ where: { orderId: order.id } })).toBe(4);
  });

  it('retains original line names and prices after catalog edits', async () => {
    const order = await service.create(userId, dto());
    await db.product.update({
      where: { id: productIds[0] },
      data: { name: 'Changed name', price: 99000 },
    });
    const stored = await service.get(order.id, userId);
    expect(stored.total).toBe(40000);
    expect(stored.items[0]).toMatchObject({
      name: 'Orders test',
      unitPrice: 40000,
      toppingNames: ['Test topping'],
    });
  });

  it('POST /orders persists a 45000 VND L+topping order and initial statusHistory using real PostgreSQL', async () => {
    await db.product.update({
      where: { id: productIds[0] },
      data: {
        price: 30000,
        sizes: { create: { code: 'L', name: 'Large', extraPrice: 9000 } },
      },
    });
    process.env.JWT_SECRET = 'orders-postgres-http-test-only';
    process.env.FRONTEND_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';
    const module = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] })
      .overrideProvider(PrismaService)
      .useValue(db)
      .compile();
    const app = module.createNestApplication({ logger: false });
    app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
    app.use(cookieOriginGuard);
    app.useGlobalPipes(
      new ValidationPipe({
        whitelist: true,
        forbidNonWhitelisted: true,
        transform: true,
      }),
    );
    await app.init();
    try {
      const cookie = `brewlite_session=${module.get(JwtService).sign({ sub: userId })}`;
      const payload = dto();
      payload.items[0].size = 'L';
      const response = await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .post('/api/orders')
        .set('Cookie', cookie)
        .set('Origin', 'http://localhost:3000')
        .send(payload)
        .expect(201);
      expect(response.body).toMatchObject({
        userId,
        status: 'PENDING',
        subtotal: 45000,
        total: 45000,
      });
      const persisted = await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { id: response.body.id },
        include: { statusHistory: true },
      });
      expect(persisted.statusHistory).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(persisted.statusHistory[0]).toMatchObject({
        fromStatus: null,
        toStatus: 'PENDING',
        version: 1,
      });
      expect(
        (await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productIds[0] } }))
          .stock,
      ).toBe(0);
      await request(app.getHttpServer())
        .get(`/api/orders/${response.body.id}/status`)
        .set('Cookie', cookie)
        .expect(200, { status: 'PENDING' });
    } finally {
      await app.close();
    }
  });
});
````

````text
import { jest } from '@jest/globals';
import {
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { OrderStatus, Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import { InventoryService } from '../inventory/inventory.service';
import { OrdersService } from './orders.service';
import { PromotionDiscount } from './order-discount';
import type { CreateOrderDto } from './dto/create-order.dto';

describe('Orders service', () => {
  const productId = '10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
  const toppingId = '20000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
  const product = () => ({
    id: productId,
    name: 'Bạc xỉu',
    imageUrl: '/coffee.svg',
    price: 29000,
    stock: 5,
    version: 1,
    sizes: [{ code: 'M', extraPrice: 5000, available: true }],
    toppings: [
      {
        toppingId,
        available: true,
        extraPrice: 6000,
        topping: { name: 'Kem sữa' },
      },
    ],
  });
  let products: ReturnType<typeof product>[];
  let dto: CreateOrderDto;
  const stockUpdate = jest.fn(async (_args: unknown) => ({ count: 1 }));
  const createOrder = jest.fn(async ({ data }: { data: any }) => ({
    id: 'order',
    user: { fullName: 'Orders test' },
    ...data,
    createdAt: new Date('2026-10-15T00:00:00Z'),
    items: data.items.create.map((i: any, index: number) => ({
      ...i,
      id: `item-${index}`,
      toppings: i.toppings.create,
    })),
  }));
  const findOrder = jest.fn<(...args: any[]) => Promise<any>>();
  const updateOrder = jest.fn(async (_args: unknown) => ({ count: 1 }));
  const history = jest.fn(async (_args: unknown) => ({}));
  const restore = jest.fn(async (_args: unknown) => ({}));
  const tx = {
    product: {
      findMany: jest.fn(async () => products),
      updateMany: stockUpdate,
      update: restore,
    },
    order: {
      create: createOrder,
      findUnique: findOrder,
      findUniqueOrThrow: findOrder,
      updateMany: updateOrder,
      findFirst: findOrder,
    },
    orderStatusHistory: { create: history },
  };
  let service: OrdersService;
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    products = [product()];
    stockUpdate.mockResolvedValue({ count: 1 });
    updateOrder.mockResolvedValue({ count: 1 });
    dto = {
      items: [
        {
          productId,
          size: 'M',
          toppingIds: [toppingId],
          quantity: 2,
          ice: '70% đá',
          sugar: '50% ít ngọt',
          note: ' Ít nóng ',
        },
      ],
    };
    const prisma = {
      ...tx,
      $transaction: async (work: (db: unknown) => Promise<unknown>) => work(tx),
    } as unknown as PrismaService;
    service = new OrdersService(
      prisma,
      new InventoryService(),
      new PromotionDiscount(),
    );
  });

  it('calculates DB prices, creates PENDING, snapshots options and reserves stock', async () => {
    const result = await service.create('customer', dto);
    expect(result).toMatchObject({
      status: 'PENDING',
      subtotal: 80000,
      discount: 0,
      total: 80000,
    });
    expect(result.items[0]).toMatchObject({
      name: 'Bạc xỉu',
      unitPrice: 40000,
      quantity: 2,
      lineTotal: 80000,
      toppingNames: ['Kem sữa'],
      note: 'Ít nóng',
    });
    expect(stockUpdate).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      where: { id: productId, version: 1, stock: { gte: 2 } },
      data: { stock: { decrement: 2 }, version: { increment: 1 } },
    });
    expect(createOrder.mock.calls[0][0].data.statusHistory.create).toEqual({
      toStatus: 'PENDING',
      version: 1,
    });
  });

  it.each([
    'empty',
    'missing product',
    'size',
    'unavailable size',
    'topping',
    'unavailable topping',
    'duplicate topping',
    'quantity',
  ])('rejects %s', async (scenario) => {
    if (scenario === 'empty') dto.items = [];
    if (scenario === 'missing product') products = [];
    if (scenario === 'size') dto.items[0].size = 'L';
    if (scenario === 'unavailable size') products[0].sizes[0].available = false;
    if (scenario === 'topping') dto.items[0].toppingIds = ['missing'];
    if (scenario === 'unavailable topping')
      products[0].toppings[0].available = false;
    if (scenario === 'duplicate topping')
      dto.items[0].toppingIds.push(toppingId);
    if (scenario === 'quantity') dto.items[0].quantity = 0;
    await expect(service.create('customer', dto)).rejects.toThrow(
      BadRequestException,
    );
    expect(stockUpdate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(createOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it.each(['insufficient', 'version conflict'])(
    'rejects %s stock without creating an order',
    async (scenario) => {
      if (scenario === 'insufficient') products[0].stock = 1;
      else stockUpdate.mockResolvedValue({ count: 0 });
      await expect(service.create('customer', dto)).rejects.toThrow(
        ConflictException,
      );
      expect(createOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    },
  );

  it('does not silently accept demo promotion codes', async () => {
    dto.promotionCode = 'BREW10';
    await expect(service.create('customer', dto)).rejects.toThrow(
      BadRequestException,
    );
    expect(stockUpdate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('bounds integer money before writing stock', async () => {
    products[0].price = 2147483647;
    await expect(service.create('customer', dto)).rejects.toThrow(
      BadRequestException,
    );
    expect(stockUpdate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('hides other customers orders as 404', async () => {
    findOrder.mockResolvedValue(null);
    await expect(service.get('order', 'other')).rejects.toThrow(
      NotFoundException,
    );
    expect(findOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ where: { id: 'order', userId: 'other' } }),
    );
  });

  function order(status: OrderStatus, held = true) {
    return {
      id: 'order',
      status,
      version: 3,
      inventoryHeld: held,
      items: [{ productId, qty: 2 }],
    };
  }

  it.each(['CANCELLED', 'PAYMENT_FAILED'] as OrderStatus[])(
    'releases stock after winning order CAS for %s',
    async (to) => {
      findOrder.mockResolvedValue(order('PENDING'));
      await service.transitionInTransaction(
        tx as unknown as Prisma.TransactionClient,
        'order',
        to,
        to === 'CANCELLED' ? 'Hết nguyên liệu' : undefined,
      );
      expect(updateOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          where: { id: 'order', status: 'PENDING', version: 3 },
        }),
      );
      expect(restore).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(history).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        data: {
          orderId: 'order',
          fromStatus: 'PENDING',
          toStatus: to,
          version: 4,
          createdAt: expect.any(Date),
        },
      });
    },
  );

  it('does not restore twice when cancelling a failed payment', async () => {
    findOrder.mockResolvedValue(order('PAYMENT_FAILED', false));
    await service.transitionInTransaction(
      tx as unknown as Prisma.TransactionClient,
      'order',
      'CANCELLED',
      'Khách yêu cầu hủy',
    );
    expect(restore).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('reacquires stock before retrying payment', async () => {
    findOrder.mockResolvedValue(order('PAYMENT_FAILED', false));
    await service.transitionInTransaction(
      tx as unknown as Prisma.TransactionClient,
      'order',
      'PENDING',
    );
    expect(stockUpdate).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(restore).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('does not mutate inventory/history after losing order CAS', async () => {
    findOrder.mockResolvedValue(order('PENDING'));
    updateOrder.mockResolvedValue({ count: 0 });
    await expect(
      service.transitionInTransaction(
        tx as unknown as Prisma.TransactionClient,
        'order',
        'CANCELLED',
        'Hết nguyên liệu',
      ),
    ).rejects.toThrow(ConflictException);
    expect(restore).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(history).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('rejects skipped states and staff attempts to mark payment successful', async () => {
    findOrder.mockResolvedValue(order('PENDING'));
    await expect(
      service.transitionInTransaction(
        tx as unknown as Prisma.TransactionClient,
        'order',
        'PREPARING',
      ),
    ).rejects.toThrow(ConflictException);
    await expect(service.staffTransition('order', 'PAID')).rejects.toThrow(
      BadRequestException,
    );
    expect(updateOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
````

````text
import {
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
  Inject,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { OrderStatus, Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import { InventoryService } from '../inventory/inventory.service';
import { CreateOrderDto } from './dto/create-order.dto';
import { assertOrderTransition } from './order-state-machine';
import { ORDER_DISCOUNT, type OrderDiscount } from './order-discount';
import { orderInclude, orderResponse } from './order-response';

function money(value: number) {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0 || value > 2147483647) {
    throw new BadRequestException('Giá trị đơn hàng vượt giới hạn');
  }
  return value;
}

@Injectable()
export class OrdersService {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly inventory: InventoryService,
    @Inject(ORDER_DISCOUNT) private readonly discount: OrderDiscount,
  ) {}

  private async transaction<T>(
    work: (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) => Promise<T>,
  ): Promise<T> {
    try {
      return await this.prisma.$transaction(work);
    } catch (error) {
      if (
        error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError &&
        error.code === 'P2034'
      ) {
        throw new ConflictException(
          'Đơn hàng hoặc tồn kho vừa thay đổi. Vui lòng thử lại',
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async create(userId: string, dto: CreateOrderDto) {
    if (!dto.items?.length) throw new BadRequestException('Giỏ hàng trống');
    return this.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const products = await tx.product.findMany({
        where: { id: { in: [...new Set(dto.items.map((i) => i.productId))] } },
        include: { sizes: true, toppings: { include: { topping: true } } },
      });
      const items = dto.items.map((item, position) => {
        const product = products.find((p) => p.id === item.productId);
        if (!product) throw new BadRequestException('Sản phẩm không tồn tại');
        const size = product.sizes.find(
          (s) => s.code === item.size && s.available,
        );
        if (!size)
          throw new BadRequestException('Size không hợp lệ hoặc ngừng bán');
        if (new Set(item.toppingIds).size !== item.toppingIds.length) {
          throw new BadRequestException('Topping bị trùng');
        }
        const toppings = item.toppingIds.map((id) => {
          const option = product.toppings.find(
            (t) => t.toppingId === id && t.available,
          );
          if (!option)
            throw new BadRequestException(
              'Topping không hợp lệ hoặc ngừng bán',
            );
          return {
            toppingId: id,
            name: option.topping.name,
            extraPrice: money(option.extraPrice),
          };
        });
        const unitPrice = money(
          money(product.price) +
            money(size.extraPrice) +
            toppings.reduce((sum, t) => sum + t.extraPrice, 0),
        );
        if (
          !Number.isInteger(item.quantity) ||
          item.quantity < 1 ||
          item.quantity > 99
        ) {
          throw new BadRequestException('Số lượng không hợp lệ');
        }
        return {
          productId: product.id,
          position,
          name: product.name,
          imageUrl: product.imageUrl,
          size: size.code,
          basePrice: product.price,
          sizePrice: size.extraPrice,
          unitPrice,
          qty: item.quantity,
          lineTotal: money(unitPrice * item.quantity),
          ice: item.ice,
          sugar: item.sugar,
          note: item.note?.trim() || null,
          toppings: { create: toppings },
        };
      });
      const subtotal = money(
        items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.lineTotal, 0),
      );
      const promotionCode = dto.promotionCode?.trim();
      if (dto.promotionCode != null && !promotionCode)
        throw new BadRequestException('Mã ưu đãi trống');
      const discountAmount = money(
        await this.discount.calculate(tx, { userId, subtotal, promotionCode }),
      );
      if (discountAmount > subtotal)
        throw new BadRequestException('Giảm giá vượt tổng đơn');
      await this.inventory.reserve(tx, items, products);
      const order = await tx.order.create({
        data: {
          userId,
          subtotal,
          discountAmount,
          total: subtotal - discountAmount,
          promotionCode,
          status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
          inventoryHeld: true,
          items: { create: items },
          statusHistory: {
            create: { toStatus: OrderStatus.PENDING, version: 1 },
          },
        } satisfies Prisma.OrderUncheckedCreateInput,
        include: orderInclude,
      });

      // 💡 BỔ SUNG: ĐÁNH DẤU MÃ VOUCHER ĐÃ ĐƯỢC SỬ DỤNG
      if (promotionCode) {
        try {
          const db = tx as any;

          // 1. Cập nhật bảng UserCoupon (nếu có)
          if (db.userCoupon) {
            await db.userCoupon.updateMany({
              where: { code: promotionCode, userId },
              data: { isUsed: true, status: 'USED' },
            });
          }

          // 2. Tạo record trong CouponUsage (nếu có)
          if (db.couponUsage) {
            await db.couponUsage.create({
              data: {
                code: promotionCode,
                userId,
                orderId: order.id,
              },
            });
          }

          // 3. Cập nhật bảng LoyaltyTransaction (nếu có)
          if (db.loyaltyTransaction) {
            await db.loyaltyTransaction.updateMany({
              where: { code: promotionCode, userId },
              data: { isUsed: true, status: 'USED' },
            });
          }
        } catch (e) {
          // Bỏ qua nếu bảng phụ chưa có
        }
      }

      return orderResponse(order);
    });
  }

  async mine(userId: string) {
    return (
      await this.prisma.order.findMany({
        where: { userId },
        include: orderInclude,
        orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'desc' }],
      })
    ).map(orderResponse);
  }

  async get(id: string, userId: string) {
    const order = await this.prisma.order.findFirst({
      where: { id, userId },
      include: orderInclude,
    });
    if (!order) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy đơn hàng');
    return orderResponse(order);
  }

  /** Internal payment retry only. Re-reserves inventory atomically and verifies ownership. */
  async preparePaymentRetry(
    id: string,
    userId: string,
    transaction?: Prisma.TransactionClient,
  ) {
    const prepare = async (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) => {
      const owned = await tx.order.findFirst({ where: { id, userId } });
      if (!owned) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy đơn hàng');
      return orderResponse(
        await this.transitionInTransaction(tx, id, OrderStatus.PENDING),
      );
    };
    return transaction ? prepare(transaction) : this.transaction(prepare);
  }

  async staffList() {
    return (
      await this.prisma.order.findMany({
        where: {
          status: {
            in: ['PAID', 'PREPARING', 'READY', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'],
          },
        },
        include: orderInclude,
        orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }],
      })
    ).map(orderResponse);
  }

  async staffGet(id: string) {
    const order = await this.prisma.order.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: orderInclude,
    });
    if (!order) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy đơn hàng');
    return orderResponse(order);
  }

  async staffCancel(id: string, reason: string) {
    return this.transaction(async (tx) =>
      orderResponse(
        await this.transitionInTransaction(
          tx,
          id,
          OrderStatus.CANCELLED,
          reason,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  async staffTransition(id: string, to: OrderStatus) {
    if (!(['PREPARING', 'READY', 'COMPLETED'] as OrderStatus[]).includes(to)) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Chỉ cho phép PREPARING, READY hoặc COMPLETED; hủy đơn phải dùng API cancel kèm lý do',
      );
    }
    return this.transaction(async (tx) =>
      orderResponse(await this.transitionInTransaction(tx, id, to)),
    );
  }

  /** Internal TV5/TV6 integration only. Caller MUST propagate errors to roll back its transaction.
   * Verify ownership in PaymentsModule; persist payment/idempotency/loyalty in the same tx.
   * UNKNOWN must not call this method. Retry PAYMENT_FAILED -> PENDING before gateway attempt.
   * CANCELLED requires a reason as the fourth argument, including internal callers.
   */
  async transitionInTransaction(
    tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
    id: string,
    to: OrderStatus,
    reason?: string,
  ) {
    const cancelReason = typeof reason === 'string' ? reason.trim() : '';
    if (
      to === OrderStatus.CANCELLED &&
      (!cancelReason || Array.from(cancelReason).length > 300)
    ) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Lý do hủy phải có từ 1 đến 300 ký tự');
    }
    const order = await tx.order.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: orderInclude,
    });
    if (!order) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy đơn hàng');
    assertOrderTransition(order.status, to);
    const release =
      to === OrderStatus.CANCELLED || to === OrderStatus.PAYMENT_FAILED;
    const reserve =
      order.status === OrderStatus.PAYMENT_FAILED && to === OrderStatus.PENDING;
    const transitionedAt = new Date();
    // Version also prevents ABA races across PAYMENT_FAILED -> PENDING retry cycles.
    const changed = await tx.order.updateMany({
      where: { id, status: order.status, version: order.version },
      data: {
        status: to,
        version: { increment: 1 },
        inventoryHeld: release ? false : reserve ? true : order.inventoryHeld,
        ...(to === OrderStatus.CANCELLED ? { cancelReason } : {}),
        ...(to === OrderStatus.COMPLETED
          ? { completedAt: transitionedAt }
          : {}),
      },
    });
    if (changed.count !== 1)
      throw new ConflictException('Đơn hàng vừa thay đổi. Vui lòng tải lại');
    if (release && order.inventoryHeld)
      await this.inventory.restore(tx, order.items);
    if (reserve) await this.inventory.reserve(tx, order.items);
    await tx.orderStatusHistory.create({
      data: {
        orderId: id,
        fromStatus: order.status,
        toStatus: to,
        version: order.version + 1,
        createdAt: transitionedAt,
      },
    });

    // TÍCH ĐIỂM TỰ ĐỘNG: Mỗi khi đơn chuyển sang PAID và trước đó chưa phải PAID
    if (to === OrderStatus.PAID && order.status !== OrderStatus.PAID) {
      const pointsToEarn = Math.floor(order.total / 10000);
      if (pointsToEarn > 0) {
        await tx.user.update({
          where: { id: order.userId },
          data: {
            loyaltyPoints: {
              increment: pointsToEarn,
            },
          },
        });
        console.log(
          `[LOYALTY] Đã cộng ${pointsToEarn} điểm cho user ${order.userId} từ đơn hàng ${order.id}`,
        );
      }
    }

    return tx.order.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id }, include: orderInclude });
  }
}
````

````text
import { BadRequestException, Body, Controller, Inject, Post } from '@nestjs/common';
import { IsInt, IsString, Max, MaxLength, Min, MinLength } from 'class-validator';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import { ORDER_DISCOUNT, type OrderDiscount } from './order-discount';

export class ValidatePromotionDto {
  @IsString()
  @MinLength(1)
  @MaxLength(64)
  code: string;

  @IsInt()
  @Min(0)
  @Max(1_000_000_000)
  subtotal: number;
}

@Controller('promotions')
export class PromotionsController {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    @Inject(ORDER_DISCOUNT) private readonly discount: OrderDiscount,
  ) {}

  @Post('validate')
  async validate(@Body() dto: ValidatePromotionDto) {
    const code = dto.code.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!code) throw new BadRequestException('Vui lòng nhập mã ưu đãi');
    const discount = await this.prisma.$transaction((tx) =>
      this.discount.calculate(tx, { userId: '', subtotal: dto.subtotal, promotionCode: code }),
    );
    return { code, discount };
  }
}
````

````text
import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Get,
  Param,
  ParseUUIDPipe,
  Patch,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { OrderStatus, Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { Transform } from 'class-transformer';
import { IsIn, IsString, Length } from 'class-validator';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/jwt-auth.guard';
import { Roles } from '../auth/roles.decorator';
import { RolesGuard } from '../auth/roles.guard';
import { OrdersService } from './orders.service';

export class StaffStatusDto {
  @IsIn(['PREPARING', 'READY', 'COMPLETED']) status: OrderStatus;
}

export class CancelOrderDto {
  @Transform(({ value }: { value: unknown }) =>
    typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : value,
  )
  @IsString()
  @Length(1, 300)
  reason: string;
}

@Controller('staff/orders')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(Role.BARISTA)
export class StaffOrdersController {
  constructor(private readonly orders: OrdersService) {}

  @Get()
  list() {
    return this.orders.staffList();
  }

  @Get(':id')
  get(@Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string) {
    return this.orders.staffGet(id);
  }

  @Patch(':id/cancel')
  cancel(@Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string, @Body() dto: CancelOrderDto) {
    return this.orders.staffCancel(id, dto.reason);
  }

  @Patch(':id/status')
  transition(
    @Param('id', ParseUUIDPipe) id: string,
    @Body() dto: StaffStatusDto,
  ) {
    return this.orders.staffTransition(id, dto.status);
  }
}
````

````text
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { INestApplication, ValidationPipe } from '@nestjs/common';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { OrderStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import request from 'supertest';
import { AppModule } from '../app.module';
import { cookieOriginGuard } from '../auth/csrf.middleware';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import { OrdersService } from './orders.service';

// Opt-in only. The verifier provisions and drops a dedicated UUID-named database.
const databaseUrl = process.env.ORDERS_TEST_DATABASE_URL;
const describeDatabase = databaseUrl ? describe : describe.skip;

describeDatabase('Staff Orders HTTP with PostgreSQL', () => {
  let db: PrismaService;
  let app: INestApplication;
  let service: OrdersService;
  let jwt: JwtService;
  const customerId = randomUUID();
  const staffId = randomUUID();
  const otherId = randomUUID();
  const productId = randomUUID();
  const toppingId = randomUUID();
  const customerName = 'Khách kiểm thử Barista';
  const cookie = (id = staffId) =>
    `brewlite_session=${jwt.sign({ sub: id, sessionVersion: 0 })}`;
  const get = (path: string, id = staffId) =>
    request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api${path}`).set('Cookie', cookie(id));
  const patch = (id: string, action: string, body: object) =>
    request(app.getHttpServer())
      .patch(`/api/staff/orders/${id}/${action}`)
      .set('Cookie', cookie())
      .set('Origin', 'http://localhost:3000')
      .send(body);
  const cancel = (id: string, reason = ' Hết nguyên liệu ') =>
    patch(id, 'cancel', { reason });
  const transition = (id: string, status: OrderStatus) =>
    patch(id, 'status', { status });
  const row = (id: string) => db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
  const stock = async () =>
    (await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productId } })).stock;
  const history = (id: string) =>
    db.orderStatusHistory.findMany({
      where: { orderId: id },
      orderBy: { version: 'asc' },
    });

  async function create(status: OrderStatus = 'PENDING') {
    const order = await service.create(customerId, {
      items: [
        {
          productId,
          size: 'M',
          toppingIds: [toppingId],
          quantity: 1,
          ice: '70% đá',
          sugar: '50% đường',
          note: 'Ít nóng',
        },
      ],
    });
    if (status === 'PAYMENT_FAILED') {
      await db.$transaction((tx) =>
        service.transitionInTransaction(tx, order.id, status),
      );
    } else if (status !== 'PENDING') {
      // Payment integration boundary: the staff HTTP API must never mark PAID.
      await db.$transaction((tx) =>
        service.transitionInTransaction(tx, order.id, 'PAID'),
      );
      for (const next of ['PREPARING', 'READY', 'COMPLETED'] as const) {
        if ((await row(order.id)).status === status) break;
        await service.staffTransition(order.id, next);
      }
    }
    return order.id;
  }

  beforeAll(async () => {
    db = new PrismaService({ datasources: { db: { url: databaseUrl! } } });
    await db.$connect();
    for (const id of [customerId, staffId, otherId]) {
      await db.user.create({
        data: {
          id,
          email: `${id}@staff.test`,
          fullName: customerName,
          passwordHash: 'test-only-not-a-login',
          role: id === staffId ? 'BARISTA' : 'CUSTOMER',
        },
      });
    }
    await db.topping.create({ data: { id: toppingId, name: 'Kem cheese' } });
    await db.product.create({
      data: {
        id: productId,
        name: 'Cacao',
        price: 30000,
        imageUrl: '/test.svg',
        stock: 20,
        sizes: { create: { code: 'M', name: 'Medium', extraPrice: 5000 } },
        toppings: { create: { toppingId, extraPrice: 6000 } },
      },
    });
    process.env.JWT_SECRET = 'staff-postgres-test-only';
    process.env.FRONTEND_ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000';
    const module = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] })
      .overrideProvider(PrismaService)
      .useValue(db)
      .compile();
    service = module.get(OrdersService);
    jwt = module.get(JwtService);
    app = module.createNestApplication({ logger: false });
    app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
    app.use(cookieOriginGuard);
    app.useGlobalPipes(
      new ValidationPipe({
        whitelist: true,
        forbidNonWhitelisted: true,
        transform: true,
      }),
    );
    await app.init();
  });
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await db.order.deleteMany({
      where: { userId: { in: [customerId, otherId] } },
    });
    await db.product.update({
      where: { id: productId },
      data: { stock: 20, version: 1 },
    });
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    if (!db) return;
    await db.order.deleteMany({
      where: { userId: { in: [customerId, otherId] } },
    });
    await db.product.deleteMany({ where: { id: productId } });
    await db.topping.deleteMany({ where: { id: toppingId } });
    await db.user.deleteMany({
      where: { id: { in: [customerId, staffId, otherId] } },
    });
    await app?.close();
    await db.$disconnect();
  });

  it('returns full detail to Barista without exposing private account fields', async () => {
    const id = await create();
    const response = await get(`/staff/orders/${id}`).expect(200);
    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({
      id,
      customerName,
      total: 41000,
      status: 'PENDING',
      items: [
        {
          name: 'Cacao',
          size: 'M',
          toppingNames: ['Kem cheese'],
          ice: '70% đá',
          sugar: '50% đường',
          note: 'Ít nóng',
        },
      ],
    });
    expect(response.body).not.toHaveProperty('user');
    expect(response.body).not.toHaveProperty('passwordHash');
    expect(response.body).not.toHaveProperty('email');
    await get(`/staff/orders/${id}`, customerId).expect(403);
    await get(`/staff/orders/${randomUUID()}`).expect(404);
    await cancel(randomUUID()).expect(404);
    await get(`/orders/${id}`, otherId).expect(404);
  });

  it.each(['PENDING', 'PAID', 'PAYMENT_FAILED', 'PREPARING'] as const)(
    'cancels %s with a trimmed reason, correct inventory, history and customer visibility',
    async (status) => {
      const id = await create(status);
      const before = await row(id);
      const result = await cancel(id).expect(200);
      expect(result.body).toMatchObject({
        status: 'CANCELLED',
        cancelReason: 'Hết nguyên liệu',
        customerName,
      });
      expect(result.body).not.toHaveProperty('completedAt');
      expect(await row(id)).toMatchObject({
        cancelReason: 'Hết nguyên liệu',
        completedAt: null,
        inventoryHeld: false,
        version: before.version + 1,
      });
      expect(await stock()).toBe(20);
      const events = await history(id);
      expect(events.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
        fromStatus: status,
        toStatus: 'CANCELLED',
        version: before.version + 1,
      });
      await get(`/orders/${id}`, customerId)
        .expect(200)
        .expect(({ body }) => {
          expect(body.cancelReason).toBe('Hết nguyên liệu');
          expect(body.status).toBe('CANCELLED');
        });
      await cancel(id, 'Không được ghi đè lý do').expect(409);
      expect(await row(id)).toMatchObject({
        cancelReason: 'Hết nguyên liệu',
        version: before.version + 1,
      });
      expect(await stock()).toBe(20);
      expect(await history(id)).toHaveLength(events.length);
    },
  );

  it('validates reasons and blocks cancellation through status and internal calls without a reason', async () => {
    const id = await create('PAID');
    const before = await row(id);
    for (const reason of [
      undefined,
      null,
      123,
      [],
      {},
      '',
      ' \t\n ',
      'x'.repeat(301),
    ]) {
      await patch(id, 'cancel', { reason }).expect(400);
    }
    await transition(id, 'CANCELLED').expect(400);
    await expect(service.staffTransition(id, 'CANCELLED')).rejects.toThrow();
    await expect(
      db.$transaction((tx) =>
        service.transitionInTransaction(tx, id, 'CANCELLED'),
      ),
    ).rejects.toThrow();
    expect(await row(id)).toEqual(before);
    expect(await stock()).toBe(19);
    await cancel(id, 'x'.repeat(300)).expect(200);
  });

  it.each(['READY', 'COMPLETED'] as const)(
    'rejects cancellation from %s without changing fields, stock or history',
    async (status) => {
      const id = await create(status);
      const before = await row(id);
      const events = await history(id);
      await cancel(id).expect(409);
      expect(await row(id)).toEqual(before);
      expect(await history(id)).toEqual(events);
      expect(await stock()).toBe(19);
    },
  );

  it('records the actual handover time and shares the completed state with the customer', async () => {
    const id = await create('PAID');
    const oldDate = new Date('2020-01-01T00:00:00Z');
    await db.order.update({ where: { id }, data: { createdAt: oldDate } });
    await transition(id, 'COMPLETED').expect(409);
    await transition(id, 'PREPARING').expect(200);
    await transition(id, 'READY').expect(200);
    expect((await row(id)).completedAt).toBeNull();
    const before = Date.now();
    const response = await transition(id, 'COMPLETED').expect(200);
    const completed = new Date(response.body.completedAt).getTime();
    expect(completed).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(before);
    expect(completed).toBeLessThanOrEqual(Date.now());
    expect((await history(id)).at(-1)?.createdAt.toISOString()).toBe(
      response.body.completedAt,
    );
    await get(`/orders/${id}`, customerId)
      .expect(200)
      .expect(({ body }) => {
        expect(body.status).toBe('COMPLETED');
        expect(body.completedAt).toBe(response.body.completedAt);
      });
    await transition(id, 'COMPLETED').expect(409);
    await transition(id, 'PREPARING').expect(409);
    expect((await row(id)).completedAt?.toISOString()).toBe(
      response.body.completedAt,
    );
    expect(await stock()).toBe(19);
  });

  it('lists active and terminal orders in deterministic creation order, excluding unpaid orders', async () => {
    const statuses = [
      'PENDING',
      'PAYMENT_FAILED',
      'PAID',
      'PREPARING',
      'READY',
      'COMPLETED',
    ] as const;
    const ids: string[] = [];
    for (const status of statuses) ids.push(await create(status));
    const cancelled = await create();
    await cancel(cancelled).expect(200);
    const visible = [...ids.slice(2), cancelled];
    for (const id of visible) {
      await db.order.update({
        where: { id },
        data: { createdAt: new Date('2026-01-01T00:00:00Z') },
      });
    }
    const response = await get('/staff/orders').expect(200);
    const ours = response.body.filter(
      (o: { userId: string }) => o.userId === customerId,
    );
    expect(ours.map((o: { id: string }) => o.id)).toEqual([...visible].sort());
    expect(
      ours.find((o: { id: string }) => o.id === cancelled).cancelReason,
    ).toBe('Hết nguyên liệu');
    expect(
      ours.find((o: { status: string }) => o.status === 'COMPLETED')
        .completedAt,
    ).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('allows only one concurrent cancel and preserves its reason with a single stock release', async () => {
    const id = await create('PAID');
    const responses = await Promise.all([
      cancel(id, 'Lý do A'),
      cancel(id, 'Lý do B'),
    ]);
    expect(responses.map((r) => r.status).sort()).toEqual([200, 409]);
    const winner = responses.find((r) => r.status === 200)!;
    expect((await row(id)).cancelReason).toBe(winner.body.cancelReason);
    expect(await stock()).toBe(20);
    expect(
      (await history(id)).filter((h) => h.toStatus === 'CANCELLED'),
    ).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('serializes a cancel versus start-preparing race', async () => {
    const id = await create('PAID');
    const responses = await Promise.all([
      cancel(id),
      transition(id, 'PREPARING'),
    ]);
    // Main permits PREPARING -> CANCELLED: both requests may commit in that
    // order, while competing updates of the same version still return 409.
    const successful = responses.filter((r) => r.status === 200).length;
    expect(successful).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(responses.every((r) => r.status === 200 || r.status === 409)).toBe(true);
    const persisted = await row(id);
    if (successful === 2) expect(persisted.status).toBe('CANCELLED');
    expect(await stock()).toBe(persisted.status === 'CANCELLED' ? 20 : 19);
    expect(persisted.cancelReason).toBe(
      persisted.status === 'CANCELLED' ? 'Hết nguyên liệu' : null,
    );
    expect(await history(id)).toHaveLength(2 + successful);
  });

  it('UC16: two customers compete for the last unit through HTTP; only one order is persisted', async () => {
    await db.product.update({ where: { id: productId }, data: { stock: 1 } });
    const payload = {
      items: [
        {
          productId,
          size: 'M',
          toppingIds: [toppingId],
          quantity: 1,
          ice: '70% đá',
          sugar: '50% ít ngọt',
        },
      ],
    };
    const results = await Promise.all(
      [customerId, otherId].map((id) =>
        request(app.getHttpServer())
          .post('/api/orders')
          .set('Cookie', cookie(id))
          .set('Origin', 'http://localhost:3000')
          .send(payload),
      ),
    );
    expect(results.map((r) => r.status).sort()).toEqual([201, 409]);
    expect(results.find((r) => r.status === 409)!.body.message).toMatch(
      /tồn kho|Tồn kho/,
    );
    const stored = await db.order.findMany({
      where: { items: { some: { productId } } },
      include: { items: true, statusHistory: true },
    });
    expect(stored).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(stored[0]).toMatchObject({
      status: 'PENDING',
      total: 41000,
      inventoryHeld: true,
    });
    expect(stored[0].items).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(stored[0].statusHistory).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(await stock()).toBe(0);
  });

  it('UC31: simultaneous handover writes one completion timestamp and one history event', async () => {
    const id = await create('READY');
    const responses = await Promise.all([
      transition(id, 'COMPLETED'),
      transition(id, 'COMPLETED'),
    ]);
    expect(responses.map((r) => r.status).sort()).toEqual([200, 409]);
    const persisted = await row(id);
    const events = (await history(id)).filter(
      (h) => h.toStatus === 'COMPLETED',
    );
    expect(events).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(persisted.completedAt).toEqual(events[0].createdAt);
    expect(persisted.completedAt?.toISOString()).toBe(
      responses.find((r) => r.status === 200)!.body.completedAt,
    );
    expect(await stock()).toBe(19);
  });

  it('rolls back the reason, state, inventory and history when the transaction fails', async () => {
    const id = await create('PAID');
    const before = await row(id);
    await expect(
      db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        await service.transitionInTransaction(
          tx,
          id,
          'CANCELLED',
          'Hết nguyên liệu',
        );
        throw new Error('forced transaction failure');
      }),
    ).rejects.toThrow('forced transaction failure');
    expect(await row(id)).toEqual(before);
    expect(await stock()).toBe(19);
    expect(await history(id)).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it('backfills completion from real history in the migration and preserves legacy cancellations', async () => {
    // Temporary tables shadow real tables on this transaction connection only.
    await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(
        'CREATE TEMP TABLE orders (id TEXT, status TEXT) ON COMMIT DROP',
      );
      await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(
        'CREATE TEMP TABLE order_status_history (order_id TEXT, to_status TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP(3)) ON COMMIT DROP',
      );
      await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(
        "INSERT INTO orders VALUES ('complete', 'COMPLETED'), ('missing', 'COMPLETED'), ('cancel', 'CANCELLED'), ('paid', 'PAID')",
      );
      await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(
        "INSERT INTO order_status_history VALUES ('complete', 'READY', '2026-01-01'), ('complete', 'COMPLETED', '2026-01-02')",
      );
      const migration = readFileSync(
        'prisma/migrations/20261016000100_staff_order_details/migration.sql',
        'utf8',
      );
      for (const sql of migration
        .split(/;\s*(?:\r?\n|$)/)
        .filter((part) => part.trim())) {
        await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(sql);
      }
      const result = await tx.$queryRawUnsafe<
        {
          id: string;
          cancel_reason: string | null;
          completed_at: Date | null;
        }[]
      >('SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY id');
      expect(
        result.find((r) => r.id === 'complete')?.completed_at?.toISOString(),
      ).toBe('2026-01-02T00:00:00.000Z');
      expect(result.every((r) => r.cancel_reason === null)).toBe(true);
      expect(
        result
          .filter((r) => r.id !== 'complete')
          .every((r) => r.completed_at === null),
      ).toBe(true);
    });
  });
});
````

````text
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';

const databaseUrl = process.env.ORDERS_TEST_DATABASE_URL;
const describeDatabase = databaseUrl ? describe : describe.skip;

describeDatabase(
  'Payment consistency migration against legacy rows (PostgreSQL)',
  () => {
    let db: PrismaService;
    const migration = readFileSync(
      resolve(
        process.cwd(),
        'prisma/migrations/20261017000000_payment_consistency/migration.sql',
      ),
      'utf8',
    )
      .replace(/--[^\n]*/g, '')
      .split(';')
      .map((s) => s.trim())
      .filter((s) => s && s !== 'BEGIN' && s !== 'COMMIT');

    beforeAll(async () => {
      db = new PrismaService({ datasources: { db: { url: databaseUrl! } } });
      await db.$connect();
    });
    afterAll(async () => {
      await db?.$disconnect();
    });

    it('preserves legacy final results without inventing a journal or applied timestamp', async () => {
      await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        // pg_temp shadows payments only inside this connection/transaction.
        await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(
          'CREATE TEMP TABLE payments (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, order_id UUID NOT NULL, status "PaymentStatus" NOT NULL) ON COMMIT DROP',
        );
        for (const status of ['PAID', 'PAYMENT_FAILED', 'UNKNOWN']) {
          await tx.$executeRaw`INSERT INTO payments(id, order_id, status) VALUES (${randomUUID()}::uuid, ${randomUUID()}::uuid, ${status}::"PaymentStatus")`;
        }
        for (const sql of migration) await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(sql);
        const rows = await tx.$queryRaw<
          Array<{
            status: string;
            gateway_status: string | null;
            applied_at: Date | null;
          }>
        >`SELECT status, gateway_status, applied_at FROM payments ORDER BY status`;
        expect(rows).toHaveLength(3);
        for (const row of rows)
          expect(row).toMatchObject({ gateway_status: null, applied_at: null });
        expect(rows.map((r) => r.status).sort()).toEqual(
          ['PAID', 'PAYMENT_FAILED', 'UNKNOWN'].sort(),
        );
      });
    });

    it('refuses duplicate live legacy attempts instead of silently deleting financial rows', async () => {
      await expect(
        db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
          await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(
            'CREATE TEMP TABLE payments (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, order_id UUID NOT NULL, status "PaymentStatus" NOT NULL) ON COMMIT DROP',
          );
          const orderId = randomUUID();
          for (const status of ['PAID', 'PROCESSING']) {
            await tx.$executeRaw`INSERT INTO payments(id, order_id, status) VALUES (${randomUUID()}::uuid, ${orderId}::uuid, ${status}::"PaymentStatus")`;
          }
          for (const sql of migration) await tx.$executeRawUnsafe(sql);
        }),
      ).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'P2010', meta: { code: '23505' } });
    });
  },
);
````

````text
import type { PaymentMethod, Prisma } from '@prisma/client';

export const PAYMENT_ORDER_PORT = Symbol('PAYMENT_ORDER_PORT');
export const PAYMENT_GATEWAY = Symbol('PAYMENT_GATEWAY');

export type PaymentFinalStatus = 'PAID' | 'PAYMENT_FAILED';

export type PayableOrder = {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  total: number;
  status: string;
};

export interface PaymentOrderPort {
  findOwned(
    orderId: string,
    userId: string,
    tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient,
  ): Promise<PayableOrder | null>;
  prepareRetry(
    orderId: string,
    userId: string,
    tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient,
  ): Promise<PayableOrder>;
  applyPaymentResult(
    input: {
      orderId: string;
      userId: string;
      method: PaymentMethod;
      status: PaymentFinalStatus;
    },
    tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient,
  ): Promise<void>;
}

export interface PaymentGateway {
  createPaymentUrl(input: {
    txnRef: string;
    orderId: string;
    amount: number;
    ipAddress: string;
    now?: Date;
  }): { paymentUrl: string; expiresAt: Date };

  verifyCallback(query: VnpayQuery): VnpayVerification;
  queryTransaction(input: {
    txnRef: string;
    transactionDate: string;
    orderInfo: string;
    now?: Date;
  }): Promise<VnpayVerification>;
  isExpectedMerchant(tmnCode: string | undefined): boolean;
  frontendRedirect(path: string): string;
}

export type VnpayQuery = Record<
  string,
  string | string[] | Record<string, unknown> | undefined
>;

export type VnpayVerification =
  | { valid: true; params: Readonly<Record<string, string>> }
  | { valid: false; params: Readonly<Record<string, string>> };

export type VnpayIpnResponse = {
  RspCode: '00' | '01' | '02' | '04' | '97' | '99';
  Message:
    | 'Confirm Success'
    | 'Order not found'
    | 'Order already confirmed'
    | 'Invalid amount'
    | 'Invalid checksum'
    | 'Unknown error';
};
````

<!-- snapshot-file {"path": "backend/src/payments/payments.controller.ts", "encoding": "utf-8", "bytes": 2435, "characters": 2425, "sha256": "3e5fb86267e3256ffa95e52a252736f051c28f701be90e6737fa1828fad1a324"} -->
````text
import {
  BadRequestException,
  Body,
  Controller,
  Get,
  Headers,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
  Param,
  ParseUUIDPipe,
  Post,
  Query,
  Req,
  Res,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { isUUID } from 'class-validator';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/jwt-auth.guard';
import { Roles } from '../auth/roles.decorator';
import { RolesGuard } from '../auth/roles.guard';
import { CreatePaymentDto } from './dto/create-payment.dto';
import type { VnpayQuery } from './payment.types';
import { PaymentsService } from './payments.service';

export function normalizeVnpayIp(value: string | undefined): string {
  if (!value || value === '::1') return '127.0.0.1';
  return value.startsWith('::ffff:') ? value.slice(7) : value;
}

@Controller('payments')
export class PaymentsController {
  constructor(private readonly payments: PaymentsService) {}

  @Post()
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
  @Roles(Role.CUSTOMER)
  pay(
    @Req() request: Request & { user: { userId: string } },
    @Body() input: CreatePaymentDto,
    @Headers('idempotency-key') headerKey?: string,
  ) {
    if (headerKey && input.idempotencyKey && headerKey !== input.idempotencyKey) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Idempotency-Key không khớp với body');
    }
    const idempotencyKey = headerKey || input.idempotencyKey;
    if (!idempotencyKey || !isUUID(idempotencyKey)) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Idempotency-Key không hợp lệ');
    }
    return this.payments.pay(
      request.user.userId,
      { ...input, idempotencyKey },
      normalizeVnpayIp(request.ip || request.socket.remoteAddress),
    );
  }

  @Post(':orderId/reconcile')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
  @Roles(Role.CUSTOMER)
  reconcile(
    @Req() request: Request & { user: { userId: string } },
    @Param('orderId', new ParseUUIDPipe()) orderId: string,
  ) {
    return this.payments.reconcile(request.user.userId, orderId);
  }

  @Get('vnpay/ipn')
  ipn(@Query() query: VnpayQuery) {
    return this.payments.handleIpn(query);
  }

  @Get('vnpay/return')
  async returnFromVnpay(
    @Query() query: VnpayQuery,
    @Res() response: Response,
  ) {
    response.redirect(302, await this.payments.handleReturn(query));
  }
}

````
