````text
import { jest } from '@jest/globals';
import { ValidationPipe, type INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';
import request from 'supertest';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/jwt-auth.guard';
import {
  normalizeVnpayIp,
  PaymentsController,
} from './payments.controller';
import { PaymentsService } from './payments.service';

describe('Payments HTTP contract', () => {
  let app: INestApplication;
  const pay = jest.fn<PaymentsService['pay']>();
  const reconcile = jest.fn<PaymentsService['reconcile']>();
  const handleIpn = jest.fn<PaymentsService['handleIpn']>();
  const handleReturn = jest.fn<PaymentsService['handleReturn']>();
  const orderId = '21a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001';
  const idempotencyKey = '41a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001';
  let role: Role = Role.CUSTOMER;
  const response = {
    id: '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001',
    orderId,
    method: 'VNPAY_QR' as const,
    status: 'PROCESSING' as const,
    idempotencyKey,
    paymentUrl: 'https://sandbox.vnpayment.vn/paymentv2/vpcpay.html?signed',
    expiresAt: '2026-10-21T03:15:00.000Z',
  };

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const module = await Test.createTestingModule({
      controllers: [PaymentsController],
      providers: [
        {
          provide: PaymentsService,
          useValue: { pay, reconcile, handleIpn, handleReturn },
        },
      ],
    })
      .overrideGuard(JwtAuthGuard)
      .useValue({
        canActivate: (context: {
          switchToHttp(): {
            getRequest(): { user?: { userId: string; role: Role } };
          };
        }) => {
          context.switchToHttp().getRequest().user = {
            userId: 'customer-1',
            role,
          };
          return true;
        },
      })
      .compile();

    app = module.createNestApplication({ logger: false });
    app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
    app.useGlobalPipes(
      new ValidationPipe({ whitelist: true, forbidNonWhitelisted: true }),
    );
    await app.init();
  });

  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    role = Role.CUSTOMER;
    pay.mockResolvedValue(response);
    reconcile.mockResolvedValue(response);
    handleIpn.mockResolvedValue({
      RspCode: '00',
      Message: 'Confirm Success',
    });
    handleReturn.mockResolvedValue(
      `https://coffee.example.test/payment/${orderId}/verifying`,
    );
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await app?.close();
  });

  it('accepts only the documented authenticated VNPAY_QR request', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/payments')
      .send({ orderId, method: 'VNPAY_QR', idempotencyKey })
      .expect(201, response);
    expect(pay).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'customer-1',
      { orderId, method: 'VNPAY_QR', idempotencyKey },
      expect.any(String),
    );
  });

  it.each([
    { method: 'CARD' },
    { method: 'WALLET' },
    { method: 'CASH' },
    { method: 'VNPAY_QR', demoOutcome: 'PAID' },
    { method: 'VNPAY_QR', amount: 1 },
    { method: 'VNPAY_QR', userId: 'attacker' },
  ])('rejects unsupported or client-controlled fields: %j', async (extra) => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/payments')
      .send({ orderId, idempotencyKey, ...extra })
      .expect(400);
    expect(pay).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('rejects an authenticated BARISTA from the customer payment endpoint', async () => {
    role = Role.BARISTA;
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/payments')
      .send({ orderId, method: 'VNPAY_QR', idempotencyKey })
      .expect(403);
    expect(pay).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('lets the owning CUSTOMER request server-side reconciliation', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post(`/api/payments/${orderId}/reconcile`)
      .expect(200, response);
    expect(reconcile).toHaveBeenCalledWith('customer-1', orderId);

    role = Role.BARISTA;
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post(`/api/payments/${orderId}/reconcile`)
      .expect(403);
  });

  it('exposes public IPN as HTTP 200 JSON', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/payments/vnpay/ipn')
      .query({ vnp_TxnRef: 'ref', vnp_SecureHash: 'hash' })
      .expect(200, { RspCode: '00', Message: 'Confirm Success' });
    expect(handleIpn).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ vnp_TxnRef: 'ref', vnp_SecureHash: 'hash' }),
    );
  });

  it('exposes public Return as a fixed 302 redirect', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/payments/vnpay/return')
      .query({ vnp_TxnRef: 'ref', redirect: 'https://evil.test' })
      .expect(302)
      .expect(
        'Location',
        `https://coffee.example.test/payment/${orderId}/verifying`,
      );
  });

  it('normalizes loopback and IPv4-mapped request addresses', () => {
    expect(normalizeVnpayIp('::1')).toBe('127.0.0.1');
    expect(normalizeVnpayIp('::ffff:203.0.113.8')).toBe('203.0.113.8');
    expect(normalizeVnpayIp('2001:db8::1')).toBe('2001:db8::1');
  });
});
````

````text
        email: `${userId}@payments.test`,
        fullName: 'Payments test',
        passwordHash: 'not-a-login',
      },
    });
    await db.product.create({
      data: {
        id: productId,
        name: 'Payment test coffee',
        price: 40000,
        imageUrl: '/test.svg',
        stock: 5,
        sizes: {
          create: {
            code: 'M',
            name: 'Medium',
            extraPrice: 0,
            isDefault: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });
    module = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] })
      .overrideProvider(PrismaService)
      .useValue(db)
      .compile();
    app = module.createNestApplication({ logger: false });
    app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
    app.use(cookieOriginGuard);
    app.useGlobalPipes(
      new ValidationPipe({
        whitelist: true,
        forbidNonWhitelisted: true,
        transform: true,
      }),
    );
    await app.init();
  });

  beforeEach(async () => {
    await db.payment.deleteMany({ where: { userId } });
    await db.order.deleteMany({ where: { userId } });
    await db.product.update({
      where: { id: productId },
      data: { stock: 5, version: 1 },
    });
    await db.user.update({
      where: { id: userId },
      data: { loyaltyPoints: 0 },
    });
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      if (db) {
        await db.payment.deleteMany({ where: { userId } });
        await db.order.deleteMany({ where: { userId } });
        await db.product.deleteMany({ where: { id: productId } });
        await db.user.deleteMany({ where: { id: userId } });
      }
    } finally {
      await app?.close();
      await db?.$disconnect();
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(savedEnv)) {
        if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
        else process.env[key] = value;
      }
    }
  });

  const cookie = () =>
    `brewlite_session=${module
      .get(JwtService)
      .sign({ sub: userId, sessionVersion: 0 })}`;

  const createOrder = async () => {
    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/orders')
      .set('Cookie', cookie())
      .set('Origin', origin)
      .send({
        items: [
          {
            productId,
            size: 'M',
            toppingIds: [],
            quantity: 1,
            ice: '70% đá',
            sugar: '50% ít ngọt',
          },
        ],
      })
      .expect(201);
    return response.body as { id: string; total: number };
  };

  const pay = (orderId: string, idempotencyKey: string) =>
    request(app.getHttpServer())
      .post('/api/payments')
      .set('Cookie', cookie())
      .set('Origin', origin)
      .send({ orderId, method: 'VNPAY_QR', idempotencyKey });

  const callback = (
    paymentUrl: string,
    responseCode = '00',
    transactionStatus = '00',
  ) => {
    const url = new URL(paymentUrl);
    const params = {
      vnp_Amount: url.searchParams.get('vnp_Amount')!,
      vnp_BankCode: 'NCB',
      vnp_CardType: 'QRCODE',
      vnp_PayDate: '20261021101500',
      vnp_ResponseCode: responseCode,
      vnp_TmnCode: tmnCode,
      vnp_TransactionNo: '123456789',
      vnp_TransactionStatus: transactionStatus,
      vnp_TxnRef: url.searchParams.get('vnp_TxnRef')!,
    };
    return {
      ...params,
      vnp_SecureHash: createHmac('sha512', hashSecret)
        .update(formEncode(params), 'utf8')
        .digest('hex'),
    };
  };

  it('persists and idempotently replays one PROCESSING URL while blocking another active attempt', async () => {
    const order = await createOrder();
    const idempotencyKey = randomUUID();
    const first = await pay(order.id, idempotencyKey).expect(201);
    expect(first.body).toMatchObject({
      orderId: order.id,
      method: 'VNPAY_QR',
      status: 'PROCESSING',
      idempotencyKey,
      paymentUrl: expect.stringContaining('vnp_SecureHash='),
      expiresAt: expect.any(String),
    });
    await pay(order.id, idempotencyKey).expect(201, first.body);
    await pay(order.id, randomUUID()).expect(409);

    expect(await db.payment.count({ where: { orderId: order.id } })).toBe(1);
    expect(
      await db.payment.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: first.body.id } }),
    ).toMatchObject({
      status: 'PROCESSING',
      amount: order.total,
      paymentUrl: first.body.paymentUrl,
    });
    expect(
      await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: order.id } }),
    ).toMatchObject({ status: 'PENDING', inventoryHeld: true });
  });

  it('atomically finalizes success from IPN, ignores replay, and keeps Return read-only', async () => {
    const order = await createOrder();
    const created = await pay(order.id, randomUUID()).expect(201);
    const query = callback(created.body.paymentUrl);

    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/payments/vnpay/ipn')
      .query(query)
      .expect(200, { RspCode: '00', Message: 'Confirm Success' });
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/payments/vnpay/ipn')
      .query(query)
      .expect(200, {
        RspCode: '02',
        Message: 'Order already confirmed',
      });

    const beforeReturn = {
      payment: await db.payment.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { id: created.body.id },
      }),
      order: await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { id: order.id },
        include: { statusHistory: { orderBy: { version: 'asc' } } },
      }),
      points: (
        await db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: userId } })
      ).loyaltyPoints,
    };
    expect(beforeReturn.payment).toMatchObject({
      status: 'PAID',
      vnpResponseCode: '00',
      vnpTransactionStatus: '00',
      vnpTransactionNo: '123456789',
    });
    expect(beforeReturn.order.status).toBe('PAID');
    expect(beforeReturn.order.statusHistory.map((row) => row.toStatus)).toEqual([
      'PENDING',
      'PAID',
    ]);
    expect(beforeReturn.points).toBe(4);

    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/payments/vnpay/return')
      .query(query)
      .expect(302)
      .expect(
        'Location',
        `${origin}/payment/${order.id}/verifying`,
      );
    expect(
      await db.payment.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: created.body.id } }),
    ).toEqual(beforeReturn.payment);
    expect(
      await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({
        where: { id: order.id },
        include: { statusHistory: { orderBy: { version: 'asc' } } },
      }),
    ).toEqual(beforeReturn.order);
    expect(
      (await db.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: userId } }))
        .loyaltyPoints,
    ).toBe(beforeReturn.points);
  });

  it('releases stock on failed IPN and atomically reserves it before a retry URL', async () => {
    const order = await createOrder();
    const failed = await pay(order.id, randomUUID()).expect(201);
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/payments/vnpay/ipn')
      .query(callback(failed.body.paymentUrl, '24', '02'))
      .expect(200, { RspCode: '00', Message: 'Confirm Success' });
    expect(
      await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: order.id } }),
    ).toMatchObject({ status: 'PAYMENT_FAILED', inventoryHeld: false });
    expect(
      (await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productId } })).stock,
    ).toBe(5);

    await db.product.update({ where: { id: productId }, data: { stock: 0 } });
    await pay(order.id, randomUUID()).expect(409);
    expect(await db.payment.count({ where: { orderId: order.id } })).toBe(1);
    expect(
      await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: order.id } }),
    ).toMatchObject({ status: 'PAYMENT_FAILED', inventoryHeld: false });

    await db.product.update({ where: { id: productId }, data: { stock: 5 } });
    const retry = await pay(order.id, randomUUID()).expect(201);
    expect(retry.body.status).toBe('PROCESSING');
    const retriedOrder = await db.order.findUniqueOrThrow({
      where: { id: order.id },
      include: { statusHistory: { orderBy: { version: 'asc' } } },
    });
    expect(retriedOrder).toMatchObject({
      status: 'PENDING',
      inventoryHeld: true,
    });
    expect(retriedOrder.statusHistory.map((row) => row.toStatus)).toEqual([
      'PENDING',
      'PAYMENT_FAILED',
      'PENDING',
    ]);
    expect(
      (await db.product.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: productId } })).stock,
    ).toBe(4);
  });
});
````

````text
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Prisma, type PaymentMethod } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import type { PaymentFinalStatus } from './payment.types';

type CreateInput = {
  userId: string;
  orderId: string;
  amount: number;
  method: PaymentMethod;
  idempotencyKey: string;
  vnpTxnRef: string;
  paymentUrl: string;
  expiresAt: Date;
};

type FinalizeInput = {
  id: string;
  status: PaymentFinalStatus;
  responseCode: string;
  transactionStatus: string;
  transactionNo?: string;
  bankCode?: string;
  cardType?: string;
  payDate?: string;
  processedAt: Date;
};

type DbClient = PrismaService | Prisma.TransactionClient;

@Injectable()
export class PaymentsRepository {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  transaction<T>(work: (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) => Promise<T>) {
    return this.prisma.$transaction(work);
  }

  findByKey(
    userId: string,
    idempotencyKey: string,
    client: DbClient = this.prisma,
  ) {
    return client.payment.findUnique({
      where: { userId_idempotencyKey: { userId, idempotencyKey } },
    });
  }

  findByTxnRef(vnpTxnRef: string, client: DbClient = this.prisma) {
    return client.payment.findUnique({ where: { vnpTxnRef } });
  }

  findLatestForOwnedOrder(
    orderId: string,
    userId: string,
    client: DbClient = this.prisma,
  ) {
    return client.payment.findFirst({
      where: { orderId, userId },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
  }

  create(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, input: CreateInput) {
    return tx.payment.create({
      data: { ...input, status: 'PROCESSING' },
    });
  }

  conditionalFinalize(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, input: FinalizeInput) {
    return tx.payment.updateMany({
      where: { id: input.id, status: 'PROCESSING' },
      data: {
        status: input.status,
        vnpResponseCode: input.responseCode,
        vnpTransactionStatus: input.transactionStatus,
        vnpTransactionNo: input.transactionNo,
        vnpBankCode: input.bankCode,
        vnpCardType: input.cardType,
        vnpPayDate: input.payDate,
        processedAt: input.processedAt,
      },
    });
  }

  isUniqueViolation(error: unknown): boolean {
    return (
      error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError &&
      error.code === 'P2002'
    );
  }
}
````

````text
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { jest } from '@jest/globals';
import { ConflictException } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Payment, Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import type { CreatePaymentDto } from './dto/create-payment.dto';
import type { PaymentGateway, PaymentOrderPort } from './payment.types';
import { PaymentsRepository } from './payments.repository';
import { PaymentsService } from './payments.service';

const userId = '11a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001';
const orderId = '21a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001';
const paymentId = '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001';
const idempotencyKey = '41a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001';
const expiresAt = new Date('2026-10-21T03:15:00.000Z');
const input: CreatePaymentDto = {
  orderId,
  method: 'VNPAY_QR',
  idempotencyKey,
};

function payment(status: Payment['status'] = 'PROCESSING'): Payment {
  return {
    id: paymentId,
    userId,
    orderId,
    amount: 98000,
    method: 'VNPAY_QR',
    status,
    idempotencyKey,
    vnpTxnRef: '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef',
    paymentUrl:
      'https://sandbox.vnpayment.vn/pay?vnp_CreateDate=20261021100000&vnp_OrderInfo=Thanh+toan+don+hang+0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef&vnp_TxnRef=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef&vnp_SecureHash=signed',
    expiresAt,
    vnpTransactionNo: null,
    vnpResponseCode: null,
    vnpTransactionStatus: null,
    vnpBankCode: null,
    vnpCardType: null,
    vnpPayDate: null,
    processedAt: null,
    createdAt: new Date('2026-10-21T03:00:00.000Z'),
    updatedAt: new Date('2026-10-21T03:00:00.000Z'),
  };
}

describe('PaymentsService VNPAY flow', () => {
  const tx = {} as Prisma.TransactionClient;
  const findByKey = jest.fn<PaymentsRepository['findByKey']>();
  const findByTxnRef = jest.fn<PaymentsRepository['findByTxnRef']>();
  const findLatestForOwnedOrder =
    jest.fn<PaymentsRepository['findLatestForOwnedOrder']>();
  const create = jest.fn<PaymentsRepository['create']>();
  const conditionalFinalize =
    jest.fn<PaymentsRepository['conditionalFinalize']>();
  const isUniqueViolation =
    jest.fn<PaymentsRepository['isUniqueViolation']>();
  const transaction = jest.fn<PaymentsRepository['transaction']>();
  const repository = {
    findByKey,
    findByTxnRef,
    findLatestForOwnedOrder,
    create,
    conditionalFinalize,
    isUniqueViolation,
    transaction,
  } as unknown as PaymentsRepository;

  const findOwned = jest.fn<PaymentOrderPort['findOwned']>();
  const prepareRetry = jest.fn<PaymentOrderPort['prepareRetry']>();
  const applyPaymentResult = jest.fn<PaymentOrderPort['applyPaymentResult']>();
  const orders: PaymentOrderPort = {
    findOwned,
    prepareRetry,
    applyPaymentResult,
  };

  const createPaymentUrl = jest.fn<PaymentGateway['createPaymentUrl']>();
  const verifyCallback = jest.fn<PaymentGateway['verifyCallback']>();
  const queryTransaction = jest.fn<PaymentGateway['queryTransaction']>();
  const isExpectedMerchant = jest.fn<PaymentGateway['isExpectedMerchant']>();
  const frontendRedirect = jest.fn<PaymentGateway['frontendRedirect']>();
  const gateway: PaymentGateway = {
    createPaymentUrl,
    verifyCallback,
    queryTransaction,
    isExpectedMerchant,
    frontendRedirect,
  };
  const service = new PaymentsService(repository, orders, gateway);

  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    transaction.mockImplementation(async (work) => work(tx));
    findByKey.mockResolvedValue(null);
    findOwned.mockResolvedValue({
      id: orderId,
      userId,
      total: 98000,
      status: 'PENDING',
    });
    prepareRetry.mockResolvedValue({
      id: orderId,
      userId,
      total: 98000,
      status: 'PENDING',
    });
    createPaymentUrl.mockReturnValue({
      paymentUrl: payment().paymentUrl!,
      expiresAt,
    });
    create.mockResolvedValue(payment());
    findLatestForOwnedOrder.mockResolvedValue(payment());
    conditionalFinalize.mockResolvedValue({ count: 1 });
    isUniqueViolation.mockReturnValue(false);
    applyPaymentResult.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    isExpectedMerchant.mockReturnValue(true);
    frontendRedirect.mockImplementation((path) => `https://shop.test${path}`);
    queryTransaction.mockResolvedValue({
      valid: true,
      params: {
        vnp_Command: 'querydr',
        vnp_ResponseCode: '00',
        vnp_TmnCode: 'BREWTEST',
        vnp_TxnRef: payment().vnpTxnRef!,
        vnp_Amount: '9800000',
        vnp_TransactionType: '01',
        vnp_TransactionStatus: '00',
        vnp_TransactionNo: '12345',
        vnp_BankCode: 'NCB',
        vnp_PayDate: '20261021100100',
      },
    });
  });

  it('creates and persists a PROCESSING URL using the trusted order amount', async () => {
    await expect(service.pay(userId, input, '203.0.113.8')).resolves.toEqual({
      id: paymentId,
      orderId,
      method: 'VNPAY_QR',
      status: 'PROCESSING',
      idempotencyKey,

    expect(findOwned).toHaveBeenCalledWith(orderId, userId, tx);
    expect(createPaymentUrl).toHaveBeenCalledWith(

    expect(create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(

    expect(findOwned).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(createPaymentUrl).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

  it('maps an active-payment uniqueness race to 409', async () => {

    verifyCallback.mockReturnValue({

        vnp_TmnCode: 'BREWTEST',

      },

    findByTxnRef.mockResolvedValue(null);
    await expect(service.handleIpn({})).resolves.toEqual({

    });
    await expect(service.handleIpn({})).resolves.toEqual({

      Message: 'Unknown error',
    });
  });

  it('conditionally finalizes Payment and Order in the same IPN transaction', async () => {
    verifyCallback.mockReturnValue({
      valid: true,
      params: {
        vnp_TmnCode: 'BREWTEST',
        vnp_TxnRef: payment().vnpTxnRef!,
        vnp_Amount: '9800000',
        vnp_ResponseCode: '00',
        vnp_TransactionStatus: '00',
        vnp_TransactionNo: '12345',
      },
    });
    findByTxnRef.mockResolvedValue(payment());
    await expect(service.handleIpn({})).resolves.toEqual({
      RspCode: '00',
      Message: 'Confirm Success',
    });
    expect(conditionalFinalize).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      tx,
      expect.objectContaining({ id: paymentId, status: 'PAID' }),

  it('maps a final VNPAY failure and reports duplicate IPNs as confirmed', async () => {
    verifyCallback.mockReturnValue({

  it('does not finalize IPN states that may still represent a debit or manual review', async () => {
    findByTxnRef.mockResolvedValue(payment());
    for (const [responseCode, transactionStatus] of [

      ['00', '07'],

      verifyCallback.mockReturnValue({
        valid: true,

          vnp_TmnCode: 'BREWTEST',
          vnp_TxnRef: payment().vnpTxnRef!,

    expect(applyPaymentResult).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('lets only one concurrent IPN pass the conditional finalization', async () => {
    verifyCallback.mockReturnValue({
      valid: true,
      params: {
        vnp_TmnCode: 'BREWTEST',
        vnp_TxnRef: payment().vnpTxnRef!,
        vnp_Amount: '9800000',
        vnp_ResponseCode: '00',
        vnp_TransactionStatus: '00',
      },
    });
    findByTxnRef.mockResolvedValue(payment());
    conditionalFinalize.mockResolvedValue({ count: 0 });
    await expect(service.handleIpn({})).resolves.toEqual({
      RspCode: '02',
      Message: 'Order already confirmed',
    });
    expect(applyPaymentResult).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

  it('rejects a mismatched amount and converts transaction failures to 99', async () => {
    verifyCallback.mockReturnValue({
      valid: true,
      params: {
        vnp_TmnCode: 'BREWTEST',
        vnp_TxnRef: payment().vnpTxnRef!,
        vnp_Amount: '1',
        vnp_ResponseCode: '00',
        vnp_TransactionStatus: '00',
      },
    });
    findByTxnRef.mockResolvedValue(payment());
    await expect(service.handleIpn({})).resolves.toEqual({
      RspCode: '04',
      Message: 'Invalid amount',
    });

    verifyCallback.mockReturnValue({
      valid: true,
      params: {
        vnp_TmnCode: 'BREWTEST',
        vnp_TxnRef: payment().vnpTxnRef!,
        vnp_Amount: '9800000',
        vnp_ResponseCode: '00',
        vnp_TransactionStatus: '00',
      },
    });
    applyPaymentResult.mockRejectedValue(new ConflictException('race'));
    await expect(service.handleIpn({})).resolves.toEqual({
      RspCode: '99',
      Message: 'Unknown error',
    });
  });

  it('return verifies reference and amount, redirects, and never finalizes', async () => {
    verifyCallback.mockReturnValue({
      valid: true,
      params: {
        vnp_TmnCode: 'BREWTEST',
        vnp_TxnRef: payment().vnpTxnRef!,
        vnp_Amount: '9800000',
        vnp_ResponseCode: '00',
        vnp_TransactionStatus: '00',
      },
    });
    findByTxnRef.mockResolvedValue(payment());
    await expect(service.handleReturn({})).resolves.toBe(
      `https://shop.test/payment/${orderId}/verifying`,
    );
    expect(conditionalFinalize).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(applyPaymentResult).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    verifyCallback.mockReturnValue({
      valid: true,
      params: {
        vnp_TmnCode: 'BREWTEST',
        vnp_TxnRef: payment().vnpTxnRef!,
        vnp_Amount: '9800000',
        vnp_ResponseCode: '24',
        vnp_TransactionStatus: '02',
      },
    });
    await expect(service.handleReturn({})).resolves.toBe(
      `https://shop.test/payment/${orderId}/unknown`,
    );
    expect(conditionalFinalize).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(applyPaymentResult).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    verifyCallback.mockReturnValue({ valid: false, params: {} });
    await expect(service.handleReturn({})).resolves.toBe(
      'https://shop.test/payment/error',
    );
  });

  it('reconciles a signed successful QueryDR result atomically', async () => {
    findByTxnRef
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(payment())
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(payment('PAID'));

    await expect(service.reconcile(userId, orderId)).resolves.toMatchObject({
      id: paymentId,
      status: 'PAID',
    });
    expect(queryTransaction).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      txnRef: payment().vnpTxnRef,
      transactionDate: '20261021100000',
      orderInfo:
        'Thanh toan don hang 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef',
    });
    expect(conditionalFinalize).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      tx,
      expect.objectContaining({
        id: paymentId,
        status: 'PAID',
        transactionNo: '12345',
        bankCode: 'NCB',
      }),
    );
    expect(applyPaymentResult).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      { orderId, userId, method: 'VNPAY_QR', status: 'PAID' },
      tx,
    );
  });

  it('does not mutate on QueryDR throttling or a non-final status', async () => {
    queryTransaction.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      valid: true,
      params: { vnp_ResponseCode: '94' },
    });
    await expect(service.reconcile(userId, orderId)).resolves.toMatchObject({
      status: 'PROCESSING',
    });

    for (const transactionStatus of ['01', '04', '07', '10', '20']) {
      queryTransaction.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        valid: true,
        params: {
          vnp_Command: 'querydr',
          vnp_ResponseCode: '00',
          vnp_TmnCode: 'BREWTEST',
          vnp_TxnRef: payment().vnpTxnRef!,
          vnp_Amount: '9800000',
          vnp_TransactionType: '01',
          vnp_TransactionStatus: transactionStatus,
        },
      });
      await expect(service.reconcile(userId, orderId)).resolves.toMatchObject({
        status: 'PROCESSING',
      });
    }
    expect(conditionalFinalize).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(applyPaymentResult).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('finalizes an expired or cancelled signed QueryDR transaction as failed', async () => {
    queryTransaction.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      valid: true,
      params: {
        vnp_Command: 'querydr',
        vnp_ResponseCode: '00',
        vnp_TmnCode: 'BREWTEST',
        vnp_TxnRef: payment().vnpTxnRef!,
        vnp_Amount: '9800000',
        vnp_TransactionType: '01',
        vnp_TransactionStatus: '11',
      },
    });
    findByTxnRef
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(payment())
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(payment('PAYMENT_FAILED'));

    await expect(service.reconcile(userId, orderId)).resolves.toMatchObject({
      status: 'PAYMENT_FAILED',
    });
    expect(conditionalFinalize).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      tx,
      expect.objectContaining({ status: 'PAYMENT_FAILED' }),
    );
    expect(applyPaymentResult).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ status: 'PAYMENT_FAILED' }),
      tx,
    );
  });

  it('rejects a tampered or mismatched QueryDR result without mutation', async () => {
    queryTransaction.mockResolvedValueOnce({ valid: false, params: {} });
    await expect(service.reconcile(userId, orderId)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 503,
    });

    queryTransaction.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      valid: true,
      params: {
        vnp_Command: 'querydr',
        vnp_ResponseCode: '00',
        vnp_TmnCode: 'BREWTEST',
        vnp_TxnRef: payment().vnpTxnRef!,
        vnp_Amount: '1',
        vnp_TransactionType: '01',
        vnp_TransactionStatus: '00',
      },
    });
    await expect(service.reconcile(userId, orderId)).rejects.toMatchObject({
      status: 503,
    });
    expect(conditionalFinalize).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(applyPaymentResult).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
````

<!-- snapshot-file {"path": "backend/src/payments/payments.service.ts", "encoding": "utf-8", "bytes": 13959, "characters": 13773, "sha256": "af33005be88b2e68ed09b459ae295a6cbd5b3656d73e6990b43edf8e4e36bcd1"} -->

````text
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import {
  ConflictException,
  Inject,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  ServiceUnavailableException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Payment, Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { CreatePaymentDto } from './dto/create-payment.dto';
import {
  PAYMENT_GATEWAY,
  PAYMENT_ORDER_PORT,
  type PaymentFinalStatus,
  type PaymentGateway,
  type PaymentOrderPort,
  type VnpayIpnResponse,
  type VnpayQuery,
} from './payment.types';
import { PaymentsRepository } from './payments.repository';

const IPN_RESPONSE = {
  success: { RspCode: '00', Message: 'Confirm Success' },
  notFound: { RspCode: '01', Message: 'Order not found' },
  confirmed: { RspCode: '02', Message: 'Order already confirmed' },
  invalidAmount: { RspCode: '04', Message: 'Invalid amount' },
  invalidChecksum: { RspCode: '97', Message: 'Invalid checksum' },
  error: { RspCode: '99', Message: 'Unknown error' },
} as const satisfies Record<string, VnpayIpnResponse>;

// The public PAY/QueryDR contract defines only 00 as payment success. Later
// lifecycle codes such as delivered/settled stay manual-review here rather
// than being allowed to fulfil an order from an unexpected callback.
const PAID_TRANSACTION_STATUSES = new Set(['00']);
const FAILED_TRANSACTION_STATUSES = new Set(['02', '08', '11']);
const CLEAR_IPN_FAILURE_RESPONSE_CODES = new Set([
  '09',
  '10',
  '11',
  '12',
  '13',
  '24',
  '51',
  '65',
  '75',
  '79',
]);

/**
 * VNPAY has non-terminal/manual-review states (for example reversal and
 * suspected fraud). They must remain PROCESSING so the customer cannot start
 * a second charge while the first debit may still exist.
 */
function classifyFinalStatus(
  params: Readonly<Record<string, string>>,
  source: 'ipn' | 'querydr',
): PaymentFinalStatus | null {
  const responseCode = params.vnp_ResponseCode;
  const transactionStatus = params.vnp_TransactionStatus;

  if (
    responseCode === '00' &&
    transactionStatus &&
    PAID_TRANSACTION_STATUSES.has(transactionStatus)
  ) {
    return 'PAID';
  }

  if (!transactionStatus || !FAILED_TRANSACTION_STATUSES.has(transactionStatus)) {
    return null;
  }

  // QueryDR's response code describes whether the query itself succeeded;
  // the signed transaction status carries the payment result.
  if (source === 'querydr') return 'PAYMENT_FAILED';

  // 08 (expired) and 11 (cancelled) are explicit terminal transaction states.
  if (transactionStatus === '08' || transactionStatus === '11') {
    return 'PAYMENT_FAILED';
  }

  // Status 02 is only safe to retry when the detailed IPN response is a
  // documented, unambiguous payment failure. In particular, response 07
  // means the customer may already have been debited and needs manual review.
  return CLEAR_IPN_FAILURE_RESPONSE_CODES.has(responseCode)
    ? 'PAYMENT_FAILED'
    : null;
}

@Injectable()
export class PaymentsService {
  constructor(
    private readonly payments: PaymentsRepository,
    @Inject(PAYMENT_ORDER_PORT) private readonly orders: PaymentOrderPort,
    @Inject(PAYMENT_GATEWAY) private readonly gateway: PaymentGateway,
  ) {}

  async pay(userId: string, input: CreatePaymentDto, ipAddress: string) {
    try {
      const payment = await this.payments.transaction(async (tx) => {
        const existing = await this.payments.findByKey(
          userId,
          input.idempotencyKey,
          tx,
        );
        if (existing) return this.assertReplay(existing, input);

        let order = await this.orders.findOwned(input.orderId, userId, tx);
        if (!order) throw new NotFoundException('Không tìm thấy đơn hàng');
        if (!['PENDING', 'PAYMENT_FAILED'].includes(order.status)) {
          throw new ConflictException('Đơn hàng không thể thanh toán');
        }

        // Retry inventory must be reserved before a usable VNPAY URL exists.
        // The transition and Payment insert share this transaction, so any
        // configuration/signing/uniqueness failure rolls the reservation back.
        if (order.status === 'PAYMENT_FAILED') {
          order = await this.orders.prepareRetry(order.id, userId, tx);
        }

        const vnpTxnRef = randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
        const session = this.gateway.createPaymentUrl({
          txnRef: vnpTxnRef,
          orderId: order.id,
          amount: order.total,
          ipAddress,
        });
        return this.payments.create(tx, {
          userId,
          orderId: order.id,
          amount: order.total,
          method: input.method,
          idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey,
          vnpTxnRef,
          paymentUrl: session.paymentUrl,
          expiresAt: session.expiresAt,
        });
      });
      return this.toResponse(payment);
    } catch (error) {
      const uniqueViolation = this.payments.isUniqueViolation(error);
      const idempotencyRace =
        uniqueViolation || error instanceof ConflictException;
      if (!idempotencyRace) throw error;

      // A concurrent request may have committed the same idempotency key.
      // Retry races can lose the Order CAS before reaching Payment.create,
      // so ConflictException is also checked for an idempotent winner.
      const existing = await this.payments.findByKey(
        userId,
        input.idempotencyKey,
      );
      if (existing) return this.toResponse(this.assertReplay(existing, input));
      if (uniqueViolation) {
        throw new ConflictException(
          'Đơn hàng đã có một giao dịch đang xử lý hoặc đã thanh toán',
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async handleIpn(query: VnpayQuery): Promise<VnpayIpnResponse> {
    let verification;
    try {
      verification = this.gateway.verifyCallback(query);
    } catch {
      return IPN_RESPONSE.error;
    }
    if (!verification.valid) return IPN_RESPONSE.invalidChecksum;
    const params = verification.params;
    try {
      if (!this.gateway.isExpectedMerchant(params.vnp_TmnCode)) {
        return IPN_RESPONSE.error;
      }
    } catch {
      return IPN_RESPONSE.error;
    }
    if (
      !/^[0-9]{2}$/.test(params.vnp_ResponseCode ?? '') ||
      !/^[0-9]{2}$/.test(params.vnp_TransactionStatus ?? '')
    ) {
      return IPN_RESPONSE.error;
    }

    const txnRef = params.vnp_TxnRef;
    if (!txnRef) return IPN_RESPONSE.notFound;

    try {
      return await this.payments.transaction(async (tx) => {
        const payment = await this.payments.findByTxnRef(txnRef, tx);
        if (!payment || payment.method !== 'VNPAY_QR') {
          return IPN_RESPONSE.notFound;
        }
        if (!this.hasExpectedAmount(params.vnp_Amount, payment.amount)) {
          return IPN_RESPONSE.invalidAmount;
        }
        if (payment.status !== 'PROCESSING') return IPN_RESPONSE.confirmed;

        const status = classifyFinalStatus(params, 'ipn');
        if (!status) return IPN_RESPONSE.error;
        return (await this.finalizeInTransaction(tx, payment, status, params))
          ? IPN_RESPONSE.success
          : IPN_RESPONSE.confirmed;
      });
    } catch {
      return IPN_RESPONSE.error;
    }
  }

  async reconcile(userId: string, orderId: string) {
    const order = await this.orders.findOwned(orderId, userId);
    if (!order) throw new NotFoundException('KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y Ä‘Æ¡n hÃ ng');

    const payment = await this.payments.findLatestForOwnedOrder(
      orderId,
      userId,
    );
    if (!payment || payment.method !== 'VNPAY_QR') {
      throw new NotFoundException('KhÃ´ng tÃ¬m tháº¥y giao dá»‹ch VNPAY');
    }
    if (payment.status !== 'PROCESSING') return this.toResponse(payment);
    if (!payment.vnpTxnRef || !payment.paymentUrl) {
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
        'Giao dá»‹ch VNPAY thiáº¿u dá»¯ liá»‡u Ä‘á»ƒ Ä‘á»‘i soÃ¡t',
      );
    }

    const paymentUrl = this.paymentUrlForQuery(payment);
    const verification = await this.gateway.queryTransaction({
      txnRef: payment.vnpTxnRef,
      transactionDate: paymentUrl.transactionDate,
      orderInfo: paymentUrl.orderInfo,
    });
    if (!verification.valid) {
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
        'Chá»¯ kÃ½ pháº£n há»“i truy váº¥n VNPAY khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡',
      );
    }

    const params = verification.params;
    if (params.vnp_ResponseCode !== '00') {
      // QueryDR can answer 91/94 while VNPAY is still synchronizing or
      // throttling repeated requests. A signed query error never finalizes an
      // Order; IPN or a later reconciliation remains authoritative.
      return this.toResponse(payment);
    }
    if (
      params.vnp_Command !== 'querydr' ||
      !this.gateway.isExpectedMerchant(params.vnp_TmnCode) ||
      params.vnp_TxnRef !== payment.vnpTxnRef ||
      !this.hasExpectedAmount(params.vnp_Amount, payment.amount) ||
      params.vnp_TransactionType !== '01' ||
      !/^[0-9]{2}$/.test(params.vnp_TransactionStatus ?? '')
    ) {
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
        'Pháº£n há»“i truy váº¥n VNPAY khÃ´ng khá»›p giao dá»‹ch',
      );
    }

    const status = classifyFinalStatus(params, 'querydr');
    if (!status) return this.toResponse(payment);

    await this.payments.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const current = await this.payments.findByTxnRef(
        payment.vnpTxnRef!,
        tx,
      );
      if (
        !current ||
        current.orderId !== orderId ||
        current.userId !== userId ||
        current.method !== 'VNPAY_QR' ||
        current.status !== 'PROCESSING'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      await this.finalizeInTransaction(tx, current, status, params);
    });

    const reconciled = await this.payments.findByTxnRef(payment.vnpTxnRef);
    if (!reconciled) {
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
        'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ Ä‘á»c káº¿t quáº£ Ä‘á»‘i soÃ¡t VNPAY',
      );
    }
    return this.toResponse(reconciled);
  }

  async handleReturn(query: VnpayQuery): Promise<string> {
    const errorRedirect = () => this.gateway.frontendRedirect('/payment/error');
    try {
      const verification = this.gateway.verifyCallback(query);
      if (!verification.valid) return errorRedirect();
      const params = verification.params;
      if (!this.gateway.isExpectedMerchant(params.vnp_TmnCode)) {
        return errorRedirect();
      }
      const payment = params.vnp_TxnRef
        ? await this.payments.findByTxnRef(params.vnp_TxnRef)
        : null;
      if (
        !payment ||
        payment.method !== 'VNPAY_QR' ||
        !this.hasExpectedAmount(params.vnp_Amount, payment.amount)
      ) {
        return errorRedirect();
      }
      const stage =
        params.vnp_ResponseCode === '00' &&
        params.vnp_TransactionStatus === '00'
          ? 'verifying'
          : 'unknown';
      return this.gateway.frontendRedirect(
        `/payment/${encodeURIComponent(payment.orderId)}/${stage}`,
      );
    } catch {
      return errorRedirect();
    }
  }

  private hasExpectedAmount(value: string | undefined, amount: number) {
    return (
      typeof value === 'string' &&
      /^[0-9]{1,12}$/.test(value) &&
      Number(value) === amount * 100
    );
  }

  private paymentUrlForQuery(payment: Payment) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(payment.paymentUrl ?? '');
      const transactionDate = url.searchParams.get('vnp_CreateDate') ?? '';
      const orderInfo = url.searchParams.get('vnp_OrderInfo') ?? '';
      if (
        url.protocol !== 'https:' ||
        url.searchParams.get('vnp_TxnRef') !== payment.vnpTxnRef ||
        !/^\d{14}$/.test(transactionDate) ||
        !orderInfo ||
        orderInfo.length > 255
      ) {
        throw new Error();
      }
      return { transactionDate, orderInfo };
    } catch {
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
        'URL giao dá»‹ch VNPAY khÃ´ng thá»ƒ Ä‘á»‘i soÃ¡t',
      );
    }
  }

  private async finalizeInTransaction(
    tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
    payment: Payment,
    status: PaymentFinalStatus,
    params: Readonly<Record<string, string>>,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const finalized = await this.payments.conditionalFinalize(tx, {
      id: payment.id,
      status,
      responseCode: params.vnp_ResponseCode,
      transactionStatus: params.vnp_TransactionStatus,
      transactionNo: params.vnp_TransactionNo,
      bankCode: params.vnp_BankCode,
      cardType: params.vnp_CardType,
      payDate: params.vnp_PayDate,
      processedAt: new Date(),
    });
    if (finalized.count !== 1) return false;

    await this.orders.applyPaymentResult(
      {
        orderId: payment.orderId,
        userId: payment.userId,
        method: payment.method,
        status,
      },
      tx,
    );
    return true;
  }

  private assertReplay(payment: Payment, input: CreatePaymentDto): Payment {
    if (payment.orderId !== input.orderId || payment.method !== input.method) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        'Idempotency key đã được dùng cho yêu cầu khác',
      );
    }
    return payment;
  }

  private toResponse(payment: Payment) {
    return {
      id: payment.id,
      orderId: payment.orderId,
      method: payment.method,
      status: payment.status,
      idempotencyKey: payment.idempotencyKey,
      ...(payment.paymentUrl ? { paymentUrl: payment.paymentUrl } : {}),
      ...(payment.expiresAt
        ? { expiresAt: payment.expiresAt.toISOString() }
        : {}),
    };
  }
}
````

````text
import { createHmac } from 'node:crypto';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it, jest } from '@jest/globals';
import {
  formEncode,
  formatVnpayDate,
  VnpayGateway,
} from './vnpay.gateway';

describe('VnpayGateway WebPay 2.1.0', () => {
  const saved = Object.fromEntries(
    [
      'VNPAY_TMN_CODE',
      'VNPAY_HASH_SECRET',
      'VNPAY_PAYMENT_URL',
      'VNPAY_QUERY_URL',
      'VNPAY_QUERY_IP_ADDRESS',
      'VNPAY_RETURN_URL',
      'VNPAY_BANK_CODE',
      'VNPAY_EXPIRE_MINUTES',
      'FRONTEND_PUBLIC_URL',
    ].map((key) => [key, process.env[key]]),
  );
  const secret = 'test-secret-that-never-leaves-the-backend';
  const gateway = new VnpayGateway();

  beforeAll(() => {
    process.env.VNPAY_TMN_CODE = 'BREWTEST';
    process.env.VNPAY_HASH_SECRET = secret;
    process.env.VNPAY_PAYMENT_URL =
      'https://sandbox.vnpayment.vn/paymentv2/vpcpay.html';
    process.env.VNPAY_QUERY_URL =
      'https://sandbox.vnpayment.vn/merchant_webapi/api/transaction';
    process.env.VNPAY_QUERY_IP_ADDRESS = '127.0.0.1';
    process.env.VNPAY_RETURN_URL =
      'https://api.example.test/api/payments/vnpay/return';
    delete process.env.VNPAY_BANK_CODE;
    process.env.VNPAY_EXPIRE_MINUTES = '15';
    process.env.FRONTEND_PUBLIC_URL = 'https://coffee.example.test';
  });

  afterAll(() => {
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(saved)) {
      if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
      else process.env[key] = value;
    }
  });

  it('uses form encoding and formats all dates in GMT+7', () => {
    expect(
      formEncode({
        vnp_ReturnUrl: 'https://merchant.test/return?a=one two',
        vnp_OrderInfo: "Thanh toan: #1 ~!'()*",
      }),
    ).toBe(
      "vnp_OrderInfo=Thanh+toan%3A+%231+~!'()*&vnp_ReturnUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fmerchant.test%2Freturn%3Fa%3Done+two",
    );
    expect(formatVnpayDate(new Date('2026-10-21T17:30:05.000Z'))).toBe(
      '20261022003005',
    );
  });

  it('builds a signed WebPay 2.1.0 URL with amount multiplied by 100', () => {
    const result = gateway.createPaymentUrl({
      txnRef: '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef',
      orderId: '21a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001',
      amount: 98000,
      ipAddress: '203.0.113.8',
      now: new Date('2026-10-21T03:00:00.000Z'),
    });
    expect(result.expiresAt.toISOString()).toBe('2026-10-21T03:15:00.000Z');
    const url = new URL(result.paymentUrl);
    expect(url.origin + url.pathname).toBe(
      'https://sandbox.vnpayment.vn/paymentv2/vpcpay.html',
    );
    expect(Object.fromEntries(url.searchParams)).toMatchObject({
      vnp_Version: '2.1.0',
      vnp_Command: 'pay',
      vnp_TmnCode: 'BREWTEST',
      vnp_Amount: '9800000',
      vnp_CurrCode: 'VND',
      vnp_CreateDate: '20261021100000',
      vnp_ExpireDate: '20261021101500',
      vnp_OrderInfo:
        'Thanh toan don hang 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef',
      vnp_ReturnUrl:
        'https://api.example.test/api/payments/vnpay/return',
      vnp_TxnRef: '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef',
    });
    expect(url.searchParams.has('vnp_BankCode')).toBe(false);
    expect(url.searchParams.has('vnp_SecureHashType')).toBe(false);

    const unsigned = Object.fromEntries(
      [...url.searchParams.entries()].filter(
        ([key]) => key !== 'vnp_SecureHash',
      ),
    );
    const expected = createHmac('sha512', secret)
      .update(formEncode(unsigned), 'utf8')
      .digest('hex');
    expect(url.searchParams.get('vnp_SecureHash')).toBe(expected);
  });

  it('uses an explicitly configured VNPAY payment channel', () => {
    process.env.VNPAY_BANK_CODE = 'VNPAYQR';
    const result = gateway.createPaymentUrl({
      txnRef: '1123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef',
      orderId: '21a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001',
      amount: 98000,
      ipAddress: '203.0.113.8',
      now: new Date('2026-10-21T03:00:00.000Z'),
    });
    expect(new URL(result.paymentUrl).searchParams.get('vnp_BankCode')).toBe(
      'VNPAYQR',
    );
    delete process.env.VNPAY_BANK_CODE;
  });

  it('rejects an invalid configured payment channel', () => {
    process.env.VNPAY_BANK_CODE = 'QR!';
    expect(() =>
      gateway.createPaymentUrl({
        txnRef: '2123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef',
        orderId: '21a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001',
        amount: 98000,
        ipAddress: '203.0.113.8',
      }),
    ).toThrow('VNPAY_BANK_CODE');
    delete process.env.VNPAY_BANK_CODE;
  });

  it('verifies signed callback fields and rejects tampering or duplicate values', () => {
    const params = {
      vnp_Amount: '9800000',
      vnp_ResponseCode: '00',
      vnp_TmnCode: 'BREWTEST',
      vnp_TransactionStatus: '00',
      vnp_TxnRef: '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef',
    };
    const vnp_SecureHash = createHmac('sha512', secret)
      .update(formEncode(params), 'utf8')
      .digest('hex');
    expect(gateway.verifyCallback({ ...params, vnp_SecureHash })).toEqual({
      valid: true,
      params,
    });
    expect(
      gateway.verifyCallback({
        ...params,
        vnp_Amount: '1',
        vnp_SecureHash,
      }).valid,
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      gateway.verifyCallback({
        ...params,
        vnp_TxnRef: [params.vnp_TxnRef, 'duplicate'],
        vnp_SecureHash,
      }).valid,
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it('always builds redirects from the configured frontend URL', () => {
    process.env.FRONTEND_PUBLIC_URL =
      'https://coffee.example.test/ignored?redirect=https://evil.test';
    expect(gateway.frontendRedirect('/payment/order-id/verifying')).toBe(
      'https://coffee.example.test/payment/order-id/verifying',
    );
  });

  it('queries VNPAY with the documented pipe checksum and verifies its response', async () => {
    const responseParams = {
      vnp_ResponseId: 'response-id',
      vnp_Command: 'querydr',
      vnp_ResponseCode: '00',
      vnp_Message: 'Success',
      vnp_TmnCode: 'BREWTEST',
      vnp_TxnRef: '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef',
      vnp_Amount: '9800000',
      vnp_BankCode: 'NCB',
      vnp_PayDate: '20261021100100',
      vnp_TransactionNo: '12345',
      vnp_TransactionType: '01',
      vnp_TransactionStatus: '00',
      vnp_OrderInfo: 'Thanh toan don hang',
    };
    const responseData = [
      responseParams.vnp_ResponseId,
      responseParams.vnp_Command,
      responseParams.vnp_ResponseCode,
      responseParams.vnp_Message,
      responseParams.vnp_TmnCode,
      responseParams.vnp_TxnRef,
      responseParams.vnp_Amount,
      responseParams.vnp_BankCode,
      responseParams.vnp_PayDate,
      responseParams.vnp_TransactionNo,
      responseParams.vnp_TransactionType,
      responseParams.vnp_TransactionStatus,
      responseParams.vnp_OrderInfo,
      '',
      '',
    ].join('|');
    const vnp_SecureHash = createHmac('sha512', secret)
      .update(responseData, 'utf8')
      .digest('hex');
    const originalFetch = global.fetch;
    const fetchMock = jest.fn(async () =>
      Promise.resolve(
        new Response(JSON.stringify({ ...responseParams, vnp_SecureHash }), {
          status: 200,
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        }),
      ),
    );
    global.fetch = fetchMock as typeof fetch;

    try {
      await expect(
        gateway.queryTransaction({
          txnRef: responseParams.vnp_TxnRef,
          transactionDate: '20261021100000',
          orderInfo: 'Truy van giao dich',
          now: new Date('2026-10-21T03:05:00.000Z'),
        }),
      ).resolves.toEqual({ valid: true, params: responseParams });

      const [url, init] = fetchMock.mock.calls[0];
      expect(url).toBe(
        'https://sandbox.vnpayment.vn/merchant_webapi/api/transaction',
      );
      const body = JSON.parse(String(init?.body)) as Record<string, string>;
      expect(body).toMatchObject({
        vnp_Version: '2.1.0',

        vnp_TxnRef: responseParams.vnp_TxnRef,
        vnp_TransactionDate: '20261021100000',
        vnp_CreateDate: '20261021100500',
        vnp_IpAddr: '127.0.0.1',
        vnp_OrderInfo: 'Truy van giao dich',
      });
      const requestData = [
        body.vnp_RequestId,
        body.vnp_Version,
        body.vnp_Command,
        body.vnp_TmnCode,
        body.vnp_TxnRef,
        body.vnp_TransactionDate,
        body.vnp_CreateDate,
        body.vnp_IpAddr,
        body.vnp_OrderInfo,
      ].join('|');
      expect(body.vnp_SecureHash).toBe(
        createHmac('sha512', secret)
          .update(requestData, 'utf8')
          .digest('hex'),
      );
    } finally {
      global.fetch = originalFetch;
    }
  });

  it('rejects a tampered QueryDR response signature', async () => {
    const originalFetch = global.fetch;
    global.fetch = jest.fn(async () =>
      Promise.resolve(
        new Response(
          JSON.stringify({
            vnp_ResponseId: 'response-id',
            vnp_Command: 'querydr',
            vnp_ResponseCode: '00',
            vnp_Message: 'Success',
            vnp_TmnCode: 'BREWTEST',
            vnp_TxnRef: '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef',
            vnp_Amount: '1',
            vnp_BankCode: 'NCB',
            vnp_PayDate: '20261021100100',
            vnp_TransactionNo: '12345',
            vnp_TransactionType: '01',
            vnp_TransactionStatus: '00',
            vnp_OrderInfo: 'Thanh toan don hang',
            vnp_SecureHash: 'a'.repeat(128),
          }),
          { status: 200 },
        ),
      ),
    ) as typeof fetch;
    try {

        gateway.queryTransaction({
          txnRef: '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef',
          transactionDate: '20261021100000',
          orderInfo: 'Truy van giao dich',
        }),
      ).resolves.toMatchObject({ valid: false });
    } finally {
      global.fetch = originalFetch;
    }
  });

  it('refuses a non-HTTPS VNPAY payment endpoint', () => {
    process.env.VNPAY_PAYMENT_URL = 'http://sandbox.vnpayment.vn/pay';
    expect(() =>
````

## backend/src/payments/vnpay.gateway.ts

<!-- snapshot-file {"path": "backend/src/payments/vnpay.gateway.ts", "encoding": "utf-8", "bytes": 10740, "characters": 10577, "sha256": "b5ac15cb47ea7ca65e7c723b714746ae2f5914007764f29268d4bcb66d627986"} -->
````text
import { createHmac, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
import { Injectable, ServiceUnavailableException } from '@nestjs/common';
import type {
  PaymentGateway,
  VnpayQuery,
  VnpayVerification,
} from './payment.types';

const GMT7_OFFSET_MS = 7 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
const DEFAULT_EXPIRE_MINUTES = 15;
const QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;
const QUERY_RESPONSE_FIELDS = [
  'vnp_ResponseId',
  'vnp_Command',
  'vnp_ResponseCode',
  'vnp_Message',
  'vnp_TmnCode',
  'vnp_TxnRef',
  'vnp_Amount',
  'vnp_BankCode',
  'vnp_PayDate',
  'vnp_TransactionNo',
  'vnp_TransactionType',
  'vnp_TransactionStatus',
  'vnp_OrderInfo',
  'vnp_PromotionCode',
  'vnp_PromotionAmount',
] as const;

function required(name: string): string {
  const value = process.env[name]?.trim();
  if (!value) {
    throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
      `Cấu hình thanh toán ${name} chưa sẵn sàng`,
    );
  }
  return value;
}

function absoluteHttpUrl(
  name: string,
  fallback?: string,
  httpsOnly = false,
): string {
  const value = process.env[name]?.trim() || fallback;
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(value ?? '');
    if (
      !['http:', 'https:'].includes(parsed.protocol) ||
      (httpsOnly && parsed.protocol !== 'https:') ||
      parsed.username ||
      parsed.password
    ) {
      throw new Error();
    }
    return parsed.toString();
  } catch {
    throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
      `Cấu hình thanh toán ${name} không hợp lệ`,
    );
  }
}

function pad(value: number) {
  return String(value).padStart(2, '0');
}

/** VNPAY dates use fixed GMT+7 and yyyyMMddHHmmss, without a timezone suffix. */
export function formatVnpayDate(value: Date): string {
  const shifted = new Date(value.getTime() + GMT7_OFFSET_MS);
  return [
    shifted.getUTCFullYear(),
    pad(shifted.getUTCMonth() + 1),
    pad(shifted.getUTCDate()),
    pad(shifted.getUTCHours()),
    pad(shifted.getUTCMinutes()),
    pad(shifted.getUTCSeconds()),
  ].join('');
}

/** application/x-www-form-urlencoded encoding is also the signed representation. */
export function formEncode(params: Readonly<Record<string, string>>): string {
  const encode = (value: string) =>
    encodeURIComponent(value).replace(/%20/g, '+');
  return Object.keys(params)
    .sort()
    .map((key) => `${encode(key)}=${encode(params[key])}`)
    .join('&');
}

function callbackParams(query: VnpayQuery): {
  validShape: boolean;
  params: Record<string, string>;
} {
  const params: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(query)) {
    if (!key.startsWith('vnp_')) continue;
    if (typeof value !== 'string') return { validShape: false, params };
    params[key] = value;
  }
  return { validShape: true, params };
}

function expireMinutes(): number {
  const raw = process.env.VNPAY_EXPIRE_MINUTES?.trim();
  if (!raw) return DEFAULT_EXPIRE_MINUTES;
  const value = Number(raw);
  if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value < 1 || value > 1440) {
    throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
      'Cấu hình thanh toán VNPAY_EXPIRE_MINUTES không hợp lệ',
    );
  }
  return value;
}

function configuredTmnCode(): string {
  const value = required('VNPAY_TMN_CODE');
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9]{8}$/.test(value)) {
    throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
      'Cấu hình thanh toán VNPAY_TMN_CODE không hợp lệ',
    );
  }
  return value;
}

function configuredBankCode(): string | undefined {
  const value = process.env.VNPAY_BANK_CODE?.trim();
  if (!value) return undefined;
  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9]{3,20}$/.test(value)) {
    throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
      'Cáº¥u hÃ¬nh thanh toÃ¡n VNPAY_BANK_CODE khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡',
    );
  }
  return value;
}

function configuredQueryIpAddress(): string {
  const value = process.env.VNPAY_QUERY_IP_ADDRESS?.trim() || '127.0.0.1';
  if (!/^[0-9A-Fa-f:.]{7,45}$/.test(value)) {
    throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
      'Cáº¥u hÃ¬nh thanh toÃ¡n VNPAY_QUERY_IP_ADDRESS khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡',
    );
  }
  return value;
}

@Injectable()
export class VnpayGateway implements PaymentGateway {
  createPaymentUrl(input: {
    txnRef: string;
    orderId: string;
    amount: number;
    ipAddress: string;
    now?: Date;
  }) {
    if (
      !Number.isSafeInteger(input.amount) ||
      input.amount <= 0 ||
      !/^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,100}$/.test(input.txnRef)
    ) {
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
        'Không thể khởi tạo yêu cầu thanh toán VNPAY',
      );
    }

    const now = input.now ?? new Date();
    const expiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + expireMinutes() * 60_000);
    const amount = input.amount * 100;
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(amount) || String(amount).length > 12) {
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException('Số tiền thanh toán không hợp lệ');
    }

    const params: Record<string, string> = {
      vnp_Amount: String(amount),
      vnp_Command: 'pay',
      vnp_CreateDate: formatVnpayDate(now),
      vnp_CurrCode: 'VND',
      vnp_ExpireDate: formatVnpayDate(expiresAt),
      vnp_IpAddr: input.ipAddress || '127.0.0.1',
      vnp_Locale: 'vn',
      vnp_OrderInfo: `Thanh toan don hang ${input.txnRef}`,
      vnp_OrderType: '180000',
      vnp_ReturnUrl: absoluteHttpUrl('VNPAY_RETURN_URL'),
      vnp_TmnCode: configuredTmnCode(),
      vnp_TxnRef: input.txnRef,
      vnp_Version: '2.1.0',
    };
    const bankCode = configuredBankCode();
    if (bankCode) params.vnp_BankCode = bankCode;
    const signedData = formEncode(params);
    const secureHash = this.sign(signedData);
    const paymentUrl = absoluteHttpUrl(
      'VNPAY_PAYMENT_URL',
      undefined,
      true,
    );
    const separator = paymentUrl.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
    return {
      expiresAt,
      paymentUrl: `${paymentUrl}${separator}${signedData}&vnp_SecureHash=${secureHash}`,
    };
  }

  verifyCallback(query: VnpayQuery): VnpayVerification {
    const extracted = callbackParams(query);
    const secureHash = extracted.params.vnp_SecureHash;
    delete extracted.params.vnp_SecureHash;
    delete extracted.params.vnp_SecureHashType;
    if (
      !extracted.validShape ||
      !secureHash ||
      !/^[a-fA-F0-9]{128}$/.test(secureHash)
    ) {
      return { valid: false, params: extracted.params };
    }

    const expected = Buffer.from(this.sign(formEncode(extracted.params)), 'hex');
    const supplied = Buffer.from(secureHash, 'hex');
    return {
      valid:
        expected.length === supplied.length &&
        timingSafeEqual(expected, supplied),
      params: extracted.params,
    };
  }

  async queryTransaction(input: {
    txnRef: string;
    transactionDate: string;
    orderInfo: string;
    now?: Date;
  }): Promise<VnpayVerification> {
    if (
      !/^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,100}$/.test(input.txnRef) ||
      !/^\d{14}$/.test(input.transactionDate) ||
      !input.orderInfo ||
      input.orderInfo.length > 255
    ) {
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
        'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ truy váº¥n giao dá»‹ch VNPAY',
      );
    }

    const params: Record<string, string> = {
      vnp_RequestId: randomBytes(16).toString('hex'),
      vnp_Version: '2.1.0',
      vnp_Command: 'querydr',
      vnp_TmnCode: configuredTmnCode(),
      vnp_TxnRef: input.txnRef,
      vnp_TransactionDate: input.transactionDate,
      vnp_CreateDate: formatVnpayDate(input.now ?? new Date()),
      vnp_IpAddr: configuredQueryIpAddress(),
      vnp_OrderInfo: input.orderInfo,
    };
    const requestData = [
      params.vnp_RequestId,
      params.vnp_Version,
      params.vnp_Command,
      params.vnp_TmnCode,
      params.vnp_TxnRef,
      params.vnp_TransactionDate,
      params.vnp_CreateDate,
      params.vnp_IpAddr,
      params.vnp_OrderInfo,
    ].join('|');

    let response: Response;
    try {
      response = await fetch(
        absoluteHttpUrl('VNPAY_QUERY_URL', undefined, true),
        {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            ...params,
            vnp_SecureHash: this.sign(requestData),
          }),
          signal: AbortSignal.timeout(QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS),
        },
      );
    } catch {
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
        'KhÃ´ng thá»ƒ káº¿t ná»‘i API truy váº¥n VNPAY',
      );
    }
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
        'API truy váº¥n VNPAY khÃ´ng sáºµn sÃ ng',
      );
    }

    let body: unknown;
    try {
      body = await response.json();
    } catch {
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
        'Pháº£n há»“i truy váº¥n VNPAY khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡',
      );
    }
    if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body)) {
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
        'Pháº£n há»“i truy váº¥n VNPAY khÃ´ng há»£p lá»‡',
      );
    }

    const extracted = callbackParams(body as VnpayQuery);
    const secureHash = extracted.params.vnp_SecureHash;
    delete extracted.params.vnp_SecureHash;
    delete extracted.params.vnp_SecureHashType;
    if (
      !extracted.validShape ||
      !secureHash ||
      !/^[a-fA-F0-9]{128}$/.test(secureHash)
    ) {
      return { valid: false, params: extracted.params };
    }

    const responseData = QUERY_RESPONSE_FIELDS.map(
      (field) => extracted.params[field] ?? '',
    ).join('|');
    const expected = Buffer.from(this.sign(responseData), 'hex');
    const supplied = Buffer.from(secureHash, 'hex');
    return {
      valid:
        expected.length === supplied.length &&
        timingSafeEqual(expected, supplied),
      params: extracted.params,
    };
  }

  isExpectedMerchant(tmnCode: string | undefined): boolean {
    return Boolean(tmnCode) && tmnCode === configuredTmnCode();
  }

  frontendRedirect(path: string): string {
    const target = new URL(
      absoluteHttpUrl(
        'FRONTEND_PUBLIC_URL',
        process.env.FRONTEND_ORIGIN?.split(',')[0]?.trim() ||
          'http://localhost:3000',
      ),
    );
    target.pathname = path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`;
    target.search = '';
    target.hash = '';
    return target.toString();
  }

  private sign(data: string): string {
    return createHmac('sha512', required('VNPAY_HASH_SECRET'))
      .update(data, 'utf8')
      .digest('hex');
  }
}
````

````text
import { jest } from '@jest/globals';
import type { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import request from 'supertest';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import { ProductsModule } from './products.module';
import type { ProductDetailRecord } from './product-detail';
import { productDetailFixture } from '../../test/fixtures/product-detail';

// Real HTTP controller/UUID pipe/service/errors; only Prisma is mocked.
describe('Product detail HTTP', () => {
  let app: INestApplication;
  const findUnique = jest.fn<() => Promise<ProductDetailRecord | null>>();
  beforeAll(async () => {
    const module = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [ProductsModule] })
      .overrideProvider(PrismaService).useValue({ product: { findUnique } }).compile();
    app = module.createNestApplication({ logger: false });
    app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
    await app.init();
  });
  beforeEach(() => findUnique.mockReset());
  afterAll(async () => { await app?.close(); });

  it('returns the direct contract without auth, with integer extras and an owned default', async () => {
    const record = productDetailFixture();
    findUnique.mockResolvedValue(record);
    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/products/${record.id}`).expect(200).expect('Content-Type', /json/);
    expect(Object.keys(response.body).sort()).toEqual(['defaultSizeId', 'description', 'id', 'imageUrl', 'name', 'price', 'sizes', 'stock', 'toppings']);
    expect(response.body.price).toBe(29000);
    expect(response.body.sizes).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(response.body.defaultSizeId).toBe(record.sizes[1].id);
    expect(response.body.sizes.some((size: { id: string; available: boolean }) => size.id === response.body.defaultSizeId && size.available)).toBe(true);
    for (const size of response.body.sizes) {
      expect(Object.keys(size).sort()).toEqual(['available', 'code', 'extraPrice', 'id', 'name']);
      expect(Number.isInteger(size.extraPrice) && size.extraPrice >= 0).toBe(true);
    }
    expect(response.body.toppings).toEqual(record.toppings.map(({ topping, ...option }) => ({ ...topping, ...option })));
    expect(response.body.stock).toBe(record.stock);
  });

  it.each(['not-a-uuid', '123', '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-00000000000z'])('rejects malformed id before querying: %s', async (id) => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/products/${id}`).expect(400);
    expect(findUnique).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('accepts UUIDs written in uppercase', async () => {
    const record = productDetailFixture();
    findUnique.mockResolvedValue(record);
    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/products/${record.id.toUpperCase()}`).expect(200);
    expect(response.body.id).toBe(record.id);
  });

  it('returns 404 for a valid UUID with no product', async () => {
    findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);
    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/products/31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000999').expect(404);
    expect(response.body.message).toBe('Product not found');
  });

  it('returns generic 500 for query failures without a trace or connection details', async () => {
    findUnique.mockRejectedValue(new Error('postgresql://private-user:private-password@db.internal/catalog'));
    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/products/${productDetailFixture().id}`).expect(500);
    expect(response.body).toEqual({ statusCode: 500, message: 'Internal server error' });
    expect(response.body).not.toHaveProperty('stack');
    expect(JSON.stringify(response.body)).not.toMatch(/private-password|db\.internal/);
  });

  it('returns 500 for existing products without options instead of a fake detail or 404', async () => {
    findUnique.mockResolvedValue({ ...productDetailFixture(), sizes: [] });
    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/products/${productDetailFixture().id}`).expect(500);
    expect(response.body).toEqual({ statusCode: 500, message: 'Internal Server Error' });
````

````text
import { jest } from '@jest/globals';
import { InternalServerErrorException, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import { ProductsService } from './products.service';
import { productDetailSelect, type ProductDetailRecord } from './product-detail';
import { productDetailFixture } from '../../test/fixtures/product-detail';

describe('Product detail service', () => {
  const findUnique = jest.fn<() => Promise<ProductDetailRecord | null>>();
  let service: ProductsService;
  beforeEach(() => {
    findUnique.mockReset();
    service = new ProductsService({ product: { findUnique } } as unknown as PrismaService);
  });

  it('queries the requested UUID and projects detail with its own default and availability', async () => {
    const record = productDetailFixture();
    findUnique.mockResolvedValue(record);
    const detail = await service.findOne(record.id);
    expect(findUnique).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ where: { id: record.id }, select: productDetailSelect });
    expect(detail.defaultSizeId).toBe(record.sizes[1].id);
    expect(detail.sizes.map((size) => size.code)).toEqual(['S', 'M', 'L']);
    expect(detail.sizes[2].available).toBe(false);
    expect(detail.toppings[1]).toEqual({ ...record.toppings[1].topping, extraPrice: 6000, available: false });
    expect(detail.sizes[0]).not.toHaveProperty('isDefault');
  });

  it('allows no toppings and an empty description', async () => {
    const record = { ...productDetailFixture(), toppings: [], description: '' };
    findUnique.mockResolvedValue(record);
    await expect(service.findOne(record.id)).resolves.toMatchObject({ toppings: [], description: '' });
  });

  it('returns NotFound only when the product does not exist', async () => {
    findUnique.mockResolvedValue(null);
    await expect(service.findOne(productDetailFixture().id)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);
  });

  it('propagates a database error for generic Nest exception handling', async () => {
    const failure = new Error('Database connection failed');
    findUnique.mockRejectedValue(failure);
    await expect(service.findOne(productDetailFixture().id)).rejects.toBe(failure);
  });

  it.each(['missing-default', 'duplicate-default', 'unavailable-default', 'missing-size', 'negative-size', 'negative-topping'])('rejects invalid configuration: %s', async (scenario) => {
    const record = productDetailFixture();
    if (scenario === 'missing-default') record.sizes[1].isDefault = false;
    if (scenario === 'duplicate-default') record.sizes[0].isDefault = true;
    if (scenario === 'unavailable-default') record.sizes[1].available = false;
    if (scenario === 'missing-size') record.sizes.pop();
    if (scenario === 'negative-size') record.sizes[0].extraPrice = -1;
    if (scenario === 'negative-topping') record.toppings[0].extraPrice = -1;
    findUnique.mockResolvedValue(record);
    await expect(service.findOne(record.id)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(InternalServerErrorException);
  });
});
````

````text
import type { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';

export const productDetailSelect = {
  id: true,
  name: true,
  description: true,
  imageUrl: true,
  price: true,
  stock: true,
  sizes: {

  },

  sizes: Omit<ProductDetailRecord['sizes'][number], 'isDefault'>[];
  toppings: { id: string; name: string; extraPrice: number; available: boolean }[];
  defaultSizeId: string;
};
````

````text
import { jest } from '@jest/globals';
import type { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import request from 'supertest';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import { ProductsModule } from './products.module';
import type { ProductListItem } from './products.service';

// Exercises real Nest routing and exception handling with a mocked database.
// This suite does not measure database or production API performance.
describe('Products HTTP contract', () => {
  let app: INestApplication;
  const findMany = jest.fn<() => Promise<ProductListItem[]>>();
  const findUnique = jest.fn<() => Promise<null>>();
  const product = {
    id: '31a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001',
    name: 'Bạc xỉu',
    price: 29000,
    imageUrl: '/images/products/sample-milk-coffee.svg',
    stock: 40,
    description: 'Cà phê và sữa, phục vụ lạnh.',
  };

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const module = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [ProductsModule] })
      .overrideProvider(PrismaService)
      .useValue({ product: { findMany, findUnique } })
      .compile();

    app = module.createNestApplication({ logger: false });
    app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
    app.enableCors({ origin: ['http://localhost:3000', 'http://localhost:3001'] });
    await app.init();
  });

  beforeEach(() => {
    findMany.mockReset();
    findUnique.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(null);
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await app?.close();
  });

  it('returns HTTP 200 and the public array without authentication', async () => {
    findMany.mockResolvedValue([product]);

    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/products')
      .expect('Content-Type', /json/)
      .expect(200);

    expect(response.body).toEqual([product]);
    expect(Object.keys(response.body[0]).sort()).toEqual(['description', 'id', 'imageUrl', 'name', 'price', 'stock']);
    expect(Number.isInteger(response.body[0].price)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('returns HTTP 200 with [] for an empty database result', async () => {
    findMany.mockResolvedValue([]);
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/products').expect(200, []);
  });

  it('returns generic HTTP 500 without exposing database connection details', async () => {
    findMany.mockRejectedValue(new Error('postgresql://private-user:private-password@db.internal/catalog'));

    const response = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/api/products').expect(500);

    expect(response.body).toEqual({ statusCode: 500, message: 'Internal server error' });
    expect(JSON.stringify(response.body)).not.toContain('private-password');
    expect(JSON.stringify(response.body)).not.toContain('db.internal');
  });

  it('allows the configured local frontend origin to read the response', async () => {
    findMany.mockResolvedValue([product]);
    await request(app.getHttpServer())
      .get('/api/products')
      .set('Origin', 'http://localhost:3001')
      .expect('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', 'http://localhost:3001')
      .expect(200, [product]);
  });

  it('requires the existing /api prefix', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get('/products').expect(404);
    expect(findMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('returns 404 for an unknown detail without changing the list query', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(`/api/products/${product.id}`).expect(404);
    expect(findMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(findUnique).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('does not add a product creation endpoint', async () => {
    await request(app.getHttpServer()).post('/api/products').send(product).expect(404);
    expect(findMany).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
````

````text
import { Injectable, InternalServerErrorException, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Product } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma.service';
import { productDetailSelect, type ProductDetail } from './product-detail';

export type ProductListItem = Pick<Product, 'id' | 'name' | 'price' | 'imageUrl' | 'stock' | 'description'>;

@Injectable()
export class ProductsService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  findAll(): Promise<ProductListItem[]> {
    return this.prisma.product.findMany({
      select: { id: true, name: true, price: true, imageUrl: true, stock: true, description: true },
      orderBy: [{ name: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }],
    });
  }

  async findOne(id: string): Promise<ProductDetail> {
    const product = await this.prisma.product.findUnique({ where: { id }, select: productDetailSelect });
    if (!product) throw new NotFoundException('Product not found');

    const defaults = product.sizes.filter((size) => size.isDefault);
    if (
      product.sizes.length !== 3 || new Set(product.sizes.map((size) => size.code)).size !== 3 ||
      defaults.length !== 1 || !defaults[0].available ||
      product.sizes.some((size) => !Number.isInteger(size.extraPrice) || size.extraPrice < 0) ||
      product.toppings.some((option) => !Number.isInteger(option.extraPrice) || option.extraPrice < 0)
    ) {
      // Existing products without configuration are a server data error, never a fake 404/default.
      throw new InternalServerErrorException();
    }

    return {
      id: product.id,
      name: product.name,
      description: product.description,
      imageUrl: product.imageUrl,
      price: product.price,
      stock: product.stock,
      sizes: product.sizes.map((size) => ({
        id: size.id, code: size.code, name: size.name, extraPrice: size.extraPrice, available: size.available,
      })),
      toppings: product.toppings.map(({ topping, extraPrice, available }) => ({ ...topping, extraPrice, available })),
      defaultSizeId: defaults[0].id,
    };
  }
}

````
