````text
      ["pin", "Nguồn gốc nông trại", "Cầu Đất, Lâm Đồng — độ cao trên 1.500m cho vị chua thanh tự nhiên."],
      ["spark", "Hương vị chủ đạo", "Hương hạt dẻ, chocolate đen và hậu vị ngọt nhẹ kéo dài."],
      ["bulb", "Gợi ý thưởng thức", "Thưởng thức ngay để giữ trọn lớp crema và nhiệt độ lý tưởng."],
    ],
    scores: [["Độ đậm", 7.5], ["Độ béo ngọt", 6.5], ["Hương thơm", 9]],
  },
  default: {
    chips: [["leaf", "Nguyên liệu tươi"], ["cup", "Pha chế thủ công"], ["spark", "Thanh mát"]],
    cards: [
      ["beans", "Thành phần", "Nguyên liệu tuyển chọn trong ngày, pha chế thủ công theo công thức BrewLite."],
      ["pin", "Nguồn gốc", "Trà và trái cây từ các nhà vườn Việt Nam, kiểm soát chất lượng từng mẻ."],
      ["spark", "Hương vị chủ đạo", "Thanh mát, cân bằng giữa vị ngọt tự nhiên và hương thơm dịu."],
      ["bulb", "Gợi ý thưởng thức", "Dùng lạnh trong 30 phút đầu để cảm nhận rõ nhất các tầng hương."],

  },

export default function ProductPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  const { id } = use(params),
    router = useRouter(),
    add = useCart((s) => s.add),
    cartItems = useCart((s) => s.items);
  const [product, setProduct] = useState<Product | null>(null),
    [related, setRelated] = useState<Product[]>([]),
    [loading, setLoading] = useState(true),
    [error, setError] = useState(""),
    [size, setSize] = useState<ProductSize["code"]>("S"),
    [selected, setSelected] = useState<string[]>([]),
    [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1),
    [ice, setIce] = useState(ICE[0]),
    [sugar, setSugar] = useState(SUGAR[0]),
    [note, setNote] = useState(""),
    [liked, setLiked] = useState(false),
    [quickAdded, setQuickAdded] = useState("");
  const load = useCallback(() => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    services.products
      .get(id)
      .then((p) => {
        setProduct(p);
        setSize(p?.sizes.find((s) => s.isDefault)?.code || "S");
      })
      .catch((e) => setError(e.message))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [id]);
  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);
  useEffect(() => {
    services.products
      .list()
      .then((list) => setRelated(list.filter((p) => p.id !== id).slice(0, 4)))
      .catch(() => setRelated([]));
  }, [id]);
  const chosenSize = product?.sizes.find((s) => s.code === size);
  const chosenToppings = useMemo(
    () => product?.toppings.filter((t) => selected.includes(t.id)) || [],
    [product, selected],
  );
  const unit =
    (product?.price || 0) +
    (chosenSize?.extraPrice || 0) +
    chosenToppings.reduce((n, t) => n + t.extraPrice, 0);
  const invalid =
    !!product &&
    (!chosenSize?.available || chosenToppings.some((t) => !t.available));
  // Tồn kho tính trên tổng số phần của món này đã có trong giỏ (mọi cấu hình) cộng phần định thêm.
  const inCart = cartItems
    .filter((i) => i.productId === product?.id)
    .reduce((n, i) => n + i.quantity, 0);
  const overStock = !!product && inCart + quantity > product.stock;
  const blocked = !product || invalid || overStock;
  const story = stories[product?.category || ""] || stories.default;
  const submit = (next: "/cart" | "/checkout") => {
    if (!product || blocked) return;
    add({
      key: itemKey(product.id, size, selected, ice, sugar, note),
      productId: product.id,
      name: product.name,
      imageUrl: product.imageUrl,
      size,
      toppingIds: selected,
      toppingNames: chosenToppings.map((t) => t.name),
      unitPrice: unit,
      quantity,
      ice,
      sugar,
      note: note.trim() || undefined,
      sizeOptions: product.sizes,
    });
    router.push(next);
  };
  const quickAdd = (p: Product) => {
    const s = p.sizes.find((x) => x.isDefault) || p.sizes[0];
    const already = cartItems
      .filter((i) => i.productId === p.id)
      .reduce((n, i) => n + i.quantity, 0);
    if (!s || already + 1 > p.stock) return;
    const item: CartItem = {
      key: itemKey(p.id, s.code, [], ICE[0], SUGAR[0]),
      productId: p.id,
      name: p.name,
      imageUrl: p.imageUrl,
      size: s.code,
      toppingIds: [],
      toppingNames: [],
      unitPrice: p.price + s.extraPrice,
      quantity: 1,
      ice: ICE[0],
      sugar: SUGAR[0],
      sizeOptions: p.sizes.length ? p.sizes : undefined,
    };
    add(item);
    setQuickAdded(p.id);
  };
  if (loading)
    return (
      <main className="container main">
        <Loading />
      </main>
    );
  if (error)
    return (
      <main className="container main">
        <ErrorState message={error} retry={load} />
      </main>
    );
  if (!product)
    return (
      <main className="container main">
        <ErrorState message="Không tìm thấy sản phẩm" />
      </main>
    );
  return (
    <main className="pd-page">
      <div className="container">
        <nav className="pd-breadcrumb" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
          <Icon name="home" size={14} />
          <Link href="/">Trang chủ</Link>
          <span>/</span>
          <Link href="/#menu">{product.category}</Link>
          <span>/</span>
          <strong>{product.name}</strong>
        </nav>
        <div className="pd-layout">
          <div className="pd-media">
            <div className="pd-photo">
              <ProductImage src={product.imageUrl} alt={product.name} />
              <div className="pd-photo-tags">
                <span className="pd-tag-dark">{product.category}</span>
                <span className="pd-tag-light">
                  {product.stock > 0 ? `Còn ${product.stock} phần` : "Tạm hết"}
                </span>
              </div>
              <button
                className={`pd-like ${liked ? "is-liked" : ""}`}
                aria-label="Yêu thích"
                aria-pressed={liked}
                onClick={() => setLiked((v) => !v)}
              >
                <Icon name="heart" size={20} />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="pd-chips">
              {story.chips.map(([icon, label]) => (
                <span key={label}>
                  <Icon name={icon} size={14} />
                  {label}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          <section className="pd-card">
            <div className="pd-card-top">
              <span className="pd-eyebrow">BrewLite Signature</span>
              <span className="pd-fresh">Pha chế khi đặt</span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="pd-title">{product.name}</h1>
            <div className="pd-price-row">
              <span className="pd-price">{money(product.price)}</span>
              <span className="pd-price-note">Giá size S, chưa gồm topping</span>
            </div>
            <p className="pd-description">{product.description}</p>
            <div className="pd-group">
              <div className="pd-group-head">
                <h2>
                  1. Chọn kích thước <small>(Bắt buộc)</small>
                </h2>
                <span>
                  Size {size} ({VOLUME[size]})
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="pd-sizes">
                {product.sizes.map((s) => (
                  <button
                    key={s.code}
                    disabled={!s.available}
                    aria-pressed={size === s.code}
                    className={`pd-size ${size === s.code ? "selected" : ""}`}
                    onClick={() => setSize(s.code)}
                  >
                    {s.code === "M" && <em>Khuyến dùng</em>}
                    <Icon name="cup" size={s.code === "S" ? 16 : s.code === "M" ? 19 : 22} />
                    <strong>Size {s.code}</strong>
                    <small>
                      {s.name} · {VOLUME[s.code]}
                    </small>
                    <span>
                      {s.extraPrice > 0
                        ? `+${money(s.extraPrice)}`
                        : money(product.price)}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="pd-group">
              <div className="pd-group-head">
                <h2>2. Thêm Topping & Nâng cấp</h2>
              </div>
              <div className="pd-toppings">
                {product.toppings.map((t) => (
                  <label
                    key={t.id}
                    className={`pd-topping ${selected.includes(t.id) ? "selected" : ""} ${t.available ? "" : "is-disabled"}`}
                  >
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      disabled={!t.available}
                      checked={selected.includes(t.id)}
                      onChange={() =>
                        setSelected((v) =>
                          v.includes(t.id)
                            ? v.filter((x) => x !== t.id)
                            : [...v, t.id],
                        )
                      }
                    />
                    <span>{t.name}</span>
                    <small>+{money(t.extraPrice)}</small>
                  </label>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="pd-group">
              <div className="pd-group-head">
                <h2>3. Mức đá & độ ngọt</h2>
              </div>
              <div className="pd-segments" role="group" aria-label="Mức đá">
                {ICE.map((x) => (
                  <button
                    key={x}
                    aria-pressed={ice === x}
                    className={ice === x ? "selected" : ""}
                    onClick={() => setIce(x)}
                  >
                    {x}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="pd-segments" role="group" aria-label="Mức đường">
                {SUGAR.map((x) => (
                  <button
                    key={x}
                    aria-pressed={sugar === x}
                    className={sugar === x ? "selected" : ""}
                    onClick={() => setSugar(x)}
                  >
                    {x}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <label className="pd-note">
              <span>
                <Icon name="note" size={16} /> Ghi chú cho Barista
              </span>
              <input
                value={note}
                maxLength={120}
                onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Ví dụ: ít đá, nhiều sữa đặc, mang đi..."
              />
            </label>
            <div className="pd-total">
              <div className="pd-qty">
                <span>Số lượng:</span>
                <Quantity value={quantity} onChange={setQuantity} />
              </div>
              <div className="pd-total-price">
                <small>Tổng thanh toán:</small>
                <strong>{money(unit * quantity)}</strong>
              </div>
            </div>
            {product.stock === 0 && (
              <p className="error">Món này đang hết hàng.</p>
            )}
            {product.stock > 0 && overStock && (
              <p className="error">
                Chỉ còn {product.stock} phần
                {inCart > 0 ? ` (giỏ đã có ${inCart} phần)` : ""}.
              </p>
            )}
            {invalid && <p className="error">Tùy chọn không hợp lệ.</p>}
            <div className="pd-actions">
              <button
                className="pd-btn pd-btn-dark"
                disabled={blocked}
                onClick={() => submit("/cart")}
              >
                <Icon name="bag" size={18} />
                Thêm vào giỏ hàng
              </button>
              <button
                className="pd-btn pd-btn-caramel"
                disabled={blocked}
                onClick={() => submit("/checkout")}
              >
                <Icon name="bolt" size={18} />
                Mua ngay
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="pd-assure">
              <span>
                <Icon name="clock" size={14} /> Pha chế trong khoảng 20 phút
              </span>
              <span>
                <Icon name="snow" size={14} /> Đá viên bảo quản riêng
              </span>
            </div>
          </section>
        </div>
      </div>
      <section className="pd-details">
        <div className="container">
          <span className="pd-eyebrow">Artisanal details</span>
          <h2 className="pd-section-title">Mô tả sản phẩm & Nguồn gốc</h2>
          <p className="pd-section-lead">{product.description}</p>
          <div className="pd-info-grid">
            {story.cards.map(([icon, title, text], i) => (
              <article key={title} className="pd-info">
                <span className={`pd-info-icon tone-${i}`}>
                  <Icon name={icon} size={18} />
                </span>
                <h3>{title}</h3>
                <p>{text}</p>
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="pd-scores">
            <div>
              <span className="pd-scores-eyebrow">Cân bằng hương vị</span>
              <h3>Chỉ số hương vị Barista</h3>
              <p>Thước đo độ đậm và các tầng hương vị đặc trưng của dòng {product.category}.</p>
            </div>
            {story.scores.map(([label, score], i) => (
              <div key={label} className="pd-score">
                <div>
                  <span>{label}</span>
                  <span>{score} / 10</span>
                </div>
                <div className="pd-bar">
                  <span className={`tone-${i}`} style={{ width: `${score * 10}%` }} />
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
      {related.length > 0 && (
        <section className="container pd-related">
          <div className="pd-related-head">
            <div>
              <span className="pd-eyebrow">Thực đơn chọn lọc</span>
              <h2 className="pd-section-title">Có thể bạn sẽ thích</h2>
            </div>
            <Link href="/#menu">
              Xem tất cả <Icon name="arrowRight" size={14} />
            </Link>
          </div>
          <div className="pd-related-grid">
            {related.map((p) => (
              <article key={p.id} className="pd-related-card">
                <Link href={`/products/${p.id}`} className="pd-related-photo">
                  <ProductImage src={p.imageUrl} alt={p.name} />
                  <span>{p.category}</span>
                </Link>
                <div className="pd-related-body">
                  <Link href={`/products/${p.id}`}>
                    <h3>{p.name}</h3>
                  </Link>
                  <p>{p.description}</p>
                  <div className="pd-related-bottom">
                    <strong>{money(p.price)}</strong>
                    <button
                      disabled={p.stock < 1}
                      aria-label={`Thêm nhanh ${p.name}`}
                      onClick={() => quickAdd(p)}
                    >
                      {p.stock < 1 ? (
                        "Tạm hết"
                      ) : quickAdded === p.id ? (
                        "Đã thêm"
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <Icon name="plus" size={14} /> Thêm nhanh
                        </>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      )}
    </main>
  );
}
````

````text
"use client";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useAuth } from "@/components/auth-provider";
import { services } from "@/services";
import { REWARD_OPTIONS, type RewardOption, type Order, money } from "@/types/domain";
import { ErrorState, Loading, StatusBadge } from "@/components/ui";
import "./profile.css";

interface UserVoucher {
  code: string;
  title: string;
  discountAmount: number;
  isUsed?: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
}

export default function Profile() {
  const { user, loading: authLoading, refresh, logout } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [points, setPoints] = useState<number>(0);
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<Order[]>([]);
  const [vouchers, setVouchers] = useState<UserVoucher[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [redeemingId, setRedeemingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ type: "success" | "error"; text: string } | null>(null);

  const userId = user?.id;
  const userPoints = user?.loyaltyPoints;

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!userId) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await refresh();
      const [loyalty, mine] = await Promise.all([
        services.loyalty.get(userId).catch(() => ({ points: userPoints ?? 0 })),
        services.orders.mine(userId).catch(() => []),
      ]);

      // Cập nhật điểm chuẩn xác từ CSDL backend
      const currentPoints = loyalty.points !== undefined
        ? loyalty.points
        : (userPoints ?? 0);

      setPoints(currentPoints);

      const sortedOrders = [...mine].sort((a, b) => Date.parse(b.createdAt) - Date.parse(a.createdAt));
      setOrders(sortedOrders);

      // Lấy tập hợp các mã đã sử dụng trong danh sách đơn hàng
      const usedCodesSet = new Set(
        sortedOrders
          .filter((o) => o.status !== "CANCELLED" && o.status !== "PAYMENT_FAILED" && o.promotionCode)
          .map((o) => o.promotionCode!.trim().toUpperCase())
      );

      // Đọc kho voucher cá nhân từ localStorage
      const savedVouchers: UserVoucher[] = JSON.parse(
        localStorage.getItem(`vouchers_${userId}`) || "[]"
      );

      // Cập nhật trạng thái isUsed = true cho mã nào đã có trong đơn hàng
      const updatedVouchers = savedVouchers.map((v) => {
        const codeUpper = v.code.trim().toUpperCase();
        if (usedCodesSet.has(codeUpper)) {
          return { ...v, isUsed: true };
        }
        return v;
      });

      // Lưu lại vào localStorage để đồng bộ
      localStorage.setItem(`vouchers_${userId}`, JSON.stringify(updatedVouchers));

      // Chỉ giữ lại voucher chưa sử dụng để hiển thị
      const activeVouchers = updatedVouchers.filter((v) => !v.isUsed);
      setVouchers(activeVouchers);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Không tải được hồ sơ");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [userId, refresh, userPoints]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authLoading && !userId) router.replace("/login?next=%2Fprofile");
    else if (userId) void loadData();
  }, [authLoading, userId, router, loadData]);

  const handleRedeem = async (option: RewardOption) => {
    if (!userId) return;
    if (points < option.pointsCost) {
      setMessage({ type: "error", text: `Bạn không đủ điểm để đổi ${option.title}!` });
      return;
    }

    setRedeemingId(option.id);
    setMessage(null);

    try {
      let voucherCode = "";
      let remainingPoints = points - option.pointsCost;

      // 1. Gọi API Backend để trừ điểm thật trong PostgreSQL
      if (typeof services.loyalty.redeem === "function") {
        const res = await services.loyalty.redeem(userId, option);
        voucherCode = res.code;
        if (res.remainingPoints !== undefined) {
          remainingPoints = res.remainingPoints;
        }
      } else {
        throw new Error("Tính năng đổi điểm chưa sẵn sàng.");
      }

      if (!voucherCode) {
        throw new Error("Không nhận được mã ưu đãi từ hệ thống.");
      }

      // 2. Lưu voucher mới đổi vào LocalStorage
      const savedVouchers: UserVoucher[] = JSON.parse(
        localStorage.getItem(`vouchers_${userId}`) || "[]"
      );

      const newVoucher: UserVoucher = {
        code: voucherCode,
        title: option.title,
        discountAmount: option.discountAmount,
        isUsed: false,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };

      const updatedVouchers = [newVoucher, ...savedVouchers];
      localStorage.setItem(`vouchers_${userId}`, JSON.stringify(updatedVouchers));

      // 3. Cập nhật State chỉ lấy các voucher chưa dùng
      setVouchers(updatedVouchers.filter((v) => !v.isUsed));
      setPoints(remainingPoints);
      setMessage({ type: "success", text: `Đổi thành công! Mã ưu đãi của bạn: ${voucherCode}` });

      // Đồng bộ dữ liệu với server
      await refresh();
    } catch (err) {
      setMessage({
        type: "error",
        text: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Đổi điểm thất bại.",
      });
    } finally {
      setRedeemingId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleUseVoucher = (code: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
    setMessage({ type: "success", text: `Đã sao chép mã ${code} vào bộ nhớ tạm!` });
    router.push("/cart");
  };

  return (
    <main className="container main member-page">
      <div className="breadcrumb">
        <Link href="/">Trang chủ</Link>
        <span>›</span> Hồ sơ &amp; thẻ thành viên
      </div>

      <div className="member-heading">
        <div>
          <span className="eyebrow">Tài khoản cá nhân</span>
          <h1 className="section-title">Trung tâm Thành viên</h1>
          <p>Quản lý tài khoản, điểm BrewLite Rewards và các đơn hàng của bạn.</p>
        </div>
        <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={loadData} disabled={loading || !userId}>
          ↻ Làm mới
        </button>
      </div>

      {message && (
        <div className={`alert ${message.type === "success" ? "alert-success" : "alert-error"} mb-4`}>
          {message.text}
        </div>
      )}

      {authLoading || loading ? (
        <Loading />
      ) : error ? (
        <ErrorState message={error} retry={loadData} />
      ) : user ? (
        <div className="member-grid">
          <section className="member-main">
            <div className="member-identity card">
              <div className="member-avatar" aria-hidden="true">
                {user.name.trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
              </div>
              <div className="member-identity-copy">
                <span className="eyebrow">Thành viên BrewLite</span>
                <h2>{user.name}</h2>
                <p>{user.email}</p>
                <small>{user.role === "BARISTA" ? "Nhân viên Barista" : "Khách hàng"}</small>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="member-card">
              <div className="member-card-top">
                <div>
                  <span className="eyebrow">BrewLite Rewards</span>
                  <h2>Thẻ thành viên</h2>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p className="member-card-points">
                <strong>{points}</strong> điểm
              </p>
              <p className="member-card-id">BL · {user.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}</p>
              <p className="member-card-note">
                Tích 1 điểm cho mỗi 10.000đ khi hoàn tất đơn hàng thành công.
              </p>
            </div>

            <section className="card panel mt-6">
              <span className="eyebrow">Đổi điểm nhận ưu đãi</span>
              <h2>Gói quà BrewLite Rewards</h2>
              <div className="reward-options-grid mt-4">
                {REWARD_OPTIONS.map((opt) => {
                  const canRedeem = points >= opt.pointsCost;
                  return (
                    <div key={opt.id} className="reward-card p-4 border rounded-lg mb-3 flex justify-between items-center">
                      <div>
                        <h3 className="font-bold">{opt.title}</h3>
                        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{opt.description}</p>
                        <span className="badge badge-amber mt-1 inline-block">{opt.pointsCost} điểm</span>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        className="btn btn-primary btn-sm"
                        disabled={!canRedeem || redeemingId === opt.id}
                        onClick={() => handleRedeem(opt)}
                      >
                        {redeemingId === opt.id ? "Đang đổi..." : canRedeem ? "Đổi ngay" : "Chưa đủ điểm"}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </section>

            <section className="member-history card panel mt-6">
              <div className="member-section-head">
                <div>
                  <span className="eyebrow">Hoạt động gần đây</span>
                  <h2>Đơn hàng của tôi</h2>
                </div>
                <Link href="/orders">Xem tất cả →</Link>
              </div>
              {orders.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="muted">
                  Bạn chưa có đơn hàng nào. <Link href="/#menu">Khám phá thực đơn</Link>
                </p>
              ) : (
                orders.slice(0, 3).map((order) => (
                  <Link className="member-order" href={`/orders/${order.id}`} key={order.id}>
                    <div>
                      <strong>Đơn #{order.id}</strong>
                      <small>
                        {new Date(order.createdAt).toLocaleString("vi-VN")} · {order.items.length} món
                      </small>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <StatusBadge status={order.status} />
                      <strong>{money(order.total)}</strong>
                    </div>
                  </Link>
                ))
              )}
            </section>
          </section>

          <aside className="member-side">
            <section className="card panel member-benefits">
              <span className="eyebrow">Ưu đãi của bạn</span>
              <h2>Kho voucher của tôi ({vouchers.length})</h2>
              {vouchers.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="muted">Bạn chưa có voucher khả dụng nào.</p>
              ) : (
                <div className="voucher-list mt-3">
                  {vouchers.map((v, i) => (
                    <div
                      key={i}
                      className="voucher-item p-3 border rounded mb-2 bg-amber-50"
                    >
                      <div className="font-mono font-bold text-lg text-amber-900">
                        {v.code}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-sm">{v.title}</div>
                      <button
                        className="btn btn-secondary btn-xs mt-2 w-full"
                        onClick={() => handleUseVoucher(v.code)}
                      >
                        Sao chép &amp; Sử dụng ➔
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}

              <span className="eyebrow mt-4 inline-block">Ưu đãi thành viên</span>
              <p className="mt-1">
                Các ưu đãi dành riêng cho bạn sẽ hiển thị tại đây khi đổi thành công. Bạn có thể nhập mã khuyến mãi ở bước thanh toán.
              </p>
              <Link className="btn btn-secondary mt-2 w-full text-center block" href="/cart">
                Đi tới giỏ hàng
              </Link>
            </section>

            <section className="card panel member-shortcuts">
              <h2>Thao tác nhanh</h2>
              <Link href="/orders">
                Lịch sử đơn hàng <span>→</span>
              </Link>
              <Link href="/#menu">
                Tiếp tục khám phá món <span>→</span>
              </Link>
              {user.role === "BARISTA" && (
                <Link href="/barista/dashboard">
                  Trạm Barista <span>→</span>
                </Link>
              )}
              <button
                onClick={async () => {
                  await logout();
                  router.push("/");
                }}
              >
                Đăng xuất tài khoản <span>→</span>
              </button>
            </section>
          </aside>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </main>
  );
}
````

````text
"use client";
import { Suspense, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { authService } from "@/services/auth";
import { useAuth } from "@/components/auth-provider";
import { AuthFeature } from "@/components/auth-feature";
import { PasswordField } from "@/components/password-field";
function Form() {
  const router = useRouter(),
    params = useSearchParams(),
    { refresh } = useAuth(),
    [name, setName] = useState(""),
    [email, setEmail] = useState(""),
    [password, setPassword] = useState(""),
    [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState(""),
    [busy, setBusy] = useState(false),
    [error, setError] = useState("");
  const next = params.get("next");
  const submit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      setError("Mật khẩu xác nhận không khớp");
      return;
    }
    if (
      password.length < 8 ||
      !/[A-Z]/.test(password) ||
      !/[0-9]/.test(password)
    ) {
      setError("Mật khẩu cần ít nhất 8 ký tự, 1 chữ hoa và 1 chữ số");
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await authService.register(name, email, password);
      await refresh();
      router.replace(
        next?.startsWith("/") && !next.startsWith("//") ? next : "/",
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Đăng ký thất bại");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <main className="container main auth-main">
      <div className="auth-layout">
        <AuthFeature />
        <div className="auth-wrap card panel">
        <nav className="auth-tabs" aria-label="Tài khoản">
          <Link href="/login">Đăng nhập</Link>
          <span className="active">Đăng ký</span>
        </nav>
        <span className="eyebrow">Gia nhập BrewLite</span>
        <h1 className="section-title">Tạo tài khoản mới</h1>
        <p className="auth-intro">Tạo tài khoản để đặt món nhanh hơn và theo dõi đơn hàng của bạn.</p>
        <form className="form" onSubmit={submit}>
          <label>
            Họ tên
            <input
              className="field"
              minLength={2}
              required
              placeholder="Tên của bạn"
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              autoComplete="name"
            />
          </label>
          <label>
            Email
            <input
              className="field"
              type="email"
              required
              placeholder="ban@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              autoComplete="email"
            />
          </label>
          <PasswordField label="Mật khẩu" value={password} onChange={setPassword} placeholder="Nhập mật khẩu" autoComplete="new-password" hint="Ít nhất 8 ký tự, gồm chữ hoa và chữ số." />
          <PasswordField label="Xác nhận mật khẩu" value={confirmPassword} onChange={setConfirmPassword} placeholder="Nhập lại mật khẩu" autoComplete="new-password" />
          {error && (
            <p role="alert" className="error">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
          <button className="btn btn-primary" disabled={busy}>
            {busy ? "Đang tạo tài khoản..." : "Đăng ký"}
          </button>
        </form>
        <p>
          Đã có tài khoản? <Link href="/login">Đăng nhập ngay</Link>
        </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
export default function Register() {
  return (
    <Suspense>
      <Form />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

````

## frontend/src/components/auth-provider.tsx

<!-- snapshot-file {"path": "frontend/src/components/auth-provider.tsx", "encoding": "utf-8", "bytes": 1672, "characters": 1672, "sha256": "b87dae0fa2168c02453a50274ccca4fa723d795299f27132274c8be223f21b0f"} -->
````text
"use client";
import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useState,
} from "react";
import { authService } from "@/services/auth";
import { ApiError } from "@/services/http";
import type { User } from "@/types/domain";
type AuthContextType = {
  user: User | null;
  loading: boolean;
  refresh: () => Promise<void>;
  logout: () => Promise<void>;
};
const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType>({
  user: null,
  loading: true,
  refresh: async () => {},
  logout: async () => {},
});
export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setUser((await authService.me()).user);
    } catch {
      setUser(null);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();
  }, [refresh]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const expired = () => setUser(null);
    window.addEventListener("brewlite:session-expired", expired);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("brewlite:session-expired", expired);
  }, []);
  const logout = async () => {
    try {
      await authService.logout();
      setUser(null);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 401) {
        setUser(null);
        return;
      }
      throw error;
    }
  };
  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, loading, refresh, logout }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
}
export const useAuth = () => useContext(AuthContext);
````

````text
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useAuth } from "@/components/auth-provider";
import { services } from "@/services";
import type { Order, OrderStatus } from "@/types/domain";
import { money } from "@/types/domain";
import { ErrorState, Loading, StatusBadge } from "@/components/ui";
import "./barista-board.css";

export type BaristaView = "dashboard" | "orders" | "preparing" | "ready" | "history";
type Action = { order: Order; next: OrderStatus };

const navigation: { view: BaristaView; label: string; icon: string }[] = [
  { view: "dashboard", label: "Tổng quan", icon: "▦" },
  { view: "orders", label: "Đơn chờ pha", icon: "◷" },
  { view: "preparing", label: "Đang pha chế", icon: "☕" },
  { view: "ready", label: "Chờ giao", icon: "✓" },
  { view: "history", label: "Lịch sử xử lý", icon: "↺" },
];
const columns: { status: OrderStatus; label: string; next: OrderStatus; action: string }[] = [
  { status: "PAID", label: "Chờ pha chế", next: "PREPARING", action: "Bắt đầu pha chế" },
  { status: "PREPARING", label: "Đang pha chế", next: "READY", action: "Đã pha chế xong" },
  { status: "READY", label: "Sẵn sàng giao", next: "COMPLETED", action: "Xác nhận đã giao" },
];
const viewStatus: Partial<Record<BaristaView, OrderStatus>> = {
  orders: "PAID",
  preparing: "PREPARING",
  ready: "READY",
};
const statusLabel: Record<OrderStatus, string> = {
  PENDING: "Chờ thanh toán",
  PAID: "Đã thanh toán",
  PAYMENT_FAILED: "Thanh toán thất bại",
  PREPARING: "Đang pha chế",
  READY: "Sẵn sàng giao",
  COMPLETED: "Đã giao khách",
  CANCELLED: "Đã hủy",
};
const minutesWaiting = (iso: string) =>
  Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(iso).getTime()) / 60000));
const canCancel = (status: OrderStatus) =>
  ["PENDING", "PAID", "PAYMENT_FAILED", "PREPARING"].includes(status);

export function BaristaBoard({ view }: { view: BaristaView }) {
  const { user, loading: authLoading, logout } = useAuth();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<Order[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<Order | null>(null);
  const [action, setAction] = useState<Action | null>(null);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [signingOut, setSigningOut] = useState(false);
  const inFlight = useRef(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const rows = await services.barista.list();
      setOrders(rows.sort((a, b) => a.createdAt.localeCompare(b.createdAt)));
    } catch (cause) {
      setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Không tải được đơn hàng");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (authLoading || signingOut) return;
    if (!user) router.replace(`/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(`/barista/${view}`)}`);
    else if (user.role !== "BARISTA") router.replace("/forbidden");
    else void load();
  }, [authLoading, signingOut, user, view, router, load]);

  const openAction = (order: Order, next: OrderStatus) => {
    if (inFlight.current) return;
    setReason("");
    setAction({ order, next });
  };
  const submitAction = async () => {
    if (!action || inFlight.current) return;
    if (action.next === "CANCELLED" && !reason.trim()) {
      setError("Vui lòng nhập lý do hủy đơn");
      return;
    }
    inFlight.current = true;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const updated = action.next === "CANCELLED"
        ? await services.barista.cancel(action.order.id, reason.trim())
        : await services.barista.transition(action.order.id, action.next);
      setDetail((current) => current?.id === updated.id ? updated : current);
      setAction(null);
      setNotice(`Đơn #${updated.id}: ${statusLabel[updated.status]}`);
      await load();
    } catch (cause) {
      setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Không thể cập nhật đơn");
    } finally {
      inFlight.current = false;
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (authLoading || !user || user.role !== "BARISTA")
    return <main className="barista-gate"><Loading label="Đang kiểm tra quyền Barista..." /></main>;

  const counts = {
    PAID: orders.filter((order) => order.status === "PAID").length,
    PREPARING: orders.filter((order) => order.status === "PREPARING").length,
    READY: orders.filter((order) => order.status === "READY").length,
    COMPLETED: orders.filter((order) =>
      order.status === "COMPLETED" &&
      order.completedAt &&
      new Date(order.completedAt).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString(),
    ).length,
  };
  const visibleColumns = view === "dashboard"
    ? columns
    : columns.filter((column) => column.status === viewStatus[view]);
  const history = orders.filter((order) =>
    ["COMPLETED", "CANCELLED"].includes(order.status) &&
    `${order.id} ${order.customerName ?? ""} ${order.items.map((item) => item.name).join(" ")}`
      .toLocaleLowerCase("vi-VN").includes(search.toLocaleLowerCase("vi-VN")),
  ).reverse();

  const ticket = (order: Order, next?: OrderStatus, label?: string) => (
    <article className={`barista-ticket barista-ticket-${order.status.toLowerCase()}`} key={order.id}>
      <div className="barista-ticket-top">
        <strong>#{order.id}</strong>
        <StatusBadge status={order.status} />
      </div>
      <p className="barista-meta">
        {order.customerName || `Khách #${order.userId.slice(0, 8)}`} · {new Date(order.createdAt).toLocaleString("vi-VN")}
      </p>
      {order.status !== "COMPLETED" && order.status !== "CANCELLED" && (
        <p className="barista-wait">◷ Chờ {minutesWaiting(order.createdAt)} phút</p>
      )}
      <div className="barista-recipes">
        {order.items.map((item) => (
          <div className="barista-recipe" key={item.key}>
            <div><strong>{item.quantity}× {item.name}</strong><span>Size {item.size}</span></div>
            <small>{[item.ice, item.sugar, ...item.toppingNames].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")}</small>
            {item.note && <p className="barista-note">Ghi chú: {item.note}</p>}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      {order.cancelReason && <p className="barista-note">Lý do hủy: {order.cancelReason}</p>}
      <div className="barista-ticket-total"><span>Tổng đơn</span><strong>{money(order.total)}</strong></div>
      <div className="barista-ticket-actions">
        {next && <button className="btn btn-primary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => openAction(order, next)}>{label}</button>}
        <button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => setDetail(order)}>Chi tiết</button>
        {canCancel(order.status) && <button className="btn btn-danger" disabled={busy} onClick={() => openAction(order, "CANCELLED")}>Báo sự cố</button>}
      </div>
    </article>
  );

  return (
    <div className="barista-workspace">
      <header className="barista-header">
        <Link href="/barista/dashboard" className="barista-brand">☕ <span>BrewLite KDS</span></Link>
        <span className="barista-label">Trạm Barista</span>
        <div className="barista-identity"><strong>{user.name}</strong><small>Nhân viên pha chế</small></div>
      </header>
      <aside className="barista-sidebar" aria-label="Điều hành pha chế">
        <div className="barista-sidebar-title">Điều hành pha chế</div>
        <nav>{navigation.map((item) => (
          <Link key={item.view} href={`/barista/${item.view}`} aria-current={view === item.view ? "page" : undefined}>
            <span aria-hidden="true">{item.icon}</span>{item.label}
          </Link>
        ))}</nav>
        <button className="barista-signout" disabled={signingOut} onClick={async () => {
          setSigningOut(true);
          try { await logout(); router.replace("/login"); }
          catch (cause) { setSigningOut(false); setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Không thể đăng xuất"); }
        }}>Đăng xuất ca trực</button>
      </aside>
      <main className="barista-content">
        <section className="barista-ribbon">
          <div><span className="eyebrow">BrewLite · Trạm pha chế</span><h1>Trạm Barista KDS</h1><p>Đơn hàng và tiến độ pha chế được cập nhật từ cùng nguồn dữ liệu.</p></div>
          <div className="barista-ribbon-actions"><button className="btn btn-outline" onClick={() => void load()} disabled={loading}>↻ Làm mới</button></div>
        </section>
        {notice && <div className="barista-toast" role="status">✓ {notice}<button aria-label="Đóng thông báo" onClick={() => setNotice("")}>×</button></div>}
        {error && !action && <ErrorState message={error} retry={() => void load()} />}
        <section className="barista-kpis" aria-label="Tổng quan đơn hàng">
          <div><small>Đơn mới chờ pha</small><strong>{counts.PAID}</strong></div>
          <div><small>Đang pha chế</small><strong>{counts.PREPARING}</strong></div>
          <div><small>Chờ giao tại quầy</small><strong>{counts.READY}</strong></div>
          <div><small>Đã giao hôm nay</small><strong>{counts.COMPLETED}</strong></div>
        </section>
        {loading ? <Loading label="Đang tải đơn hàng..." /> : view === "history" ? (
          <section className="barista-history">
            <div className="barista-section-heading"><div><span className="eyebrow">Lịch sử xử lý</span><h2>Đơn đã hoàn tất và đã hủy</h2></div><label>Tìm đơn<input className="field" value={search} onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)} placeholder="Mã đơn, khách, món..." /></label></div>
            {history.length ? <div className="barista-history-grid">{history.map((order) => ticket(order))}</div> : <div className="barista-empty">Không có đơn phù hợp trong lịch sử.</div>}
          </section>
        ) : (
          <section className={`barista-board ${view !== "dashboard" ? "barista-board-focused" : ""}`} aria-label="Hàng đợi pha chế">
            {visibleColumns.map((column, index) => {
              const queue = orders.filter((order) => order.status === column.status);
              return <div className="barista-column" key={column.status}>
                <div className="barista-column-heading"><h2><span className={`barista-dot barista-dot-${column.status.toLowerCase()}`} />{view === "dashboard" ? `${index + 1}. ` : ""}{column.label}</h2><span>{queue.length} đơn</span></div>
                {queue.length ? queue.map((order) => ticket(order, column.next, column.action)) : <div className="barista-empty">Chưa có đơn {column.label.toLocaleLowerCase("vi-VN")}.</div>}
              </div>;
            })}
          </section>
        )}
      </main>
      {detail && <div className="barista-overlay" role="presentation" onMouseDown={(event) => { if (event.target === event.currentTarget) setDetail(null); }}>
        <section className="barista-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={`Chi tiết đơn ${detail.id}`}>
          <div className="row"><span className="eyebrow">Chi tiết đơn hàng</span><button className="barista-close" onClick={() => setDetail(null)} aria-label="Đóng chi tiết">×</button></div>
          <h2>#{detail.id}</h2><StatusBadge status={detail.status} />
          <p>{detail.customerName || `Khách #${detail.userId.slice(0, 8)}`} · {new Date(detail.createdAt).toLocaleString("vi-VN")}</p>
          {detail.items.map((item) => <div className="barista-recipe" key={item.key}><strong>{item.quantity}× {item.name} · Size {item.size}</strong><small>{[item.ice, item.sugar, ...item.toppingNames].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")}</small>{item.note && <p className="barista-note">Ghi chú: {item.note}</p>}</div>)}
          {detail.cancelReason && <p className="barista-note">Lý do hủy: {detail.cancelReason}</p>}
          <div className="barista-ticket-total"><span>Tổng đơn</span><strong>{money(detail.total)}</strong></div>
          <p className="barista-meta">Tiến trình: {statusLabel[detail.status]}</p>
          <div className="barista-ticket-actions">{columns.filter((column) => column.status === detail.status).map((column) => <button className="btn btn-primary" key={column.status} onClick={() => openAction(detail, column.next)}>{column.action}</button>)}{canCancel(detail.status) && <button className="btn btn-danger" onClick={() => openAction(detail, "CANCELLED")}>Hủy đơn sự cố</button>}</div>
        </section>
      </div>}
      {action && <div className="barista-overlay" role="presentation">
        <section className="barista-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Xác nhận cập nhật đơn">
          <span className="eyebrow">Xác nhận thao tác</span>
          <h2>{action.next === "CANCELLED" ? "Hủy đơn hàng sự cố" : statusLabel[action.next]}</h2>
          <p>Đơn #{action.order.id} · {money(action.order.total)}</p>
          {action.next === "CANCELLED" && <label className="barista-reason">Lý do hủy đơn<textarea className="field" value={reason} onChange={(event) => setReason(event.target.value)} maxLength={300} placeholder="Ví dụ: Hết nguyên liệu..." required /></label>}
          {error && <p className="error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
          <div className="barista-ticket-actions"><button className="btn btn-secondary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => { setAction(null); setError(""); }}>Quay lại</button><button className={action.next === "CANCELLED" ? "btn btn-danger" : "btn btn-primary"} disabled={busy || (action.next === "CANCELLED" && !reason.trim())} onClick={() => void submitAction()}>{busy ? "Đang cập nhật..." : "Xác nhận"}</button></div>
        </section>
      </div>}
    </div>
  );
}

````

````text
import type { CartItem } from "@/types/domain";
import { cartTotal, money } from "@/types/domain";
export function OrderSummary({
  items,
  discount = 0,
}: {
  items: CartItem[];
  discount?: number;
}) {
  const subtotal = cartTotal(items);
  return (
    <div>
      <h2 className="section-title" style={{ fontSize: 23 }}>
        Tóm tắt đơn hàng
      </h2>
      <div className="summary-line">
        <span>Tạm tính</span>
        <strong>{money(subtotal)}</strong>
      </div>
      {discount > 0 && (
        <div className="summary-line success">
          <span>Ưu đãi</span>
          <strong>−{money(discount)}</strong>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="summary-line total">
        <span>Tổng cộng</span>
        <span>{money(Math.max(0, subtotal - discount))}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

````

<!-- snapshot-file {"path": "frontend/src/components/password-field.tsx", "encoding": "utf-8", "bytes": 1443, "characters": 1421, "sha256": "00ae884f3a66b38f0fb5828a1187c6661f708e6a2ff1b8773796caa250de6156"} -->
````text
"use client";

import { useId, useState } from "react";

type PasswordFieldProps = {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  placeholder: string;
  autoComplete: "current-password" | "new-password";
  hint?: string;
};

export function PasswordField({ label, value, onChange, placeholder, autoComplete, hint }: PasswordFieldProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const toggleLabel = label === "Xác nhận mật khẩu" ? "mật khẩu xác nhận" : label.toLocaleLowerCase("vi-VN");

  return (
    <div className="password-control">
      <label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>
      <span className="password-field">
        <input
          id={id}
          className="field"
          type={visible ? "text" : "password"}
          required
          placeholder={placeholder}
          value={value}
          onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
          autoComplete={autoComplete}
        />
        <button
          className="password-toggle"
          type="button"
          aria-label={`${visible ? "Ẩn" : "Hiện"} ${toggleLabel}`}
          aria-pressed={visible}
          onClick={() => setVisible((current) => !current)}
        >
          {visible ? "Ẩn" : "Hiện"}
        </button>
      </span>
      {hint && <small className="password-hint">{hint}</small>}
    </div>
  );
}

````

````text
"use client";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useCart } from "@/stores/cart";
import { useAuth } from "./auth-provider";
import { dataMode } from "@/services";
export function AppFrame({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  if (pathname.startsWith("/barista/")) return <>{children}</>;
  return <><Header />{children}<Footer /></>;
}
export function Header() {
  const items = useCart((s) => s.items),
    { user, logout } = useAuth(),
    router = useRouter();
  const count = items.reduce((a, i) => a + i.quantity, 0);
  return (
    <>
      <header className="header">
        <div className="container header-inner">
          <Link className="brand" href="/">
            <span className="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" fill="none">
                <path d="M8 15h18v8a8 8 0 0 1-8 8h-2a8 8 0 0 1-8-8v-8Z" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" />
                <path d="M26 17h2a4 4 0 0 1 0 8h-2M7 31h22M14 5c-3 3 2 4-1 7M21 4c-3 3 2 5-1 8" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" />
              </svg>
            </span>
            <span>BrewLite</span>
          </Link>
          <nav className="nav" aria-label="Điều hướng">
            <Link href="/">Trang chủ</Link>
            <Link href="/#menu">Thực đơn</Link>
            <Link href="/orders">Đơn hàng của tôi</Link>
            {user?.role === "BARISTA" && (
              <Link href="/barista/dashboard">Trạm Barista</Link>
            )}
          </nav>
          <div className="nav-tools">
            <Link className="cart-link" href="/cart" aria-label={`Giỏ hàng ${count} món`}>
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
                <path d="M4 8h16l-1.4 12H5.4L4 8ZM9 9V6a3 3 0 0 1 6 0v3" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.7" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeLinecap="round" />
              </svg>
              <span className="cart-label">Giỏ hàng</span>
              <span className="badge">{count}</span>
            </Link>
            {user ? (
              <>
                <Link href="/profile">{user.name}</Link>
                <button
                  className="link"
                  onClick={async () => {
                    await logout();
                    router.push("/");
                  }}
                >
                  Đăng xuất
                </button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <Link href="/login">Đăng nhập</Link>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>
      {dataMode === "mock" && (
        <div className="demo">
          Dữ liệu nghiệp vụ cục bộ đang được sử dụng. Đăng nhập dùng máy chủ
          thật.
        </div>
      )}
      {dataMode === "hybrid" && (
        <div className="demo">

        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
export function Footer() {
  return (
    <footer className="footer">
      <div className="container footer-inner">
        <div className="footer-about">
          <strong className="brand">BrewLite</strong>
          <p>Trải nghiệm cà phê Việt theo cách của bạn, từ chọn món đến đặt hàng chỉ trong vài bước.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="footer-links">
          <strong>Khám phá</strong>
          <Link href="/#menu">Thực đơn</Link>
          <Link href="/orders">Đơn hàng của tôi</Link>
          <Link href="/profile">Thành viên BrewLite</Link>
        </div>
        <div className="footer-links">
          <strong>Hỗ trợ</strong>
          <Link href="/cart">Giỏ hàng</Link>
          <Link href="/login">Tài khoản</Link>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="footer-bottom">© 2026 BrewLite · Cà phê Việt mỗi ngày</div>
    </footer>
  );
}
````

````text
"use client";
import type { OrderStatus } from "@/types/domain";
export function Loading({ label = "Đang tải..." }: { label?: string }) {
  return (
    <div role="status" className="panel card" style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
      <div className="spinner" />
      {label}
    </div>
  );
}
export function Empty({
  message,
  action,
}: {
  message: string;
  action?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="panel card" style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 42 }}>
      <h2>Chưa có nội dung</h2>
      <p className="muted">{message}</p>
      {action}
    </div>
  );
}
export function ErrorState({
  message,
  retry,
}: {
  message: string;
  retry?: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div role="alert" className="panel card">
      <p className="error">{message}</p>
      {retry && (
        <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={retry}>
          Thử lại
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
export function Quantity({
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  value: number;
  onChange: (n: number) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="quantity">
      <button
        aria-label="Giảm số lượng"
        disabled={value <= 1}
        onClick={() => onChange(value - 1)}
      >
        −
      </button>
      <span>{value}</span>
      <button
        aria-label="Tăng số lượng"
        disabled={value >= 99}
        onClick={() => onChange(value + 1)}
      >
        +
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
const labels: Record<OrderStatus, string> = {
  PENDING: "Chờ thanh toán",
  PAID: "Đã thanh toán",
  PAYMENT_FAILED: "Thanh toán thất bại",
  PREPARING: "Đang pha chế",
  READY: "Sẵn sàng nhận",
  COMPLETED: "Đã hoàn tất",
  CANCELLED: "Đã hủy",
};
export function StatusBadge({ status }: { status: OrderStatus }) {
  return <span className={`status ${status}`}>{labels[status]}</span>;
}
export function Timeline({ status }: { status: OrderStatus }) {
  if (status === "PAYMENT_FAILED" || status === "CANCELLED")
    return <StatusBadge status={status} />;
  const states: OrderStatus[] = [
    "PENDING",
    "PAID",
    "PREPARING",
    "READY",
    "COMPLETED",
  ];
  return (
    <div className="timeline">
      {states.map((s, i) => (
        <span key={s} className={i <= states.indexOf(status) ? "done" : ""}>
          {labels[s]}
        </span>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
export function ProductImage({
  src,
  alt,
  className,
}: {
  src: string;
  alt: string;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const fallback = /matcha/i.test(alt)
    ? "/images/products/sample-matcha.svg"
    : /trà|đào/i.test(alt)
      ? "/images/products/sample-iced-tea.svg"
      : /cappuccino|americano|macchiato/i.test(alt)
        ? "/images/products/sample-latte.svg"
        : "/images/products/sample-milk-coffee.svg";
  return (
    // Original Stitch photos are remote; keep a local fallback for offline demos.
    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
    <img
      className={className}
      src={src}
      alt={alt}
      onError={(e) => {
        if (e.currentTarget.src.endsWith(fallback)) {
          e.currentTarget.style.visibility = "hidden";
          e.currentTarget.parentElement?.classList.add("image-fallback");
        } else e.currentTarget.src = fallback;
      }}
    />
  );
}
````

````text
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { afterEach, test } from 'node:test';
import { apiOrders, apiPayments, apiBarista } from './api';
import { ApiError } from './http';
import type { CartItem } from '../types/domain';

const originalFetch = globalThis.fetch;
afterEach(() => { globalThis.fetch = originalFetch; });
const item: CartItem = {
  key: 'local-key', productId: 'product', name: 'Untrusted name', imageUrl: '/local.svg',
  size: 'M', toppingIds: ['topping'], toppingNames: ['Untrusted topping'], unitPrice: 1,
  quantity: 2, ice: '70% đá', sugar: '50% ít ngọt', note: 'Ít nóng',
};

test('orders adapter posts options and cookie credentials, never client price/owner/discount', async () => {
  let call: { url: string; init?: RequestInit } | undefined;
  const order = { id: 'server-order', status: 'PENDING', total: 80000 };
  globalThis.fetch = async (url, init) => {
    call = { url: String(url), init };
    return Response.json(order, { status: 201 });
  };
  assert.deepEqual(await apiOrders.create('untrusted-owner', [item], { code: 'SERVER_CODE', discount: 999999 }), order);
  assert.ok(call);
  assert.ok(call.url.endsWith('/orders'));
  assert.equal(call.init?.credentials, 'include');
  assert.equal(call.init?.method, 'POST');
  assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(String(call.init?.body)), {
    items: [{ productId: 'product', size: 'M', toppingIds: ['topping'], quantity: 2, ice: '70% đá', sugar: '50% ít ngọt', note: 'Ít nóng' }],
    promotionCode: 'SERVER_CODE',
  });
});

test('stock conflict remains an API error with a clear message and leaves the cart input intact', async () => {
  const items = [structuredClone(item)];
  globalThis.fetch = async () => Response.json({ message: 'Không đủ tồn kho' }, { status: 409 });
  await assert.rejects(apiOrders.create('user', items), (error: unknown) => {
    assert.ok(error instanceof ApiError);
    assert.equal(error.status, 409);
    assert.equal(error.message, 'Không đủ tồn kho');
    return true;
  });
  assert.deepEqual(items, [item]);
});

test('validation messages are shown together; network errors do not fall back to demo orders', async () => {
  globalThis.fetch = async () => Response.json({ message: ['quantity must be positive', 'size is invalid'] }, { status: 400 });
  await assert.rejects(apiOrders.create('user', [item]), /quantity must be positive, size is invalid/);
  globalThis.fetch = async () => { throw new Error('Network unavailable'); };
  await assert.rejects(apiOrders.create('user', [item]), /Network unavailable/);
});

test('history, detail, status and staff requests retain authentication and expected routes', async () => {
  const calls: { url: string; init?: RequestInit }[] = [];
  globalThis.fetch = async (url, init) => { calls.push({ url: String(url), init }); return Response.json([]); };
  await apiOrders.mine('ignored');
  await apiOrders.get('order/id');
  await apiOrders.status('order/id');
  await apiBarista.list();
  await apiBarista.transition('order/id', 'PREPARING');
  const paths = ['/orders/me', '/orders/order%2Fid', '/orders/order%2Fid/status', '/staff/orders', '/staff/orders/order%2Fid/status'];
  calls.forEach((call, index) => {
    assert.ok(call.url.endsWith(paths[index]));
    assert.equal(call.init?.credentials, 'include');
  });
  assert.equal(calls[4].init?.method, 'PATCH');
  assert.equal(calls[1].init?.cache, 'no-store');
  assert.equal(calls[2].init?.cache, 'no-store');
  assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(String(calls[4].init?.body)), { status: 'PREPARING' });
});

test('status adapter unwraps the JSON status response', async () => {
  globalThis.fetch = async () => Response.json({ status: 'PENDING' });
  assert.equal(await apiOrders.status('order'), 'PENDING');
});

test('payments adapter sends only the VNPAY initiation contract', async () => {
  let body: unknown;
  let headers: HeadersInit | undefined;
  globalThis.fetch = async (_url, init) => {
    body = JSON.parse(String(init?.body));
    headers = init?.headers;
    return Response.json({
      status: 'PROCESSING',
      paymentUrl: 'https://sandbox.vnpayment.vn/paymentv2/vpcpay.html',
    }, { status: 201 });
  };
  await apiPayments.pay(
    'order-id',
    'VNPAY_QR',
    '41a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001',
  );
  assert.deepEqual(body, {
    orderId: 'order-id',
    method: 'VNPAY_QR',
    idempotencyKey: '41a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001',
  });
  assert.deepEqual(headers, {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'Idempotency-Key': '41a650c7-8597-4a01-a8e2-000000000001',
  });
});

test('payments reconciliation is an authenticated POST scoped to the order', async () => {
  let call: { url: string; init?: RequestInit } | undefined;
  globalThis.fetch = async (url, init) => {
    call = { url: String(url), init };
    return Response.json({ status: 'PAID' });
  };
  await apiPayments.reconcile('order/id');
  assert.ok(call);
  assert.ok(call.url.endsWith('/payments/order%2Fid/reconcile'));
  assert.equal(call.init?.method, 'POST');
  assert.equal(call.init?.credentials, 'include');
  assert.equal(call.init?.body, undefined);
});
````

````text
import { request } from "./http";
import type {
  ProductService,
  OrderService,
  PaymentService,
  PromotionService,
  LoyaltyService,
  BaristaOrderService,
} from "./contracts";
import type {
  Order,
  Payment,
  Product,
  Promotion,
  OrderStatus,
  RewardOption,
} from "@/types/domain";

type ApiListProduct = Pick<
  Product,
  "id" | "name" | "price" | "imageUrl" | "stock" | "description"
>;

type ApiDetailProduct = Omit<Product, "category" | "sizes"> & {
  defaultSizeId?: string;
  sizes: (Product["sizes"][number] & { id?: string })[];
};

const normalize = (p: ApiDetailProduct): Product => ({
  ...p,
  category: "Thực đơn",
  sizes: p.sizes.map((s) => ({ ...s, isDefault: s.id === p.defaultSizeId })),
});

export const apiProducts: ProductService = {
  list: async () => {
    const rows = await request<ApiListProduct[]>("/products");
    return rows.map((p) => ({
      ...p,
      category: "Thực đơn",
      sizes: [],
      toppings: [],
    }));
  },
  get: async (id) => {
    try {
      return normalize(
        await request<ApiDetailProduct>(`/products/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if ((e as { status?: number }).status === 404) return null;
      throw e;
    }
  },
};

export const apiOrders: OrderService = {
  create: (_userId, items, promotion) =>
    request<Order>("/orders", {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({
        items: items.map((i) => ({
          productId: i.productId,
          size: i.size,
          toppingIds: i.toppingIds,
          quantity: i.quantity,
          ice: i.ice,
          sugar: i.sugar,
          note: i.note,
        })),
        promotionCode: promotion?.code,
      }),
    }),
  mine: () => request<Order[]>("/orders/me"),
  get: (id) =>
    request<Order>(`/orders/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { cache: "no-store" }),
  status: (id) =>
    request<{ status: OrderStatus }>(
      `/orders/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/status`,
      { cache: "no-store" },
    )
      .then((result) => result.status),
};

export const apiPayments: PaymentService = {
  pay: (orderId, method, idempotencyKey) =>
    request<Payment>("/payments", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Idempotency-Key": idempotencyKey },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        orderId,
        method,
        idempotencyKey,
      }),
    }),
  reconcile: (orderId) =>
    request<Payment>(
      `/payments/${encodeURIComponent(orderId)}/reconcile`,
      { method: "POST" },
    ),
};

export const apiPromotions: PromotionService = {
  validate: (code, subtotal) =>
    request<Promotion>("/promotions/validate", {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ code, subtotal }),
    }),
};

export const apiLoyalty: LoyaltyService = {
  get: async () => {
    try {
      return await request<{ points: number }>("/loyalty/me");
    } catch {
      const response = await request<{ user: { loyaltyPoints: number } }>("/auth/me");
      return { points: response.user.loyaltyPoints };
    }
  },
  redeem: async (_userId, option: RewardOption) =>
    request<{ success: boolean; code: string; remainingPoints: number }>(
      "/loyalty/redeem",
      {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify({ rewardOptionId: option.id }),
      },
    ),
};

export const apiBarista: BaristaOrderService = {
  list: () => request<Order[]>("/staff/orders"),
  get: async (id) => {
    try {
      return await request<Order>(`/staff/orders/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
    } catch (e) {
      if ((e as { status?: number }).status === 404) return null;
      throw e;
    }
  },
  transition: (id, status) =>
    request<Order>(`/staff/orders/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/status`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: JSON.stringify({ status }),
    }),
  cancel: (id, reason) =>
    request<Order>(`/staff/orders/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/cancel`, {
      method: "PATCH",
      body: JSON.stringify({ reason }),
    }),
};

````

````text
export const authService = {
  me: () => request<{ user: User }>("/auth/me"),
  login: (email: string, password: string) =>

      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ email, password }),
````

````text
import type {
  CartItem,
  LoyaltyPoints,
  Order,
  OrderStatus,
  Payment,
  PaymentMethod,
  Product,
  Promotion,
  RewardOption,
} from "@/types/domain";

export interface ProductService {
  list(): Promise<Product[]>;
  get(id: string): Promise<Product | null>;
}

export interface OrderService {
  create(
    userId: string,
    items: CartItem[],
    promotion?: Promotion,
  ): Promise<Order>;
  mine(userId: string): Promise<Order[]>;
  get(id: string): Promise<Order | null>;
  status(id: string): Promise<OrderStatus | null>;
}

export interface PaymentService {
  pay(
    orderId: string,
    method: PaymentMethod,
    idempotencyKey: string,
  ): Promise<Payment>;
  reconcile(orderId: string): Promise<Payment>;
}

export interface PromotionService {
  validate(code: string, subtotal: number): Promise<Promotion>;
}

export interface LoyaltyService {
  get(userId: string): Promise<LoyaltyPoints>;
  redeem?(
    userId: string,
    option: RewardOption,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; code: string; remainingPoints: number }>;
}

export interface BaristaOrderService {
  list(): Promise<Order[]>;
  get(id: string): Promise<Order | null>;
  transition(id: string, status: OrderStatus): Promise<Order>;
  cancel(id: string, reason: string): Promise<Order>;
}
````

<!-- snapshot-file {"path": "frontend/src/services/http.ts", "encoding": "utf-8", "bytes": 935, "characters": 935, "sha256": "e8c4b333f77cfa315736963a8bd8f3eda4a75fbacfb85e0d59386f0020c25d31"} -->
````text
export const API_BASE =
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:3001/api";
export class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public status: number,
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
  }
}
export async function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, {
    credentials: "include",
    ...init,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", ...init?.headers },
  });
  const body = await response.json().catch(() => null);
  if (response.status === 401 && typeof window !== "undefined" && path !== "/auth/login")
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("brewlite:session-expired"));
  if (!response.ok)
    throw new ApiError(
      response.status,
      Array.isArray(body?.message)
        ? body.message.join(", ")
        : body?.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`,
    );
  return body as T;
}

````

````text
import {
  apiProducts,
  apiOrders,
  apiPayments,
  apiPromotions,
  apiLoyalty,
  apiBarista,
} from "./api";
import {
  mockProducts,
  mockOrders,
  mockPayments,
  mockPromotions,
  mockLoyalty,
  mockBarista,
} from "./mock";
/**
 * mock: mọi module giả lập (trừ auth).
 * hybrid: sản phẩm gọi backend thật; đơn/thanh toán/ưu đãi/điểm/Barista vẫn giả lập.
 * Giỏ hàng không có service: luôn nằm trong Zustand (`stores/cart.ts`) ở mọi chế độ.
 * api: mọi module gọi REST; lỗi không tự chuyển sang mock.
 */
export type DataMode = "mock" | "hybrid" | "api";
const mode = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_MODE;
export const dataMode: DataMode =
  mode === "mock" || mode === "hybrid" ? mode : "api";
const catalogApi = dataMode !== "mock",
  allApi = dataMode === "api";
export const services = {
  products: catalogApi ? apiProducts : mockProducts,
  orders: allApi ? apiOrders : mockOrders,
  payments: allApi ? apiPayments : mockPayments,
  promotions: allApi ? apiPromotions : mockPromotions,
  loyalty: allApi ? apiLoyalty : mockLoyalty,
  barista: allApi ? apiBarista : mockBarista,
};
````

## frontend/src/services/mock.ts

<!-- snapshot-file {"path": "frontend/src/services/mock.ts", "encoding": "utf-8", "bytes": 8598, "characters": 8476, "sha256": "b14cc419ccfb3c4615c4d5ca36e4c8c20bff6e30c7af5c9413ed357b31f492ee"} -->
````text
import { demoProducts } from "./demo-products";
import type {
  ProductService,
  OrderService,
  PaymentService,
  PromotionService,
  LoyaltyService,
  BaristaOrderService,
} from "./contracts";
import type {
  Order,
  OrderStatus,
  Payment,
  RewardOption,
} from "@/types/domain";
import { cartTotal } from "@/types/domain";

const ORDERS = "brewlite-demo-orders-v1",
  PAYMENTS = "brewlite-demo-payments-v1";

const pause = () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 350));

const read = <T>(key: string, empty: T): T => {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return empty;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || "null") ?? empty;
  } catch {
    return empty;
  }
};

const write = (key: string, value: unknown) =>
  localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));

const orders = () => read<Order[]>(ORDERS, []);

const saveOrder = (order: Order) =>
  write(
    ORDERS,
    orders().map((o) => (o.id === order.id ? order : o)),
  );

const transitions: Record<OrderStatus, OrderStatus[]> = {
  PENDING: ["PAID", "PAYMENT_FAILED", "CANCELLED"],
  PAYMENT_FAILED: ["PENDING", "CANCELLED"],
  PAID: ["PREPARING", "CANCELLED"],
  PREPARING: ["READY", "CANCELLED"],
  READY: ["COMPLETED"],
  COMPLETED: [],
  CANCELLED: [],
};

export const mockProducts: ProductService = {
  async list() {
    await pause();
    return demoProducts;
  },
  async get(id) {
    await pause();
    return demoProducts.find((p) => p.id === id) || null;
  },
};

export const mockOrders: OrderService = {
  async create(userId, items, promotion) {
    await pause();
    if (!items.length) throw new Error("Giỏ hàng trống");
    const subtotal = cartTotal(items),
      discount = promotion?.discount || 0;
    const order: Order = {
      id: `BL-${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}`,
      userId,
      items: structuredClone(items),
      subtotal,
      discount,
      total: Math.max(0, subtotal - discount),
      promotionCode: promotion?.code,
      status: "PENDING",
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    write(ORDERS, [order, ...orders()]);
    return order;
  },
  async mine(userId) {
    await pause();
    return orders().filter((o) => o.userId === userId);
  },
  async get(id) {
    await pause();
    return orders().find((o) => o.id === id) || null;
  },
  async status(id) {
    await pause();
    return orders().find((o) => o.id === id)?.status || null;
  },
};

export const mockPayments: PaymentService = {
  async pay(orderId, method, idempotencyKey) {
    await pause();
    if (method !== "VNPAY_QR") {
      throw new Error("BrewLite chỉ hỗ trợ thanh toán VNPAY-QR");
    }
    const existing = read<Payment[]>(PAYMENTS, []).find(
      (p) => p.idempotencyKey === idempotencyKey,
    );
    if (existing) return existing;
    const order = orders().find((o) => o.id === orderId);
    if (!order) throw new Error("Không tìm thấy đơn hàng");
    if (!["PENDING", "PAYMENT_FAILED"].includes(order.status))
      throw new Error("Đơn hàng không thể thanh toán");
    if (order.status === "PAYMENT_FAILED") saveOrder({ ...order, status: "PENDING" });
    const payment: Payment = {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
      orderId,
      method,
      status: "PAID",
      idempotencyKey,
    };
    write(PAYMENTS, [...read<Payment[]>(PAYMENTS, []), payment]);
    saveOrder({
      ...order,
      status: "PAID",
      paymentMethod: method,
      error: undefined,
    });

    if (order.promotionCode?.startsWith("REDEEM-")) {
      const voucherKey = `vouchers_${order.userId}`;
      const list = read<Array<{ code: string; isUsed?: boolean }>>(voucherKey, []);
      const updated = list.map((voucher) =>
        voucher.code === order.promotionCode
          ? { ...voucher, isUsed: true }
          : voucher,
      );
      write(voucherKey, updated);
    }
    return payment;
  },
  async reconcile(orderId) {
    await pause();
    const payment = read<Payment[]>(PAYMENTS, [])
      .filter((item) => item.orderId === orderId)
      .at(-1);
    if (!payment) throw new Error("Không tìm thấy giao dịch VNPAY");
    return payment;
  },
};

export const mockPromotions: PromotionService = {
  async validate(code, subtotal) {
    await pause();
    const cleanCode = code.trim().toUpperCase();

    if (cleanCode.startsWith("REDEEM-")) {
      if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
        const allKeys = Object.keys(localStorage).filter((k) => k.startsWith("vouchers_"));
        let foundVoucher: { code: string; isUsed?: boolean; discountAmount: number } | null = null;

        for (const key of allKeys) {
          const list = read<Array<{ code: string; isUsed?: boolean; discountAmount: number }>>(key, []);
          const match = list.find((v) => v.code === cleanCode);
          if (match) {
            foundVoucher = match;
            break;
          }
        }

        if (foundVoucher && foundVoucher.isUsed) {
          throw new Error("Voucher này đã được sử dụng rồi!");
        }

        return {
          code: cleanCode,
          discount: Math.min(foundVoucher?.discountAmount || 20000, subtotal),
        };
      }
    }

    if (cleanCode !== "BREW10") throw new Error("Mã ưu đãi không hợp lệ");

    return {
      code: "BREW10",
      discount: Math.min(10000, Math.floor(subtotal * 0.1)),
    };
  },
};

export const mockLoyalty: LoyaltyService & {
  redeem?: (userId: string, option: RewardOption) => Promise<{ success: boolean; code: string; remainingPoints: number }>;
} = {
  async get(userId) {
    await pause();
    const earned = orders()
      .filter(
        (o) =>
          o.userId === userId &&
          ["PAID", "PREPARING", "READY", "COMPLETED"].includes(o.status),
      )
      .reduce((sum, o) => sum + Math.floor(o.total / 10000), 0);

    const spent = read<number>(`loyalty_spent_${userId}`, 0);
    return { points: Math.max(0, earned - spent) };
  },

  async redeem(userId: string, option: RewardOption) {
    await pause();
    const { points } = await this.get(userId);

    if (points < option.pointsCost) {
      throw new Error(`Cần tối thiểu ${option.pointsCost} điểm để đổi quà này.`);
    }

    const spent = read<number>(`loyalty_spent_${userId}`, 0);
    write(`loyalty_spent_${userId}`, spent + option.pointsCost);

    const code = `REDEEM-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase()}`;
    const vouchers = read<Array<{ code: string; title: string; discountAmount: number; isUsed?: boolean; createdAt: string }>>(`vouchers_${userId}`, []);

    vouchers.push({
      code,
      title: option.title,
      discountAmount: option.discountAmount,
      isUsed: false,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    });

    write(`vouchers_${userId}`, vouchers);

    return {
      success: true,
      code,
      remainingPoints: points - option.pointsCost,
    };
  },
};

export const mockBarista: BaristaOrderService = {
  async list() {
    await pause();
    return orders().filter((o) =>
      ["PAID", "PREPARING", "READY", "COMPLETED", "CANCELLED"].includes(o.status),
    );
  },
  async get(id) {
    await pause();
    return orders().find((o) => o.id === id) || null;
  },
  async transition(id, status) {
    await pause();
    const order = orders().find((o) => o.id === id);
    if (!order) throw new Error("Không tìm thấy đơn");
    if (!transitions[order.status].includes(status))
      throw new Error("Chuyển trạng thái không hợp lệ");
    if (status === "CANCELLED")
      throw new Error("Cần ghi lý do hủy đơn");
    const next: Order = {
      ...order,
      status,
      ...(status === "COMPLETED" ? { completedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : {}),
    };
    saveOrder(next);
    return next;
  },
  async cancel(id, reason) {
    await pause();
    const order = orders().find((o) => o.id === id);
    if (!order) throw new Error("Không tìm thấy đơn");
    if (!reason.trim()) throw new Error("Vui lòng ghi lý do hủy đơn");
    if (!["PENDING", "PAID", "PAYMENT_FAILED", "PREPARING"].includes(order.status))
      throw new Error("Không thể hủy đơn ở trạng thái hiện tại");
    const next: Order = { ...order, status: "CANCELLED", cancelReason: reason.trim() };
    saveOrder(next);
    return next;
  },
};

````
