## frontend/src/services/payment-intent.test.ts

<!-- snapshot-file {"path": "frontend/src/services/payment-intent.test.ts", "encoding": "utf-8", "bytes": 3645, "characters": 3645, "sha256": "812c79223eb86aaf12d99d53b27a4b21752bd73abe446ffc5e8970a1128b6f2b"} -->
````text
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import {
  clearCartAfterPaidOrder,
  parsePaymentIntent,
  parseHttpsPaymentUrl,
  paymentIntentKey,
  preparePaymentIntent,
  readPaymentIntent,
  removePaymentIntent,
  savePaymentIntent,
} from "./payment-intent";

const memoryStorage = () => {
  const values = new Map<string, string>();
  return {
    getItem: (key: string) => values.get(key) ?? null,
    setItem: (key: string, value: string) => values.set(key, value),
    removeItem: (key: string) => values.delete(key),
    values,
  };
};

test("payment intent stores only a non-empty idempotency key", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    parsePaymentIntent(JSON.stringify({ key: "payment-key" })),
    { key: "payment-key" },
  );
  assert.equal(parsePaymentIntent("not-json"), null);
  assert.equal(parsePaymentIntent(JSON.stringify({ key: "" })), null);
});

test("payment intent storage preserves the idempotency key for safe retry", () => {
  const storage = memoryStorage();
  savePaymentIntent("order-1", { key: "first-key" }, storage);
  assert.equal(readPaymentIntent("order-1", storage)?.key, "first-key");
  removePaymentIntent("order-1", storage);
  assert.equal(storage.values.has(paymentIntentKey("order-1")), false);
});

test("checkout resume reuses its key while a finalized retry creates a new key", () => {
  const storage = memoryStorage();
  savePaymentIntent("order-1", { key: "processing-key" }, storage);

  assert.deepEqual(
    preparePaymentIntent("order-1", true, storage, () => "must-not-run"),
    { key: "processing-key" },
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    preparePaymentIntent("order-1", false, storage, () => "fresh-key"),
    { key: "fresh-key" },
  );
  assert.equal(readPaymentIntent("order-1", storage)?.key, "fresh-key");
});

test("checkout resume is blocked when the current browser has no intent", () => {
  const storage = memoryStorage();
  assert.equal(preparePaymentIntent("order-2", true, storage), null);
});

test("gateway redirects accept HTTPS only", () => {
  assert.equal(
    parseHttpsPaymentUrl(
      "https://sandbox.vnpayment.vn/paymentv2/vpcpay.html?vnp_TxnRef=abc",
    ),
    "https://sandbox.vnpayment.vn/paymentv2/vpcpay.html?vnp_TxnRef=abc",
  );
  assert.equal(
    parseHttpsPaymentUrl("http://sandbox.vnpayment.vn/payment"),
    null,
  );
  assert.equal(parseHttpsPaymentUrl("javascript:alert(1)"), null);
  assert.equal(parseHttpsPaymentUrl("not-a-url"), null);
});

test("invalid stored payment intent is discarded", () => {
  const storage = memoryStorage();
  storage.setItem(paymentIntentKey("order-2"), "{");
  assert.equal(readPaymentIntent("order-2", storage), null);
  assert.equal(storage.values.has(paymentIntentKey("order-2")), false);
});

test("paid cart cleanup is scoped to the current payment intent", async () => {
  const storage = memoryStorage();
  let clearCalls = 0;
  const clear = async () => {
    clearCalls += 1;
    return true;
  };

  assert.equal(await clearCartAfterPaidOrder("old-order", clear, storage), false);
  assert.equal(clearCalls, 0);

  savePaymentIntent("current-order", { key: "current-key" }, storage);
  assert.equal(
    await clearCartAfterPaidOrder("current-order", async () => false, storage),
    false,
  );
  assert.equal(readPaymentIntent("current-order", storage)?.key, "current-key");

  assert.equal(
    await clearCartAfterPaidOrder("current-order", clear, storage),
    true,
  );
  assert.equal(clearCalls, 1);
  assert.equal(readPaymentIntent("current-order", storage), null);
});

<!-- snapshot-file {"path": "frontend/src/services/payment-intent.ts", "encoding": "utf-8", "bytes": 2599, "characters": 2540, "sha256": "f272a87c6e1ae13cefd3c6a1e4640079a0625fe38a2b6df7ee2990e32246ed49"} -->
````text
export type PaymentIntent = {
  key: string;
};

export const paymentIntentKey = (orderId: string) =>
  `brewlite-payment-${orderId}`;

export function parsePaymentIntent(raw: string | null): PaymentIntent | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    const value = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<PaymentIntent>;
    if (typeof value.key !== "string" || !value.key.trim()) return null;
    return { key: value.key };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Chỉ cho phép điều hướng sang cổng thanh toán HTTPS do backend trả về. */
export function parseHttpsPaymentUrl(value: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof value !== "string" || !value.trim()) return null;
  try {
    const url = new URL(value);
    return url.protocol === "https:" ? url.toString() : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export function readPaymentIntent(
  orderId: string,
  storage: Pick<Storage, "getItem" | "removeItem"> = sessionStorage,
) {
  const key = paymentIntentKey(orderId);
  const intent = parsePaymentIntent(storage.getItem(key));
  if (!intent) storage.removeItem(key);
  return intent;
}

export function savePaymentIntent(
  orderId: string,
  intent: PaymentIntent,
  storage: Pick<Storage, "setItem"> = sessionStorage,
) {
  storage.setItem(paymentIntentKey(orderId), JSON.stringify(intent));
}

/** Resume keeps the original idempotency key; a real retry gets a fresh one. */
export function preparePaymentIntent(
  orderId: string,
  resume: boolean,
  storage: Pick<Storage, "getItem" | "setItem" | "removeItem"> =
    sessionStorage,
  createKey: () => string = () => crypto.randomUUID(),
): PaymentIntent | null {
  if (resume) return readPaymentIntent(orderId, storage);
  const intent = { key: createKey() };
  savePaymentIntent(orderId, intent, storage);
  return intent;
}

export function removePaymentIntent(
  orderId: string,
  storage: Pick<Storage, "removeItem"> = sessionStorage,
) {
  storage.removeItem(paymentIntentKey(orderId));
}

/**
 * Chỉ xóa giỏ khi tab hiện tại thực sự khởi tạo payment của Order này.
 * Nhờ đó, mở lại URL success của một đơn cũ không thể xóa giỏ mới.
 */
export async function clearCartAfterPaidOrder(
  orderId: string,
  clearCart: () => Promise<boolean>,
  storage: Pick<Storage, "getItem" | "removeItem"> = sessionStorage,
) {
  if (!readPaymentIntent(orderId, storage)) return false;
  const cleared = await clearCart();
  if (!cleared) return false;
  removePaymentIntent(orderId, storage);
  return true;
}

````

import test, { before } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { cartTotal, itemKey, type CartItem } from '@/types/domain';

const data = new Map<string, string>();
const storage = {
  getItem: (k: string) => data.get(k) ?? null,
  setItem: (k: string, v: string) => { data.set(k, v); },
  removeItem: (k: string) => { data.delete(k); },
};
// Zustand persist đọc `window.localStorage`.
Object.defineProperty(globalThis, 'window', { value: { localStorage: storage }, configurable: true });
Object.defineProperty(globalThis, 'localStorage', { value: storage, configurable: true });
// Nạp store sau khi có localStorage giả để persist ghi được.
let useCart: typeof import('./cart').useCart;
before(async () => {
  ({ useCart } = await import('./cart'));
});

const sizes = [
  { code: 'S' as const, name: 'Nhỏ', extraPrice: 0, available: true },
  { code: 'M' as const, name: 'Vừa', extraPrice: 6000, available: true },
  { code: 'L' as const, name: 'Lớn', extraPrice: 12000, available: true },
];
const line = (size: CartItem['size'], quantity: number, ice = '100% đá'): CartItem => ({
  key: itemKey('coffee', size, ['cream'], ice, '100% chuẩn'),
  productId: 'coffee', name: 'Cà phê sữa', imageUrl: '', size,
  toppingIds: ['cream'], toppingNames: ['Kem sữa'],
  unitPrice: 39000 + sizes.find((s) => s.code === size)!.extraPrice,
  quantity, ice, sugar: '100% chuẩn', sizeOptions: sizes,
});
const reset = async () => { await useCart.getState().clear(); data.clear(); };

test('same configuration merges quantity, different configuration adds a line', async () => {
  await reset();
  const cart = useCart.getState();
  cart.add(line('M', 2));
  cart.add(line('M', 1));
  assert.equal(useCart.getState().items.length, 1);
  assert.equal(useCart.getState().items[0].quantity, 3);
  cart.add(line('M', 1, '30% đá'));
  assert.equal(useCart.getState().items.length, 2);
  assert.equal(cartTotal(useCart.getState().items), 4 * 45000);
});

test('quantity is clamped to 1..99 and merging never exceeds 99', async () => {
  await reset();
  const cart = useCart.getState();
  cart.add(line('S', 98));
  cart.add(line('S', 5));
  const key = useCart.getState().items[0].key;
  assert.equal(useCart.getState().items[0].quantity, 99);
  cart.setQuantity(key, 0);
  assert.equal(useCart.getState().items[0].quantity, 1);
  cart.setQuantity(key, 2.7);
  assert.equal(useCart.getState().items[0].quantity, 2);
});

test('changing size recomputes the key and merges into an existing line', async () => {
  await reset();
  const cart = useCart.getState();
  cart.add(line('S', 1));
  cart.add(line('L', 2));
  const small = useCart.getState().items[0];
  cart.changeSize(small.key, 'M', 45000);
  assert.deepEqual(useCart.getState().items.map((i) => i.size), ['M', 'L']);
  assert.equal(useCart.getState().items[0].key, itemKey('coffee', 'M', ['cream'], '100% đá', '100% chuẩn'));
  cart.changeSize(useCart.getState().items[0].key, 'L', 51000);
  assert.equal(useCart.getState().items.length, 1);
  assert.equal(useCart.getState().items[0].quantity, 3);
});

test('remove, clear and persistence to localStorage', async () => {
  await reset();
  const cart = useCart.getState();
  cart.add(line('S', 1));
  cart.add(line('M', 1));
  cart.setPromoCode('BREW10');
  assert.match(data.get('brewlite-cart-v1') ?? '', /BREW10/);
  cart.remove(useCart.getState().items[0].key);
  assert.equal(useCart.getState().items.length, 1);
  assert.equal(await cart.clear(), true);
  assert.equal(useCart.getState().items.length, 0);
  assert.equal(useCart.getState().promoCode, '');
});

## frontend/src/stores/cart.ts

<!-- snapshot-file {"path": "frontend/src/stores/cart.ts", "encoding": "utf-8", "bytes": 4231, "characters": 4094, "sha256": "a11d1161daceedb092c6068d1d312629ded7b9f3a6fcc1bafd5d91f6165bea50"} -->
````text
"use client";
import { create } from "zustand";
import { persist } from "zustand/middleware";
import type { CartItem, ProductSize } from "@/types/domain";
import { itemKey } from "@/types/domain";
/**
 * Giỏ hàng chỉ nằm ở trình duyệt (Zustand persist → localStorage), dùng chung cho khách và người đã đăng nhập.
 * Giá ở đây chỉ để hiển thị: `POST /orders` nhận cấu hình món và backend tính lại giá, kiểm tồn kho.
 */
type CartStore = {
  items: CartItem[];
  promoCode: string;
  add: (item: CartItem) => void;
  setQuantity: (key: string, quantity: number) => void;
  changeSize: (key: string, size: ProductSize["code"], unitPrice: number) => void;
  remove: (key: string) => void;
  /** Trả Promise để luồng thanh toán (`clearCartAfterPaidOrder`) chờ xóa xong. */
  clear: () => Promise<boolean>;
  setPromoCode: (code: string) => void;
};
export const MAX_QUANTITY = 99;
const clampQuantity = (n: number) =>
  Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_QUANTITY, Math.floor(n)));
/** Cùng `key` (cùng món + size + topping + đá + đường + ghi chú) thì cộng số lượng thay vì thêm dòng. */
const merge = (items: CartItem[], item: CartItem) =>
  items.some((i) => i.key === item.key)
    ? items.map((i) =>
        i.key === item.key
          ? { ...i, quantity: clampQuantity(i.quantity + item.quantity) }
          : i,
      )
    : [...items, { ...item, quantity: clampQuantity(item.quantity) }];
export const useCart = create<CartStore>()(
  persist(
    (set) => ({
      items: [],
      promoCode: "",
      add: (item) => set((s) => ({ items: merge(s.items, item) })),
      setQuantity: (key, quantity) =>
        set((s) => ({
          items: s.items.map((i) =>
            i.key === key ? { ...i, quantity: clampQuantity(quantity) } : i,
          ),
        })),
      // Đổi size tạo khóa mới; trùng một dòng khác thì gộp, không thì giữ nguyên vị trí.
      changeSize: (key, size, unitPrice) =>
        set((s) => {
          const current = s.items.find((i) => i.key === key);
          if (!current || current.size === size) return s;
          const next: CartItem = {
            ...current,
            size,
            unitPrice,
            key: itemKey(
              current.productId,
              size,
              current.toppingIds,
              current.ice,
              current.sugar,
              current.note,
            ),
          };
          const index = s.items.indexOf(current),
            rest = s.items.filter((i) => i.key !== key);
          if (rest.some((i) => i.key === next.key))
            return { items: merge(rest, next) };
          rest.splice(index, 0, next);
          return { items: rest };
        }),
      remove: (key) =>
        set((s) => ({ items: s.items.filter((i) => i.key !== key) })),
      clear: async () => {
        set({ items: [], promoCode: "" });
        return true;
      },
      setPromoCode: (promoCode) => set({ promoCode }),
    }),
    {
      name: "brewlite-cart-v1",
      version: 2,
      partialize: (s) => ({ items: s.items, promoCode: s.promoCode }),
      // Bản cũ có thể chứa giỏ lấy từ server (key là UUID dòng, có `issue`): tính lại key và bỏ trường server.
      migrate: (persisted) => {
        const state = (persisted ?? {}) as Partial<CartStore>;
        const items = (state.items ?? []).map(
          (i): CartItem => ({
            key: itemKey(i.productId, i.size, i.toppingIds, i.ice, i.sugar, i.note),
            productId: i.productId,
            name: i.name,
            imageUrl: i.imageUrl,
            size: i.size,
            toppingIds: i.toppingIds,
            toppingNames: i.toppingNames,
            unitPrice: i.unitPrice,
            quantity: i.quantity,
            ice: i.ice,
            sugar: i.sugar,
            note: i.note,
            sizeOptions: i.sizeOptions,
          }),
        );
        return {
          items: items.reduce<CartItem[]>(merge, []),
          promoCode: state.promoCode ?? "",
        } as CartStore;
      },
    },
  ),
);

````

export type Role = "CUSTOMER" | "BARISTA";
export type User = {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  name: string;
  role: Role;
  loyaltyPoints: number;
};
export type ProductSize = {
  code: "S" | "M" | "L";
  name: string;
  extraPrice: number;
  available: boolean;
  isDefault?: boolean;
};
export type Topping = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  extraPrice: number;
  available: boolean;
};
export type Product = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  price: number;
  imageUrl: string;
  stock: number;
  category: string;
  sizes: ProductSize[];
  toppings: Topping[];
};
export type CartItem = {
  key: string;
  productId: string;
  name: string;
  imageUrl: string;
  size: ProductSize["code"];
  toppingIds: string[];
  toppingNames: string[];
  unitPrice: number;
  quantity: number;
  ice: string;
  sugar: string;
  note?: string;
  /** Các size của món, để đổi size ngay trong giỏ. */
  sizeOptions?: ProductSize[];
};
export type OrderStatus =
  | "PENDING"
  | "PAID"
  | "PAYMENT_FAILED"
  | "PREPARING"
  | "READY"
  | "COMPLETED"
  | "CANCELLED";
export type PaymentMethod = "WALLET" | "CARD" | "VNPAY_QR";
export type OrderItem = CartItem;
export type Order = {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  items: OrderItem[];
  subtotal: number;
  discount: number;
  total: number;
  promotionCode?: string;
  status: OrderStatus;
  paymentMethod?: PaymentMethod;
  createdAt: string;
  completedAt?: string;
  error?: string;
  customerName?: string;
  cancelReason?: string;
};
export type Payment = {
  id: string;
  orderId: string;
  method: PaymentMethod;
  status: "PROCESSING" | "PAID" | "PAYMENT_FAILED" | "UNKNOWN";
  idempotencyKey: string;
  paymentUrl?: string;
  expiresAt?: string;
};
export type Promotion = { code: string; discount: number };
export type LoyaltyPoints = { points: number };

export const money = (n: number) =>
  new Intl.NumberFormat("vi-VN").format(n) + " ₫";
export const lineTotal = (item: CartItem) => item.unitPrice * item.quantity;
export const cartTotal = (items: CartItem[]) =>
  items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + lineTotal(item), 0);
export const itemKey = (
  id: string,
  size: string,
  toppings: string[],
  ice: string,
  sugar: string,
  note = "",
) =>
  [id, size, [...toppings].sort().join(","), ice, sugar, note.trim()].join("|");

export interface RewardOption {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  discountAmount: number;
  pointsCost: number;
  description: string;
}

export const REWARD_OPTIONS: RewardOption[] = [

````text
import os
import shutil
import sys
import re
from datetime import datetime

# Paths
output_path = os.path.join('docs', 'assignment2', 'BREWLITE_PROJECT_FULL_EXPORT.md')
root_output_path = 'BREWLITE_PROJECT_FULL_EXPORT.md'

# Exclude patterns
exclude_dirs = {'.git', 'node_modules', '.next', 'dist', 'build', '.turbo', 'coverage', '.vscode', '.idea', '__pycache__'}
exclude_exts = {'.png', '.webp', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.gif', '.ico', '.pdf', '.docx', '.zip', '.gz', '.tar', '.log', '.exe', '.dll', '.map', '.tsbuildinfo', '.pyc'}
exclude_files = {'package-lock.json', '.env'}

def get_lang(path):
    filename = os.path.basename(path).lower()
    if filename == 'dockerfile':
        return 'dockerfile'
    if filename in ['.gitignore', '.dockerignore']:
        return 'text'
    if filename == '.prettierrc':
        return 'json'
    ext = os.path.splitext(path)[1].lower()
    mapping = {
        '.ts': 'typescript',
        '.tsx': 'tsx',
        '.js': 'javascript',
        '.jsx': 'jsx',
        '.cjs': 'javascript',
        '.mjs': 'javascript',
        '.json': 'json',
        '.md': 'markdown',
        '.css': 'css',
        '.html': 'html',
        '.sql': 'sql',
        '.prisma': 'prisma',
        '.yml': 'yaml',
        '.yaml': 'yaml',
        '.puml': 'plantuml',
        '.sh': 'bash',
        '.ps1': 'powershell',
        '.svg': 'xml',
        '.txt': 'text',
        '.toml': 'toml',
        '.py': 'python',
        '.example': 'bash',
    }
    return mapping.get(ext, 'text')

def sort_key(p):
    # Root configs and main docs
    if p in ['README.md', 'AGENTS.md', 'TV4_CODE_GIAI_THICH.md', 'docker-compose.yml', 'package.json', '.env.example', '.gitignore']:
        order = ['README.md', 'AGENTS.md', 'TV4_CODE_GIAI_THICH.md', 'docker-compose.yml', 'package.json', '.env.example', '.gitignore']
        return (0, order.index(p) if p in order else 99, p)
    if p.startswith('docs/'):
        if '/' not in p[5:]:  # docs/*.md
            return (1, 0, p)
        elif p.startswith('docs/requirements/'):
            return (1, 1, p)
        elif p.startswith('docs/diagrams/'):
            return (1, 2, p)
        elif p.startswith('docs/architecture/'):
            return (1, 3, p)
        elif p.startswith('docs/assignment2/'):
            return (1, 4, p)
        else:
            return (1, 5, p)
    if p.startswith('backend/prisma/'):
        if p == 'backend/prisma/schema.prisma':
            return (2, 0, p)
        if 'seed' in p:
            return (2, 1, p)
        return (2, 2, p)
    if p.startswith('backend/'):
        if p.startswith('backend/src/'):
            return (3, 1, p)
        if p.startswith('backend/test/') or p.startswith('backend/scripts/'):
            return (3, 2, p)
        return (3, 0, p)  # backend configs
    if p.startswith('frontend/'):
        if p.startswith('frontend/src/'):
            return (4, 1, p)
        if p.startswith('frontend/e2e/'):
            return (4, 2, p)
        if p.startswith('frontend/public/'):
            return (4, 3, p)
        return (4, 0, p)  # frontend configs
    if p.startswith('stitch/'):
        return (5, 0, p)
    if p.startswith('scripts/'):
        return (6, 0, p)
    return (7, 0, p)

def make_anchor(index, path):
    clean = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]', '-', path).lower()
    return f'file-{index}-{clean}'

def get_max_consecutive_backticks(content):
    bt = chr(96)
    max_c = 0
    curr = 0
    for ch in content:
        if ch == bt:
            curr += 1
            if curr > max_c:
                max_c = curr
        else:
            curr = 0
    return max_c

def build_tree(path='.', prefix=''):
    entries = sorted(os.listdir(path))
    filtered = []
    for e in entries:
        if e in exclude_dirs or e in exclude_files:
            continue
        if 'FULL_EXPORT' in e:
            continue
        filtered.append(e)
    
    lines = []
    for i, entry in enumerate(filtered):
        is_last = (i == len(filtered) - 1)
        connector = '└── ' if is_last else '├── '
        full_path = os.path.join(path, entry)
        if os.path.isdir(full_path):
            lines.append(f'{prefix}{connector}{entry}/')
            sub_prefix = prefix + ('    ' if is_last else '│   ')
            lines.extend(build_tree(full_path, sub_prefix))
        else:
            lines.append(f'{prefix}{connector}{entry}')
    return lines

print('Collecting files...')

for root, dirs, files in os.walk('.'):

        rel = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(root, f)).replace('\\', '/')

        ext = os.path.splitext(f)[1].lower()
        if ext in {'.png', '.webp', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.gif', '.ico', '.pdf', '.docx'}:

        elif f in exclude_files or ext in exclude_exts:
            continue
        else:
            files_to_export.append(rel)

files_to_export.sort(key=sort_key)

    stats['total_lines'] += lines

    file_meta.append({
        'path': p,

    })

"""Export the current working tree into one Markdown file, including binary assets."""
import base64
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SKIP_DIRS = {'.git', '.codex', '.agents', '.aws', 'node_modules', '.next', 'dist',
             'build', 'coverage', '__pycache__', 'playwright-report', 'test-results'}


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT).decode('utf-8')


def excluded(path):
    name = path.name.lower()
    return (bool(set(path.parts) & SKIP_DIRS)
            or 'FULL_EXPORT' in path.name.upper()
            or (name.startswith('.env') and name != '.env.example')
            or name in {'.npmrc', '.pypirc', 'credentials', 'id_rsa', 'id_ed25519'}
            or path.suffix.lower() in {'.pem', '.key', '.pfx', '.p12', '.log', '.pyc', '.tsbuildinfo'})


def main():
    now = datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=7)))
    output = ROOT / f'BREWLITE_PROJECT_FULL_EXPORT_{now:%Y-%m-%d}.md'
    candidates = sorted(set(filter(None, git('ls-files', '-z', '--cached', '--others',
                                              '--exclude-standard').split('\0'))))
    records, skipped = [], []
    for name in candidates:
        path = ROOT / name
        if excluded(Path(name)):
            skipped.append(name)
            continue
        if path.is_symlink() or not path.resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT):
            raise RuntimeError(f'Unsupported link outside snapshot: {name}')
        if not path.is_file():
            skipped.append(name)
            continue
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        try:
            body = raw.decode('utf-8')
            if '\0' in body:
                raise ValueError('binary content')
            encoding = 'utf-8'
        except (UnicodeDecodeError, ValueError):
            body = base64.encodebytes(raw).decode('ascii')
            encoding = 'base64'
        meta = {'path': name, 'encoding': encoding, 'bytes': len(raw),
                'characters': len(body), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
        records.append((meta, body))

    with output.open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as stream:
        stream.write('# BrewLite — bản xuất nội dung project\n\n')
        stream.write(f'Thời gian: {now.isoformat(timespec="seconds")} (UTC+07:00).\n\n')
        stream.write(f'Nhánh: `{git("branch", "--show-current").strip()}`; '
                     f'commit: `{git("rev-parse", "HEAD").strip()}`.\n\n')
        stream.write('Nội dung lấy từ cây làm việc hiện tại, gồm cả thay đổi chưa commit. '
                     'Văn bản UTF-8 được giữ nguyên; ảnh, Word và file nhị phân được nhúng Base64 '
                     '(giải mã Base64 để lấy lại file gốc). Mỗi file có SHA-256 để đối chiếu.\n\n')
        stream.write('Phạm vi: file Git theo dõi và file mới không bị Git ignore. '
                     'Loại .git, thư viện, build/cache, cấu hình bí mật, log và bản xuất cũ; '
                     'giữ .env.example và package-lock.json. Không xuất dữ liệu DB đang chạy. '
                     'Đây là bản chụp nội dung, không phải kết quả nghiệm thu ứng dụng.\n\n')
        stream.write(f'Tổng cộng: {len(records)} file; '
                     f'{sum(m["encoding"] == "base64" for m, _ in records)} file Base64.\n\n')
        stream.write('## Mục lục\n\n')
        for index, (meta, _) in enumerate(records, 1):
            stream.write(f'{index}. [{meta["path"]}](#file-{index}) — {meta["bytes"]} bytes; {meta["encoding"]}\n')
        stream.write('\n## File bị loại trong danh sách Git\n\n')
        for name in skipped:
            stream.write(f'- `{name}`\n')
        stream.write('\nCác file bị Git ignore không được duyệt nội dung.\n\n')
        for index, (meta, body) in enumerate(records, 1):
            fence = '`' * max(4, 1 + max((len(x) for x in re.findall(r'`+', body)), default=0))
            stream.write(f'<a id="file-{index}"></a>\n\n## {meta["path"]}\n\n')
            stream.write('<!-- snapshot-file ' + json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False) + ' -->\n')
            stream.write(f'{fence}{"base64" if meta["encoding"] == "base64" else "text"}\n')
            stream.write(body)
            stream.write(f'\n{fence}\n\n')

    # Read the artifact back and compare every embedded file against the working tree.
    exported = output.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
    cursor = 0
    for expected, _ in records:
        start = exported.index('<!-- snapshot-file ', cursor) + len('<!-- snapshot-file ')
        end = exported.index(' -->\n', start)
        meta = json.loads(exported[start:end])
        body_start = exported.index('\n', end + len(' -->\n')) + 1
        body = exported[body_start:body_start + meta['characters']]
        raw = base64.b64decode(body) if meta['encoding'] == 'base64' else body.encode('utf-8')
        assert meta == expected
        assert len(raw) == meta['bytes']
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == meta['sha256']
        assert raw == (ROOT / meta['path']).read_bytes(), meta['path']
        cursor = body_start + meta['characters']
    print(json.dumps({'file': output.name, 'files_verified': len(records),
                      'binary_files': sum(m['encoding'] == 'base64' for m, _ in records),
                      'bytes': output.stat().st_size}, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

````

"""Smoke test the local Compose stack. Creates one disposable CUSTOMER account."""
import http.cookiejar
import json
import os
import secrets
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

BASE = os.getenv('BREWLITE_SMOKE_API', 'http://localhost:3001/api').rstrip('/')
if urllib.parse.urlparse(BASE).hostname not in {'localhost', '127.0.0.1'}:
    raise SystemExit('Smoke test chỉ chạy với API cục bộ')
ORIGIN = 'http://localhost:3000'

def client():
    jar = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
    return urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(jar)), jar

def call(opener, path, method='GET', body=None, origin=ORIGIN):
    headers = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
    if method != 'GET' and origin is not None:
        headers['Origin'] = origin
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        BASE + path,
        data=json.dumps(body or {}).encode() if method != 'GET' else None,
        headers=headers,
        method=method,
    )
    try:
        with opener.open(request, timeout=5) as response:
            return response.status, json.load(response)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        return error.code, json.load(error)

opener, _ = client()
status, products = call(opener, '/products')
assert status == 200 and products and 'stock' in products[0]
status, detail = call(opener, '/products/' + products[0]['id'])
assert status == 200 and len(detail['sizes']) == 3

email = 'smoke-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:10] + '@example.test'
password = 'A' + secrets.token_urlsafe(16) + '9'
customer, cookies = client()
assert call(customer, '/auth/register', 'POST', {'name': 'Test', 'email': email, 'password': password, 'role': 'BARISTA'})[0] == 400
assert call(customer, '/auth/register', 'POST', {'name': 'Test', 'email': 'bad', 'password': password})[0] == 400
status, registered = call(customer, '/auth/register', 'POST', {'name': 'Test Customer', 'email': email, 'password': password})
assert status == 201 and registered['user']['role'] == 'CUSTOMER'
assert 'accessToken' not in registered and 'passwordHash' not in registered['user']
assert len(list(cookies)) == 1 and list(cookies)[0].has_nonstandard_attr('HttpOnly')
old_cookie = list(cookies)[0].value
assert call(customer, '/auth/me')[0] == 200
assert call(customer, '/barista/dashboard')[0] == 403
assert call(customer, '/auth/register', 'POST', {'name': 'Test', 'email': email, 'password': password})[0] == 409
assert call(customer, '/auth/logout', 'POST')[0] == 201
assert call(customer, '/auth/me')[0] == 401
# A copied JWT must also fail after logout, even if a client ignores Set-Cookie deletion.
stale_request = urllib.request.Request(BASE + '/auth/me', headers={'Cookie': f'brewlite_session={old_cookie}'})
try:
    urllib.request.urlopen(stale_request, timeout=5)
    raise AssertionError('Old session was accepted after logout')
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    assert error.code == 401
assert call(customer, '/auth/login', 'POST', {'email': email, 'password': 'WrongPassword123'})[0] == 401
assert call(customer, '/auth/login', 'POST', {'email': email, 'password': password})[0] == 201
assert call(customer, '/auth/logout', 'POST', origin='https://other.example')[0] == 403

config = {}
for line in Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1].joinpath('.env').read_text().splitlines():
    if '=' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
        key, value = line.split('=', 1)
        config[key] = value.strip('"')
if config.get('BARISTA_EMAIL') and config.get('BARISTA_PASSWORD'):
    staff, _ = client()
    status, login = call(staff, '/auth/login', 'POST', {'email': config['BARISTA_EMAIL'], 'password': config['BARISTA_PASSWORD']})
    assert status == 201 and login['user']['role'] == 'BARISTA'
    assert call(staff, '/barista/dashboard')[0] == 200
print('PASS: Products list/detail, auth validation/session/logout, CSRF, CUSTOMER 403, BARISTA 200')

````

## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a refined digital flagship for artisanal Vietnamese coffee culture. Drawing from modern editorial minimalism intertwined with tactile, warm hospitality, the interface marries the timeless ritual of phin brewing with friction-free modern digital commerce.

### Brand Personality & Core Tenets
- **Artisanal & Sophisticated:** Evoking the aroma of slow-dripped Robusta, dark roast blends, and warm condensed milk without clutter or cliché. High-contrast typography paired with measured negative space conveys curation and culinary precision.
- **Warm & Welcoming:** Grounded in Vietnamese cafe culture (*cà phê la cà*), the emotional tone is hospitable, sensory, and approachable rather than cold or aloof.
- **Convenient & Trustworthy:** Streamlined ordering, transparent order progress, and seamless cashless checkouts evoke certainty and speed during peak morning and midday rush hours.

### Visual Style Movement
The design blends **Warm Editorial Minimalism** with soft **Tactile Depth**. It uses crisp, high-contrast serif headers paired with clear, humanist body copy, placed atop creamy, textured backgrounds. Surfaces rely on warm neutral borders, subtle elevation steps, and carefully balanced inner margins to evoke tactile menus, packaging labels, and contemporary boutique cafe interiors.

## Colors

The palette draws directly from the roasting spectrum, slow phin extractions, and natural cream pairings. The default display mode is light, capturing an open, sunlit cafe ambience.

### Palette Roles & Application

- **Primary (`#4B2E2B` - Deep Espresso):** The core anchor. Used for primary call-to-actions, prominent headers, navigation accents, active states, and dominant visual weights.
- **Secondary (`#6F4E37` - Roast Brown):** Supporting structural color. Applied to category headers, sub-navigation tabs, step indicators, and interactive borders.
- **Tertiary (`#C58B55` - Warm Caramel):** Used selectively for highlights, promotion badges, loyalty point rewards, order confirmation cues, and key conversion accents.
- **Canvas & Surfaces:**
  - Base Background: `#FAF7F2` (Pure Warm Cream) creates an organic canvas softer than harsh sterile white.
  - Card & Container Fill: `#FFFFFF` (Surface White) provides pristine contrast for drink imagery and product modifiers.
  - Muted Inset / Subtle Fill: `#EFE6DA` (Soft Beige) provides structure for disabled fields, nested card groupings, and item counter controls.
- **Typographic Contrast:**
  - Primary Text: `#27211E` (Dark Roast Charcoal) ensures WCAG AAA accessibility across light surfaces.
  - Secondary Text: `#786F69` (Subtle Earth) reserved for metadata, descriptions, pricing comparisons, and phin brew origin tags.
  - Border & Dividers: `#E8DFD5` creates clean structural separation without high-contrast visual noise.
- **Feedback & Semantics:**
  - Success: `#2E7D5B` (Botanical Green) for payment complete, loyalty verified, and customized additions.
  - Warning: `#D99836` (Golden Toast) for low stock, peak queue wait-times, and table transfer alerts.
  - Error: `#C84C4C` (Red Ochre) for payment failures, validation errors, and item stock-outs.

## Typography

Typography balances heritage and practical mobile clarity. All diacritics and complex tone marks inherent to Vietnamese receive ample vertical clearance via relaxed line heights.

### Editorial Headings (`Noto Serif`)
- Reserved for page titles, category headers (e.g., *Cà Phê Phin Truyền Thống*, *Trà & Tráng Miệng*), promotional banners, and receipt headlines.
- Adds an editorial, curated aura reminiscent of high-end culinary publications and historical Vietnamese coffee salons.

### Functional Body & Labels (`Be Vietnam Pro`)
- Designed natively for the Vietnamese writing system, preventing tone clip issues and uneven vowel rendering.
- Applied across all interactive elements, customization controls (ice levels, sweetness options, milk choices), cart tallies, and transactional checkout flows.
- Maintains strict legibility at dense mobile viewports with weights spanning Regular (400) for descriptions, Medium (500) for chips and buttons, and Semi-Bold (600) for item titles and pricing.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built upon an 8pt baseline rhythm with responsive adaptation targeted at mobile-first in-store table QR scanning, as well as desktop pre-ordering.

### Grid & Viewport Adaptation
- **Mobile (< 768px):** Single-column fluid feed with a fixed sticky bottom cart/action drawer. Canvas padding uses `margin-mobile` (16px), with `gutter-mobile` (12px) separating menu item cards in two-column grid sections.
- **Tablet (768px - 1024px):** 8-column layout. Split layout displays categorized menus on the left 5 columns, with persistent checkout orders on the right 3 columns.
- **Desktop (> 1024px):** Max container width bounded at 1200px centered. 12-column layout with 24px gutters and 32px canvas margins. Category anchor navigation fixes to the left side, menu grids occupy the central region, and active cart/receipt summaries dock to the right.

### Vertical Rhythm
Section transitions use `space-xl` (40px) to give menu categories breathing room. Card internals preserve a minimum of `space-md` (16px) padding to prevent tap target crowding around quantity adjusters and customization pills.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual depth is conveyed through delicate, warm-tinted ambient shadows and structured surface borders rather than abrupt heavy drops. Shadows are tinted with `#4B2E2B` at low opacities to echo warm ambient cafe lighting.

### Elevation Hierarchy
- **Level 0 (Flat / Canvas):** Applied to the base canvas (`#FAF7F2`) and inactive option containers. Completely flat, bounded by a 1px solid `#E8DFD5` border.
- **Level 1 (Resting Cards):** Applied to product cards, drink item listings, and modifier groups. Features a white background with a subtle ambient tint: `box-shadow: 0 2px 8px -2px rgba(75, 46, 43, 0.05), 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(75, 46, 43, 0.03)` with a 1px border in `#E8DFD5`.
- **Level 2 (Hover & Active Surfaces):** Used when hovering cards or tapping selectable add-on options. Shadow deepens: `box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -4px rgba(75, 46, 43, 0.08), 0 4px 8px -2px rgba(75, 46, 43, 0.04)`. The border shifts to `#C58B55` or `#4B2E2B`.
- **Level 3 (Floating Bars & Bottom Drawers):** Reserved for sticky mobile checkout trays, floating order progress pill badges, and option customization sheets: `box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -6px rgba(75, 46, 43, 0.12), 0 4px 12px 0 rgba(75, 46, 43, 0.06)`.
- **Level 4 (Modal Dialogs & Payment Confirmations):** Overlays with high visual focus, centered over a 40% opacity espresso-toned backdrop blur: `box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -12px rgba(39, 33, 30, 0.25)`.

## Shapes

The shape vocabulary uses gentle, organic geometry (level 2 roundedness), mirroring the smoothed rim of ceramic phin cups and custom cafe glassware.

### Curvature Scale
- **Base Components (`rounded`, 8px / 0.5rem):** Form inputs, modifier choice tiles, counter increment buttons, and table QR code cards.
- **Mid-Tier Elements (`rounded-lg`, 16px / 1rem):** Coffee card containers, loyalty stamp cards, modal confirmation boxes, and banner displays.
- **Containers & Drawers (`rounded-xl`, 24px / 1.5rem):** Floating bottom checkout bars, sliding product modifier sheets, and hero promotional showcases.
- **Pills (`rounded-full`):** Filter tags, sugar/ice selection chips, status badges (e.g., *Đang pha chế*, *Đã thanh toán*), and floating action triggers.

## Components

All components are tailored for Vietnamese language strings, ensuring sufficient horizontal padding for compound words (e.g., *Thanh toán ngay*, *Tùy chỉnh món*).

### Buttons
- **Primary Action (Thanh toán / Thêm vào giỏ):** Background `#4B2E2B`, text `#FFFFFF`, rounded 8px (`rounded`), font weight Semi-Bold (600). Hover shifts background to `#6F4E37`. Minimum height 48px for effortless thumb tap targets.
- **Secondary Action (Xem lại đơn / Chọn lại):** Background `#EFE6DA`, text `#4B2E2B`, border 1px solid `#E8DFD5`. Hover transitions background to `#E8DFD5`.
- **Accent Action (Áp dụng ưu đãi / Tích điểm):** Background `#C58B55`, text `#FFFFFF`. Used for high-value transactional perks.

### Chips & Attribute Selectors (Mức đường, Mức đá, Loại sữa)
- **Unselected:** Border 1px solid `#E8DFD5`, background `#FFFFFF`, text `#786F69`. Shape is pill-shaped (`rounded-full`) or soft rectangle (`rounded`).
- **Selected:** Border 1.5px solid `#4B2E2B`, background `#FAF7F2`, text `#4B2E2B`, font weight 600. Accompanied by a subtle caramel checkmark indicator or bold ring highlight.

### Coffee Menu Cards
- Elevated at Level 1, framed by a 1px `#E8DFD5` border, rounded 16px (`rounded-lg`).
- High-contrast layout: Crisp square or 4:3 product photography on top or left, followed by the item title in `title-md` (`Be Vietnam Pro`), origin/blend note in `body-sm` (`#786F69`), and currency-formatted price (e.g., `45.000 ₫`) anchored in `title-md` `#4B2E2B`.
- Integrated quick-add button (`+`) positioned at the bottom right corner in `#4B2E2B` with inverse white icon.

### Form Inputs & Voucher Fields
- Background `#FFFFFF`, border 1.5px solid `#E8DFD5`, border-radius 8px (`rounded`), text `#27211E`.
- Focus state: Border transitions to `#4B2E2B` with a 2px outer aura ring in `rgba(197, 139, 85, 0.25)`. Error state uses `#C84C4C` border and helper text.
- Text placeholders rendered in `#786F69` (e.g., *Nhập mã giảm giá...*, *Ghi chú cho quán...*).

### Checkboxes & Radio Controls (Topping & Milk Add-ons)
- 20px x 20px control footprint with 8px clearance.
- Checked state fills with `#4B2E2B` carrying a pure white icon mark.
- Unchecked state features an inset white background with 1.5px `#E8DFD5` outline.

### Quantity Stepper Controls
- Encased pill or compact box in `#EFE6DA`.
- Plus/minus buttons in `#4B2E2B` (hovering to `#6F4E37`), sandwiching a center numerical count in `title-sm` `#27211E`.

### Order Status & Payment Badge (Trạng thái đơn hàng)
- Compact pill element (`rounded-full`) with an 8px colored dot and `label-sm` copy.
- Unpaid/Pending: `#FAF7F2` background, `#D99836` border and text (*Chờ thanh toán*).
- Processing/Brewing: `#FAF7F2` background, `#C58B55` border and text (*Đang pha chế*).
- Ready/Delivered: `#FAF7F2` background, `#2E7D5B` border and text (*Mời nhận món*).
````

<div class="w-full h-1.5 rounded-full bg-surface-container-high overflow-hidden">

<span class="font-label-sm text-label-sm text-on-surface-variant">Kho còn 12 hộp 1L</span>
</div>
<div class="p-space-sm rounded-lg bg-surface-container-low flex flex-col gap-1">
<div class="flex justify-between items-center font-label-md text-label-md">
<span class="text-on-surface">Thạch đào giòn</span>
<span class="text-emerald-700 font-bold">Đầy đủ</span>
</div>
<div class="w-full h-1.5 rounded-full bg-surface-container-high overflow-hidden">

</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Quick Action Guide -->
<div class="p-space-md rounded-xl bg-surface-container-lowest shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between gap-space-sm">
<div>
<h4 class="font-title-md text-title-md text-primary flex items-center gap-2">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-secondary">verified_user</span>
            Quy chuẩn an toàn quầy bar
          </h4>
<p class="mt-1 font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant leading-relaxed">
            Kiểm tra áp suất máy pha Espresso ở mức 9 bar. Sau mỗi 10 cữ trích xuất, xả vòi hơi và lau chùi bã cà phê bằng khăn vi sợi chuyên dụng.
          </p>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-surface-container">
<span class="font-label-sm text-label-sm text-secondary font-semibold">Quy trình HACCP chuẩn</span>
<span class="font-label-sm text-label-sm text-on-surface-variant">Kiểm định: 13:00 Hôm nay</span>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
<!-- Cancellation & Exception Modal (SCREEN 17) -->
<div class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-primary/60 backdrop-blur-sm hidden" id="cancellation-modal">
<div class="w-full max-w-lg bg-surface-container-lowest rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-space-lg flex flex-col gap-space-md animate-in fade-in zoom-in duration-200">
<!-- Modal Header -->
<div class="flex items-start justify-between pb-space-sm border-b border-surface-container">
<div class="flex items-center gap-3">
<div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-error-container text-on-error-container flex items-center justify-center">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-2xl">report</span>
</div>

<p class="font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant">Ghi nhận log bất khả kháng cho mã <span class="font-bold text-primary" id="modal-order-id">#BL-1042</span></p>
</div>
</div>
<button class="text-on-surface-variant hover:text-primary transition-colors" onclick="closeCancellationModal()">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-2xl">close</span>
</button>
</div>
<!-- Regulatory Policy Notice -->
<div class="p-3 rounded-xl bg-surface-container-low flex items-start gap-2.5 text-on-surface-variant">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-xl text-secondary mt-0.5">policy</span>
<div class="flex flex-col">
<span class="font-label-md text-label-md font-bold text-primary">Quy định thẩm quyền Barista:</span>
<p class="font-body-sm text-body-sm">Chỉ hủy đơn khi quầy bar gặp sự cố kỹ thuật hoặc hết nguyên liệu bất ngờ. Hành động này ghi nhận log kiểm toán nhân viên (BAR-08). Không tự ý cam kết hoàn tiền mặt tại quầy khi chưa có xác nhận từ hệ thống kế toán trung tâm.</p>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Reason Selection Form -->
<form class="flex flex-col gap-space-sm" id="cancel-form" onsubmit="handleCancelSubmit(event)">
<label class="font-label-md text-label-md font-bold text-primary">Chọn lý do huỷ đơn:</label>
<label class="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl bg-surface-container-low cursor-pointer hover:bg-surface-container transition-colors">
<input checked="" class="w-4 h-4 text-primary focus:ring-primary" name="cancel-reason" type="radio" value="out_of_stock"/>
<div class="flex flex-col">
<span class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-primary">Hết nguyên liệu pha chế đột xuất</span>
<span class="font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant">Hết hạt Robusta đặc biệt / Sữa hạt Oatly</span>
</div>
</label>
<label class="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl bg-surface-container-low cursor-pointer hover:bg-surface-container transition-colors">
<input class="w-4 h-4 text-primary focus:ring-primary" name="cancel-reason" type="radio" value="hardware_failure"/>
<div class="flex flex-col">
<span class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-primary">Thiết bị máy móc gặp sự cố kỹ thuật</span>
<span class="font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant">Hỏng boiler áp suất máy pha / Mất điện trạm pha chế</span>
</div>
</label>
<label class="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl bg-surface-container-low cursor-pointer hover:bg-surface-container transition-colors">
<input class="w-4 h-4 text-primary focus:ring-primary" name="cancel-reason" type="radio" value="customer_requested"/>
<div class="flex flex-col">
<span class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-primary">Khách hàng yêu cầu hủy trực tiếp tại quầy</span>
<span class="font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant">Khách bận việc gấp không thể tiếp tục chờ</span>
</div>
</label>
<div class="flex flex-col gap-1.5 mt-1">
<label class="font-label-sm text-label-sm font-semibold text-primary">Chi tiết ghi chú bắt buộc cho Quản lý ca (Shift Manager):</label>
<textarea class="w-full p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-surface-container-lowest border-0 ring-1 ring-outline-variant focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface resize-none" placeholder="Nhập mô tả cụ thể về sự cố để phục vụ đối soát nguyên vật liệu cuối ca..." required="" rows="2"></textarea>
</div>
<!-- Action Buttons -->
<div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-space-sm pt-space-sm">
<button class="px-space-md py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-surface-container-high text-on-surface font-title-sm text-title-sm hover:bg-surface-container-highest transition-colors" onclick="closeCancellationModal()" type="button">
            Quay lại pha chế
          </button>
<button class="px-space-md py-2.5 rounded-lg bg-error text-on-error font-title-sm text-title-sm flex items-center gap-2 hover:bg-error/90 transition-colors shadow-md" type="submit">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-lg">check</span>
<span>Xác nhận ghi log hủy đơn</span>
</button>
</div>
</form>
</div>
</div>
<script>
    function openCancellationModal(orderId) {
      const modal = document.getElementById('cancellation-modal');
      const orderSpan = document.getElementById('modal-order-id');
      if (orderSpan) {
        orderSpan.textContent = '#' + (orderId || 'BL-1042');
      }
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.remove('hidden');
      }
    }

    function closeCancellationModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('cancellation-modal');
      if (modal) {
        modal.classList.add('hidden');
      }
    }

    document.getElementById('open-emergency-btn')?.addEventListener('click', function() {
      openCancellationModal('BL-1042');
    });

    function handleCancelSubmit(event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      alert('Đã gửi yêu cầu hủy đơn thành công. Hệ thống tự động cập nhật log kiểm toán cho Barista BAR-08.');
      closeCancellationModal();
    }
  </script>
</div></main></body></html>

<!-- Topping 3: Kem Cheese Macchiato -->
<label class="topping-item cursor-pointer p-space-sm bg-surface-container-low rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between transition-all hover:bg-surface-container">
<div class="flex items-center gap-space-sm">
<input class="w-5 h-5 rounded accent-primary cursor-pointer" data-price="10000" name="toppings" onchange="updateCalculations()" type="checkbox" value="Kem Cheese Macchiato"/>
<div>
<span class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-on-surface block">Kem cheese macchiato</span>
<span class="font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant">Mịn mượt, béo mặn nhẹ</span>
</div>
</div>
<span class="font-label-md text-label-md text-primary font-semibold">+10.000 ₫</span>
</label>
<!-- Topping 4: Sốt caramel thủ công -->
<label class="topping-item cursor-pointer p-space-sm bg-surface-container-low rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between transition-all hover:bg-surface-container">
<div class="flex items-center gap-space-sm">
<input class="w-5 h-5 rounded accent-primary cursor-pointer" data-price="5000" name="toppings" onchange="updateCalculations()" type="checkbox" value="Sốt caramel thủ công"/>
<div>
<span class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-on-surface block">Sốt caramel thủ công</span>
<span class="font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant">Nấu bơ sữa thơm ngậy</span>
</div>
</div>
<span class="font-label-md text-label-md text-primary font-semibold">+5.000 ₫</span>
</label>
</div>
</section>
<!-- 5 & 6. Quantity Adjuster & Dynamic Calculation Summary -->
<section aria-labelledby="summary-heading" class="bg-surface-container-highest/60 rounded-xl p-space-md flex flex-col gap-space-md">
<div class="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-space-sm">
<div>
<span class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-primary block">Số lượng món</span>
<span class="font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant">Đặt cùng lúc nhiều ly cho văn phòng</span>
</div>
<!-- Quantity Stepper Controls -->
<div class="flex items-center bg-surface-container-lowest rounded-lg p-1 shadow-sm">
<button class="w-9 h-9 rounded bg-surface-container-low hover:bg-surface-variant text-primary flex items-center justify-center font-bold transition-colors" onclick="adjustQuantity(-1)" type="button">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">remove</span>
</button>
<span class="w-12 text-center font-title-md text-title-md text-primary font-bold" id="quantity-display">2</span>
<button class="w-9 h-9 rounded bg-surface-container-low hover:bg-surface-variant text-primary flex items-center justify-center font-bold transition-colors" onclick="adjustQuantity(1)" type="button">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">add</span>
</button>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Breakdown Ledger -->
<div class="pt-space-sm flex flex-col gap-1.5 font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant">
<div class="flex justify-between">
<span>Giá cơ sở ly Size S (35.000 ₫ × <span class="qty-mirror">2</span>):</span>
<span class="font-medium text-on-surface" id="base-subtotal">70.000 ₫</span>
</div>
<div class="flex justify-between">
<span>Phụ thu kích cỡ (<span id="size-name-summary">Size M</span>: +6.000 ₫ × <span class="qty-mirror">2</span>):</span>
<span class="font-medium text-on-surface" id="size-subtotal">+12.000 ₫</span>
</div>
<div class="flex justify-between">
<span>Topping đi kèm (<span id="topping-count-summary">2 loại</span>: +14.000 ₫ × <span class="qty-mirror">2</span>):</span>
<span class="font-medium text-on-surface" id="topping-subtotal">+28.000 ₫</span>
</div>
<div class="h-px bg-surface-variant my-1"></div>
<div class="flex items-baseline justify-between text-on-surface">
<span class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-primary font-bold">Tổng thanh toán dự kiến:</span>
<span class="font-headline-md text-headline-md text-primary font-bold" id="grand-total-display">98.000 ₫</span>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- 7. Main CTA Action & Trust Messaging -->
<div class="flex flex-col gap-space-sm pt-space-xs">
<div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch gap-space-sm">
<button class="flex-1 min-h-[52px] px-space-lg py-space-sm rounded-lg bg-primary hover:bg-primary-container text-on-primary font-title-sm text-title-sm font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-space-sm shadow-md transition-all active:scale-[0.99]" onclick="handleAddToCart()" type="button">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-body-lg">shopping_bag</span>
<span id="cta-button-text">Thêm vào giỏ hàng • 98.000 ₫</span>
</button>
<a class="min-h-[52px] px-space-md py-space-sm rounded-lg bg-secondary text-on-secondary font-title-sm text-title-sm font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:bg-secondary/90 transition-all shadow-sm" data-path="thanh-toan" href="#">
<span>Mua ngay</span>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-body-md">arrow_forward</span>
</a>
</div>

<div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-on-surface-variant font-body-sm text-body-sm">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-secondary text-body-md">timer</span>
<span>Pha tươi tại chỗ trong <strong>5 - 10 phút</strong></span>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-on-surface-variant font-body-sm text-body-sm">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-secondary text-body-md">contactless</span>
<span>Hỗ trợ thẻ, MoMo, ZaloPay, VietQR</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Inline Logic for Dynamic Calculation and Micro-interactions -->
<script>
    let quantity = 2;
    const basePrice = 35000;

    function formatVND(amount) {
      return amount.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + ' ₫';
    }

    function adjustQuantity(delta) {
      quantity = Math.max(1, Math.min(20, quantity + delta));
      updateCalculations();
    }

    function selectThumbnail(index, element) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.thumbnail-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.classList.remove('outline', 'outline-2', 'outline-primary');
      });
      element.classList.add('outline', 'outline-2', 'outline-primary');
      
      const newSrc = element.querySelector('img').getAttribute('src');
      const newAlt = element.querySelector('img').getAttribute('data-alt');
      const mainImg = document.getElementById('main-product-image');
      
      mainImg.style.opacity = '0.5';
      setTimeout(() => {
        mainImg.setAttribute('src', newSrc);
        mainImg.setAttribute('data-alt', newAlt);
        mainImg.style.opacity = '1';
      }, 150);
    }

    function selectPill(button, group, labelText) {
      const parent = button.parentElement;
      parent.querySelectorAll('.pill-btn').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.remove('active', 'bg-primary', 'text-on-primary', 'shadow-sm', 'font-semibold');
        b.classList.add('bg-surface-container', 'text-on-surface-variant', 'font-medium');
      });
      
      button.classList.add('active', 'bg-primary', 'text-on-primary', 'shadow-sm', 'font-semibold');
      button.classList.remove('bg-surface-container', 'text-on-surface-variant', 'font-medium');

      if (group === 'ice') {
        document.getElementById('selected-ice-label').innerText = labelText;
      } else if (group === 'sweetness') {
        document.getElementById('selected-sweetness-label').innerText = labelText;
      }
    }

    function updateCalculations() {
      // 1. Quantity Display
      document.getElementById('quantity-display').innerText = quantity;
      document.querySelectorAll('.qty-mirror').forEach(el => el.innerText = quantity);

      // 2. Size calculations
      const sizeInputs = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="size_option"]');
      let sizeExtra = 0;
      let sizeName = "Size S";
      sizeInputs.forEach(input => {
        const card = input.closest('.size-card');
        const indicator = card.querySelector('.radio-indicator');
        if (input.checked) {
          sizeExtra = parseInt(input.dataset.extra || 0);
          sizeName = "Size " + input.value;
          card.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-primary', 'bg-surface-container');
          card.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-low');
          indicator.className = 'radio-indicator w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-primary flex items-center justify-center text-on-primary';
          indicator.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[14px]">check</span>';
        } else {
          card.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-primary', 'bg-surface-container');
          card.classList.add('bg-surface-container-low');
          indicator.className = 'radio-indicator w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-surface-container-lowest flex items-center justify-center';
          indicator.innerHTML = '<div class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-transparent"></div>';
        }
      });
      document.getElementById('size-name-summary').innerText = sizeName;

      // 3. Topping calculations
      const toppingCheckboxes = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="toppings"]:checked');
      let toppingsExtraPerUnit = 0;
      toppingCheckboxes.forEach(cb => {
        toppingsExtraPerUnit += parseInt(cb.dataset.price || 0);
      });
      document.getElementById('topping-count-summary').innerText = toppingCheckboxes.length + ' loại';

      // 4. Subtotals and Grand Total
      const totalBase = basePrice * quantity;
      const totalSizeExtra = sizeExtra * quantity;
      const totalToppingsExtra = toppingsExtraPerUnit * quantity;
      const grandTotal = totalBase + totalSizeExtra + totalToppingsExtra;

      document.getElementById('base-subtotal').innerText = formatVND(totalBase);
      document.getElementById('size-subtotal').innerText = '+' + formatVND(totalSizeExtra);
      document.getElementById('topping-subtotal').innerText = '+' + formatVND(totalToppingsExtra);
      document.getElementById('grand-total-display').innerText = formatVND(grandTotal);
      document.getElementById('cta-button-text').innerText = 'Thêm vào giỏ hàng • ' + formatVND(grandTotal);
    }

    function handleAddToCart() {
      const toast = document.getElementById('toast-notification');
      toast.classList.remove('hidden');
      toast.classList.remove('translate-y-4', 'opacity-0');
      toast.classList.add('translate-y-0', 'opacity-100');

      // Auto hide after 4 seconds
      clearTimeout(window._toastTimeout);
      window._toastTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.add('opacity-0', 'translate-y-4');
        setTimeout(() => toast.classList.add('hidden'), 300);
      }, 4000);
    }

    // Initialize display on load
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      updateCalculations();
    });
  </script>
</div></main><footer class="w-full bg-surface-container-low text-on-surface py-space-xl"><div class="max-w-[1200px] mx-auto px-margin"><div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-space-xl pb-space-xl"><div class="md:col-span-5 flex flex-col gap-space-md"><div class="flex items-center gap-space-sm"><img alt="BrewLite Logo" class="h-7 w-auto object-contain" src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida-public/AB6AXuDQQPSEeE0NKrtWlD36-6QGwv6hEZPy48XA96VPbaxMinQV8jWZBuC1LAROusExxXDS1G9N2mKgudlz7JwsSs3PecCz-63FvVMTFaDw8dqoQ50KkIqeiqZbVZg6vFE-D9GHUdlmOlo8O5cLdcz_2VEXPILux8BcbV1U0poKYzTcB6VnWaEPVOpsg39Ct1hCvgH_WsLFj_Cfh3PehWwwnV7h5NNZMaaAmmU0J8gXWRuPlsyYtUrXFAITFw"/><span class="font-headline-sm text-headline-sm text-primary">BrewLite</span></div><p class="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant max-w-sm leading-relaxed">Trải nghiệm cà phê thủ công tinh túy Việt Nam, đặt món nhanh chóng và thanh toán không tiền mặt an toàn.</p></div><div class="md:col-span-3 flex flex-col gap-space-sm"><h4 class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-primary uppercase tracking-wider mb-space-xs">Khám phá</h4><ul class="flex flex-col gap-2 font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant"><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="ve-brewlite" href="#">Về BrewLite</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="thuc-don" href="#">Thực đơn</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="khuyen-mai" href="#">Khuyến mãi</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="huong-dan-dat-hang" href="#">Hướng dẫn đặt hàng</a></li></ul></div><div class="md:col-span-4 flex flex-col gap-space-sm"><h4 class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-primary uppercase tracking-wider mb-space-xs">Liên hệ &amp; <!-- Inline Micro-Interactions Script -->
<script>
    const itemPrices = {
      'item-1': 55000,
      'item-2': 59000
    };

    let cartQuantities = {
      'item-1': 2,
      'item-2': 1
    };

    function recalculateTotal() {
      const subtotal = (cartQuantities['item-1'] * itemPrices['item-1']) + (cartQuantities['item-2'] * itemPrices['item-2']);
      const totalQty = cartQuantities['item-1'] + cartQuantities['item-2'];
      
      const discount = subtotal > 0 ? Math.round(subtotal * 0.2) : 0;
      const finalTotal = Math.max(0, subtotal - discount);
      const points = Math.floor(finalTotal / 10000);

      const subtotalEl = document.getElementById('summary-subtotal');
      const discountEl = document.getElementById('summary-discount');
      const finalTotalEl = document.getElementById('summary-final-total');
      const ctaBtnText = document.getElementById('cta-button-text');
      const badgeCountEl = document.getElementById('cart-total-badge');
      const summaryTotalQtyEl = document.getElementById('summary-total-qty');

      if (subtotalEl) subtotalEl.textContent = subtotal.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + '₫';
      if (discountEl) discountEl.textContent = '-' + discount.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + '₫';
      if (finalTotalEl) finalTotalEl.textContent = finalTotal.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + '₫';
      if (ctaBtnText) ctaBtnText.textContent = 'Tiến hành thanh toán (' + finalTotal.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + '₫)';
      if (badgeCountEl) badgeCountEl.textContent = totalQty + ' món';
      if (summaryTotalQtyEl) summaryTotalQtyEl.textContent = totalQty + ' sản phẩm';
    }

    function updateQty(itemId, delta) {
      if (!cartQuantities[itemId]) return;
      const newQty = cartQuantities[itemId] + delta;
      if (newQty < 1) return;

      cartQuantities[itemId] = newQty;
      const qtyEl = document.getElementById('qty-' + itemId);
      const subtotalEl = document.getElementById('subtotal-' + itemId);

      if (qtyEl) qtyEl.textContent = newQty;
      if (subtotalEl) subtotalEl.textContent = (newQty * itemPrices[itemId]).toLocaleString('vi-VN') + '₫';

      recalculateTotal();
    }

    function removeItem(cardId, price, count) {
      const card = document.getElementById(cardId);
      if (card) {
        card.style.opacity = '0';
        card.style.transform = 'scale(0.95)';
        setTimeout(() => {
          card.remove();
          if (cardId === 'cart-item-1') cartQuantities['item-1'] = 0;
          if (cardId === 'cart-item-2') cartQuantities['item-2'] = 0;
          recalculateTotal();
        }, 250);
      }
    }

    function clearCartSim() {
      const list = document.getElementById('cart-item-list');
      if (list) {
        list.innerHTML = `
          <div class="p-space-lg bg-surface-container-low rounded-xl text-center text-on-surface-variant font-body-md">
            Bạn vừa dọn sạch giỏ hàng. <a href="#" data-path="thuc-don" class="text-primary font-semibold underline ml-1">Chọn món mới</a>
          </div>
        `;
        cartQuantities['item-1'] = 0;
        cartQuantities['item-2'] = 0;
        recalculateTotal();
      }
    }

    function applyPromoCode() {
      const input = document.getElementById('promo-input');
      const badge = document.getElementById('voucher-success-badge');
      if (input && badge) {
        badge.classList.remove('hidden');
        badge.style.display = 'flex';
      }
    }

    function checkoutProcess() {
      const btn = document.getElementById('cta-button-text');
      if (btn) {
        btn.textContent = 'Đang khởi tạo đơn hàng PENDING...';
        setTimeout(() => {
          alert('Đơn hàng đã được khởi tạo thành công! Chuyển hướng tới cổng thanh toán an toàn...');
          btn.textContent = 'Tiến hành thanh toán (135.200₫)';
        }, 800);
      }
    }
  </script>

<script>
  function copyVoucher(code, btnElement) {
    if (navigator.clipboard) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
        const originalContent = btnElement.innerHTML;
        btnElement.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[14px]">check</span><span>Đã chép!</span>';
        btnElement.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-high', 'bg-primary');
        btnElement.classList.add('bg-[#2e7d5b]', 'text-white');
        setTimeout(() => {
          btnElement.innerHTML = originalContent;
          btnElement.classList.remove('bg-[#2e7d5b]', 'text-white');
          btnElement.classList.add('bg-surface-container-high');
        }, 2000);
      });
    }
  }

  function handleLogout() {
    if (confirm('Bạn có chắc chắn muốn đăng xuất khỏi tài khoản BrewLite?')) {
      alert('Đã đăng xuất thành công. Hẹn gặp lại quý khách!');
    }
  }

<script>
  function switchState(targetState) {
    // Hide all views
    document.querySelectorAll('.state-view').forEach(function(view) {
      view.classList.add('hidden');
      view.classList.remove('flex');
    });

    // Reset button styles
    const buttons = ['success', 'failed', 'verifying'];
    buttons.forEach(function(s) {
      const btn = document.getElementById('tab-btn-' + s);
      if (btn) {
        btn.classList.remove('bg-primary', 'text-on-primary', 'font-semibold', 'shadow-sm');
        btn.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant');
      }
    });

    // Show target view
    const activeView = document.getElementById('view-' + targetState);
    if (activeView) {
      activeView.classList.remove('hidden');
      activeView.classList.add('flex');
    }

    // Highlight target button
    const activeBtn = document.getElementById('tab-btn-' + targetState);
    if (activeBtn) {
      activeBtn.classList.add('bg-primary', 'text-on-primary', 'font-semibold', 'shadow-sm');
      activeBtn.classList.remove('text-on-surface-variant');
    }
  }

  function triggerVerificationCheck() {
    const timerElem = document.getElementById('countdown-timer');
    if (timerElem) {
      timerElem.innerText = 'Đang kiểm tra kết nối cổng...';
      setTimeout(function() {
        switchState('success');
      }, 1200);
    }
  }

<script>
  // Tab Filtering Logic
  function switchTab(btn, status) {
    const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn');
    tabs.forEach(t => {
      t.classList.remove('bg-primary', 'text-on-primary', 'font-semibold', 'shadow-sm');
      t.classList.add('text-on-surface-variant', 'hover:text-primary', 'hover:bg-surface-container-low');
    });

    btn.classList.remove('text-on-surface-variant', 'hover:text-primary', 'hover:bg-surface-container-low');
    btn.classList.add('bg-primary', 'text-on-primary', 'font-semibold', 'shadow-sm');

    const trackingSection = document.getElementById('active-order-tracking-section');
    const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.order-card');
    const emptyState = document.getElementById('orders-empty-state');
    let visibleCount = 0;

    if (status === 'all') {
      if (trackingSection) trackingSection.style.display = 'block';
      cards.forEach(c => {
        c.style.display = 'flex';
        visibleCount++;
      });
    } else if (status === 'active') {
      if (trackingSection) trackingSection.style.display = 'block';
      cards.forEach(c => c.style.display = 'none');
      visibleCount = 1;
    } else {
      if (trackingSection) trackingSection.style.display = 'none';
      cards.forEach(c => {
        if (c.getAttribute('data-status') === status) {
          c.style.display = 'flex';
          visibleCount++;
        } else {
          c.style.display = 'none';
        }
      });
    }

    if (visibleCount === 0) {
      emptyState.classList.remove('hidden');
      emptyState.classList.add('flex');
    } else {
      emptyState.classList.add('hidden');
      emptyState.classList.remove('flex');
    }
  }

  // Real-time Search Handler
  function handleSearch(query) {
    const term = query.toLowerCase().trim();
    const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.order-card');
    const trackingSection = document.getElementById('active-order-tracking-section');
    const emptyState = document.getElementById('orders-empty-state');
    let matchCount = 0;

    const matchesTracking = 'bl-1042 ca phe sua da sai gon tra dao cam sa'.includes(term);
    if (trackingSection) {
      if (term === '' || matchesTracking) {
        trackingSection.style.display = 'block';
        if (matchesTracking && term !== '') matchCount++;
      } else {
        trackingSection.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }

    cards.forEach(card => {
      const searchData = card.getAttribute('data-search') || '';
      if (term === '' || searchData.includes(term)) {
        card.style.display = 'flex';
        matchCount++;
      } else {
        card.style.display = 'none';
      }
    });

    if (matchCount === 0 && term !== '') {
      emptyState.classList.remove('hidden');
      emptyState.classList.add('flex');
    } else {
      emptyState.classList.add('hidden');
      emptyState.classList.remove('flex');
    }
  }

  // Refresh Timeline animation simulator
  function refreshTrackingStatus() {
    const icon = document.getElementById('refresh-icon');
    if (!icon) return;
    icon.classList.add('rotate-180');
    
    showToast('Đang đồng bộ trạng thái đơn hàng thời gian thực...');

    setTimeout(() => {
      icon.classList.remove('rotate-180');
      showToast('Đã làm mới: Barista đang đóng nắp và thêm đá!');
    }, 900);
  }

  // Reorder action
  function reorderItem(orderCode) {
    showToast('Đã thêm các món của đơn #' + orderCode + ' vào giỏ hàng thành công!');
  }

  // Invoice Modal
  function viewInvoiceModal(orderCode, price, itemName) {
    const modal = document.getElementById('invoice-modal');
    const card = document.getElementById('invoice-modal-card');
    
    document.getElementById('modal-order-id').innerText = 'Hóa đơn #' + orderCode;
    document.getElementById('modal-order-price').innerText = price;
    document.getElementById('modal-order-item').innerText = itemName;

    modal.classList.remove('hidden');
    setTimeout(() => {
      modal.classList.remove('opacity-0');
      card.classList.remove('scale-95');
      card.classList.add('scale-100');
    }, 10);
  }

  function closeInvoiceModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('invoice-modal');
    const card = document.getElementById('invoice-modal-card');
    modal.classList.add('opacity-0');
    card.classList.remove('scale-100');
    card.classList.add('scale-95');
    setTimeout(() => {
      modal.classList.add('hidden');
    }, 250);
  }

  // Global Toast
  function showToast(text) {
    const toast = document.getElementById('toast-notify');
    const msg = document.getElementById('toast-message');
    if (!toast || !msg) return;
    msg.innerText = text;
    toast.classList.remove('translate-y-20', 'opacity-0');
    toast.classList.add('translate-y-0', 'opacity-100');

    setTimeout(() => {
      toast.classList.remove('translate-y-0', 'opacity-100');
      toast.classList.add('translate-y-20', 'opacity-0');
    }, 3200);
  }
</script></main><footer class="w-full bg-surface-container-low text-on-surface py-space-xl"><div class="max-w-[1200px] mx-auto px-margin"><div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-space-xl pb-space-xl"><div class="md:col-span-5 flex flex-col gap-space-md"><div class="flex items-center gap-space-sm"><img alt="BrewLite Logo" class="h-7 w-auto object-contain" src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida-public/AB6AXuDQQPSEeE0NKrtWlD36-6QGwv6hEZPy48XA96VPbaxMinQV8jWZBuC1LAROusExxXDS1G9N2mKgudlz7JwsSs3PecCz-63FvVMTFaDw8dqoQ50KkIqeiqZbVZg6vFE-D9GHUdlmOlo8O5cLdcz_2VEXPILux8BcbV1U0poKYzTcB6VnWaEPVOpsg39Ct1hCvgH_WsLFj_Cfh3PehWwwnV7h5NNZMaaAmmU0J8gXWRuPlsyYtUrXFAITFw"/><span class="font-headline-sm text-headline-sm text-primary">BrewLite</span></div><p class="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant max-w-sm leading-relaxed">Trải nghiệm cà phê thủ công tinh túy Việt Nam, đặt món nhanh chóng và thanh toán không tiền mặt an toàn.</p></div><div class="md:col-span-3 flex flex-col gap-space-sm"><h4 class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-primary uppercase tracking-wider mb-space-xs">Khám phá</h4><ul class="flex flex-col gap-2 font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant"><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="ve-brewlite" href="#">Về BrewLite</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="thuc-don" href="#">Thực đơn</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="khuyen-mai" href="#">Khuyến mãi</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="huong-dan-dat-hang" href="#">Hướng dẫn đặt hàng</a></li></ul></div><div class="md:col-span-4 flex flex-col gap-space-sm"><h4 class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-primary uppercase tracking-wider mb-space-xs">Liên hệ &amp; Hỗ trợ</h4><ul class="flex flex-col gap-2 font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant"><li class="flex items-start gap-2"><span class="material-symbols-outlined text-body-md text-secondary mt-0.5">call</span><span>Hotline: <strong class="text-on-surface font-semibold">1900 6868</strong></span></li><li class="flex items-start gap-2"><span class="material-symbols-outlined text-body-md text-secondary mt-0.5">mail</span><span>Email: <strong class="text-on-surface font-semibold">cskh@brewlite.vn</strong></span></li><li class="flex items-start gap-2"><span class="material-symbols-outlined text-body-md text-secondary mt-0.5">location_on</span><span>123 Đường Cà Phê, Quận 1, TP.
