w-full">
<div class="relative w-full overflow-hidden py-space-xl px-margin-mobile md:px-margin">
<div class="max-w-[1200px] mx-auto grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-space-xl items-stretch">
<!-- Cột Trái: Brand Showcase & Atmosphere -->
<div class="lg:col-span-5 relative flex flex-col justify-between rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl min-h-[520px] lg:min-h-[680px] bg-primary text-on-primary p-space-lg md:p-space-xl">
<div class="absolute inset-0 z-0">
<div class="bg-cover bg-center w-full h-full transform scale-105 transition-transform duration-700 ease-out" data-alt="Warm artisanal Vietnamese boutique coffee shop interior with soft amber lighting, rich mahogany wood tables, gleaming copper traditional phin coffee filters dripping into clear glass, creamy foam texture, cinematic atmospheric cafe photography, warm deep espresso tones and golden caramel highlights" style="background-image: url('https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida-public/AB6AXuCmRKE1Gg_O7MyR6n9bTu2rRaSrKbNeT0z_RWk7qKXPC7a_1b532Ut9FDf33ZpOw3FGrrrowKWVXeJ9ZoJpmpNbnuer4b4dv_rjXex5cAUKKBI5nmMpdoEFqvH405ASFSUvnMGk9LM99lWXKkcTuT2rOZm_AQOBE8L-6ONFd-d1LbPIrAtpwHe3tIxiviSLD9UxdfrmpZFavWdDascoV_4Z_NbmEPnnsEmtORsnd5sAfBkFm7UkVIlMsg')"></div>
<div class="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-primary via-primary/85 to-primary/40 backdrop-blur-[1px]"></div>
</div>
<!-- Header Cột Trái -->
<div class="relative z-10 flex flex-col gap-space-md">
<div class="inline-flex items-center gap-space-xs self-start px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-secondary/30 backdrop-blur-md">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-tertiary-fixed text-[18px]">local_cafe</span>
<span class="font-label-sm text-label-sm text-tertiary-fixed tracking-wider uppercase">Cà phê Phin thủ công &amp; Số hóa</span>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col gap-space-xs mt-2">
<h1 class="font-headline-lg text-headline-lg text-surface-bright tracking-tight">
              Hương vị đậm đà,<br/><span class="text-secondary-fixed">trải nghiệm trọn vẹn.</span>
</h1>
<p class="font-body-md text-body-md text-surface-variant/90 leading-relaxed max-w-sm mt-1">
              Chào mừng bạn quay lại với BrewLite. Thưởng thức hương vị cà phê thủ công tinh túy và thanh toán không chạm tiện lợi.
            </p>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Lợi ích thành viên Card -->
<div class="relative z-10 mt-space-xl flex flex-col gap-space-md p-space-md rounded-lg bg-surface-container-highest/15 backdrop-blur-md">
<div class="flex items-center justify-between">
<span class="font-label-md text-label-md text-surface-bright font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">Đặc quyền BrewLite Club</span>
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-secondary-fixed text-title-md">stars</span>
</div>
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-space-sm">
<div class="flex items-start gap-space-sm">
<div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-secondary-fixed/20 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-secondary-fixed text-body-md">loyalty</span>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col min-w-0">
<span class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-surface-bright">Tích lũy điểm thưởng thành viên</span>
<span class="font-body-sm text-body-sm text-surface-variant/80">Tích 10% giá trị đơn hàng, quy đổi voucher trực tiếp.</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="flex items-start gap-space-sm">
<div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-secondary-fixed/20 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-secondary-fixed text-body-md">tune</span>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col min-w-0">
<span class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-surface-bright">Lưu khẩu vị yêu thích</span>
<span class="font-body-sm text-body-sm text-surface-variant/80">Cá nhân hóa độ ngọt, tỷ lệ đá và loại sữa chỉ một lần chọn.</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="flex items-start gap-space-sm">
<div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-secondary-fixed/20 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 mt-0.5">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-secondary-fixed text-body-md">history</span>
</div>
<div class="flex flex-col min-w-0">
<span class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-surface-bright">Lịch sử đơn hàng nhanh chóng</span>
<span class="font-body-sm text-body-sm text-surface-variant/80">Đặt lại thức uống quen thuộc chỉ với 1 chạm duy nhất.</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="pt-2 flex items-center gap-space-sm text-tertiary-fixed font-label-sm text-label-sm">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px]">verified_user</span>
<span>Tài khoản khách hàng được mã hóa bảo mật chuẩn SSL</span>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Cột Phải: Authentication Container (Login / Register Switch) -->
<div class="lg:col-span-7 flex flex-col justify-center">
<div class="w-full bg-surface-container-lowest rounded-xl shadow-lg p-space-lg md:p-space-xl flex flex-col gap-space-lg relative">
<!-- Tab Navigation -->
<div class="flex items-center p-1 rounded bg-surface-container-low max-w-sm">
<button class="flex-1 py-2 px-space-md rounded font-title-sm text-title-sm text-on-primary bg-primary shadow-sm transition-all text-center" id="tab-login-btn" onclick="switchAuthTab('login')" type="button">
              Đăng nhập
            </button>
<button class="flex-1 py-2 px-space-md rounded font-title-sm text-title-sm text-on-surface-variant hover:text-on-surface transition-all text-center" id="tab-register-btn" onclick="switchAuthTab('register')" type="button">
              Đăng ký
            </button>
</div>
<!-- Alert Demo Lỗi (Chỉ hiển thị khi có thông báo) -->
<div class="flex items-start gap-space-sm p-space-md rounded bg-error-container text-on-error-container" id="auth-alert">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-error text-body-lg shrink-0 mt-0.5">error</span>
<div class="flex flex-col gap-0.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
<span class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-error">Thông báo xác thực</span>
<p class="font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-error-container">Email hoặc mật khẩu không chính xác. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại.</p>
</div>
<button class="text-on-error-container hover:opacity-80" onclick="document.getElementById('auth-alert').classList.add('hidden')" type="button">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-body-md">close</span>
</button>
</div>
<!-- FORM: ĐĂNG NHẬP (Mặc định hiện) -->
<form class="flex flex-col gap-space-md" id="form-login" onsubmit="event.preventDefault();">
<div class="flex flex-col gap-space-xs">
<h2 class="font-headline-sm text-headline-sm text-primary">Mừng bạn trở lại</h2>
<p class="font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant">Đăng nhập tài khoản khách hàng để nhận ưu đãi hôm nay.</p>
</div>
<!-- Email Input -->
<div class="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
<label class="font-label-md text-label-md text-on-surface flex items-center justify-between">
<span>Địa chỉ Email</span>
<span class="text-secondary font-label-sm text-label-sm">*Bắt buộc</span>
</label>
<div class="relative">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-on-surface-variant text-body-lg">mail</span>
<input class="w-full bg-surface-container-low text-on-surface placeholder:text-on-surface-variant pl-10 pr-4 py-3 rounded font-body-md text-body-md outline-none focus:bg-surface-container-lowest shadow-sm transition-all" placeholder="nhap.email@domain.com" type="email" value="nguyen.an@brewlite.vn"/>
</div>
</div>
<!-- Password Input with Toggle -->
<div class="flex flex-col gap-1.5">

<script>
    function switchAuthTab(tab) {
      const loginBtn = document.getElementById('tab-login-btn');
      const regBtn = document.getElementById('tab-register-btn');
      const formLogin = document.getElementById('form-login');
      const formRegister = document.getElementById('form-register');

      if (tab === 'login') {
        loginBtn.className = 'flex-1 py-2 px-space-md rounded font-title-sm text-title-sm text-on-primary bg-primary shadow-sm transition-all text-center';
        regBtn.className = 'flex-1 py-2 px-space-md rounded font-title-sm text-title-sm text-on-surface-variant hover:text-on-surface transition-all text-center';
        formLogin.classList.remove('hidden');
        formLogin.classList.add('flex');
        formRegister.classList.add('hidden');
        formRegister.classList.remove('flex');
      } else {
        regBtn.className = 'flex-1 py-2 px-space-md rounded font-title-sm text-title-sm text-on-primary bg-primary shadow-sm transition-all text-center';
        loginBtn.className = 'flex-1 py-2 px-space-md rounded font-title-sm text-title-sm text-on-surface-variant hover:text-on-surface transition-all text-center';
        formRegister.classList.remove('hidden');
        formRegister.classList.add('flex');
        formLogin.classList.add('hidden');
        formLogin.classList.remove('flex');
      }
    }

    function togglePasswordVisibility(inputId, btn) {
      const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
      const icon = btn.querySelector('.material-symbols-outlined');
      if (input.type === 'password') {
        input.type = 'text';
        icon.textContent = 'visibility_off';
      } else {
        input.type = 'password';
        icon.textContent = 'visibility';
      }
    }

    function openAuthModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('auth-required-modal');
      const container = document.getElementById('modal-container');
      modal.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
      modal.classList.add('opacity-100', 'pointer-events-auto');
      container.classList.remove('scale-95');
      container.classList.add('scale-100');
    }

    function closeAuthModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('auth-required-modal');
      const container = document.getElementById('modal-container');
      modal.classList.add('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
      modal.classList.remove('opacity-100', 'pointer-events-auto');
      container.classList.add('scale-95');
      container.classList.remove('scale-100');
    }

    function showQuickToast(msg, icon = 'info') {
      const toast = document.getElementById('quick-toast');
      const toastText = document.getElementById('toast-text');
      const toastIcon = document.getElementById('toast-icon');
      toastText.textContent = msg;
      toastIcon.textContent = icon;
      toast.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
      toast.classList.add('opacity-100');

      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.add('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
        toast.classList.remove('opacity-100');
      }, 3500);
    }

    function simulateLoginSuccess() {
      showQuickToast('Đăng nhập thành công! Đang chuyển hướng về giỏ hàng...', 'check_circle');
    }

    function simulateRegisterSuccess() {
      showQuickToast('Tài khoản Khách hàng đã được tạo! Mời bạn đăng nhập.', 'verified');
      setTimeout(() => {
        switchAuthTab('login');
      }, 1200);
    }
  </script>

Hỗ trợ</h4><ul class="flex flex-col gap-2 font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant"><li class="flex items-start gap-2"><span class="material-symbols-outlined text-body-md text-secondary mt-0.5">call</span><span>Hotline: <strong class="text-on-surface font-semibold">1900 6868</strong></span></li><li class="flex items-start gap-2"><span class="material-symbols-outlined text-body-md text-secondary mt-0.5">mail</span><span>Email: <strong class="text-on-surface font-semibold">cskh@brewlite.vn</strong></span></li><li class="flex items-start gap-2"><span class="material-symbols-outlined text-body-md text-secondary mt-0.5">location_on</span><span>123 Đường Cà Phê, Quận 1, TP. <!-- Inline Vanilla Script for Micro-interactions -->
<script>
    (function() {
      const payButton = document.getElementById('btn-pay-now');
      const modal = document.getElementById('payment-modal');
      const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('btn-cancel-modal');
      const progressBar = document.getElementById('modal-progress');
      let progressInterval;

      if (payButton && modal) {
        payButton.addEventListener('click', function() {
          modal.classList.remove('hidden');
          let width = 25;
          progressBar.style.width = width + '%';
          
          progressInterval = setInterval(function() {
            if (width < 90) {
              width += 15;
              progressBar.style.width = width + '%';
            }
          }, 600);
        });
      }

      if (cancelBtn && modal) {
        cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
          modal.classList.add('hidden');
          clearInterval(progressInterval);
          progressBar.style.width = '25%';
        });
      }
    })();
  </script>

<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">arrow_forward</span>
</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- Bottom Loyalty Promotion Strip -->
<section class="max-w-[1200px] mx-auto px-margin pb-space-xl">
<div class="bg-primary-container text-on-primary rounded-xl p-space-lg flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-space-md shadow-md">
<div class="flex items-center gap-space-md">
<div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-secondary flex items-center justify-center text-on-secondary shrink-0">
<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[28px]">redeem</span>
</div>
<div>
<h4 class="font-headline-sm text-headline-sm text-on-primary font-semibold">Tích điểm đổi món miễn phí</h4>
<p class="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-primary-container">Đăng ký thành viên BrewLite để nhận ngay 50 điểm khởi đầu cùng voucher giảm 20% đơn đầu tiên.</p>
</div>
</div>
<button class="h-11 px-space-lg rounded bg-secondary hover:bg-secondary-fixed text-on-secondary hover:text-on-secondary-fixed font-title-sm text-title-sm whitespace-nowrap transition-colors shadow-sm" type="button">
          Đăng ký tích điểm ngay
        </button>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</div>
<script>
  (function initBrewLiteMenu() {
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('coffee-search');
    const clearBtn = document.getElementById('btn-clear-search');
    const categoryTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.category-pill');
    const productItems = document.querySelectorAll('.product-item');
    const emptyState = document.getElementById('empty-state');
    const productGrid = document.getElementById('product-grid');
    const countDisplay = document.getElementById('visible-count');
    const resetBtn = document.getElementById('btn-reset-filters');

    let currentCategory = 'all';
    let currentSearchTerm = '';

    function filterItems() {
      let visibleCount = 0;
      const term = currentSearchTerm.toLowerCase().trim();

      productItems.forEach(item => {
        const itemCategory = item.getAttribute('data-category');
        const itemName = (item.getAttribute('data-name') || '').toLowerCase();
        
        const matchesCategory = (currentCategory === 'all' || itemCategory === currentCategory);
        const matchesSearch = !term || itemName.includes(term);

        if (matchesCategory && matchesSearch) {
          item.classList.remove('hidden');
          visibleCount++;
        } else {
          item.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      });

      countDisplay.textContent = visibleCount;

      if (visibleCount === 0) {
        productGrid.classList.add('hidden');
        emptyState.classList.remove('hidden');
      } else {
        productGrid.classList.remove('hidden');
        emptyState.classList.add('hidden');
      }
    }

    if (searchInput) {
      searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        currentSearchTerm = e.target.value;
        if (currentSearchTerm.length > 0) {
          clearBtn.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
          clearBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        filterItems();
      });
    }

    if (clearBtn) {
      clearBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        searchInput.value = '';
        currentSearchTerm = '';
        clearBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        searchInput.focus();
        filterItems();
      });
    }

    categoryTabs.forEach(tab => {
      tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
        categoryTabs.forEach(t => {
          t.classList.remove('bg-primary-container', 'text-on-primary');
          t.classList.add('bg-surface-container-low', 'text-on-surface-variant');
        });

        tab.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-low', 'text-on-surface-variant');
        tab.classList.add('bg-primary-container', 'text-on-primary');

        currentCategory = tab.getAttribute('data-category');
        filterItems();
      });
    });

    if (resetBtn) {
      resetBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (searchInput) {
          searchInput.value = '';
          currentSearchTerm = '';
          clearBtn.classList.add('hidden');
        }
        currentCategory = 'all';
        categoryTabs.forEach(t => {
          if (t.getAttribute('data-category') === 'all') {
            t.classList.remove('bg-surface-container-low', 'text-on-surface-variant');
            t.classList.add('bg-primary-container', 'text-on-primary');
          } else {
            t.classList.remove('bg-primary-container', 'text-on-primary');
            t.classList.add('bg-surface-container-low', 'text-on-surface-variant');
          }
        });
        filterItems();
      });
    }
  })();
</script></main><footer class="w-full bg-surface-container-low text-on-surface py-space-xl"><div class="max-w-[1200px] mx-auto px-margin"><div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-space-xl pb-space-xl"><div class="md:col-span-5 flex flex-col gap-space-md"><div class="flex items-center gap-space-sm"><img alt="BrewLite Logo" class="h-7 w-auto object-contain" src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida-public/AB6AXuDQQPSEeE0NKrtWlD36-6QGwv6hEZPy48XA96VPbaxMinQV8jWZBuC1LAROusExxXDS1G9N2mKgudlz7JwsSs3PecCz-63FvVMTFaDw8dqoQ50KkIqeiqZbVZg6vFE-D9GHUdlmOlo8O5cLdcz_2VEXPILux8BcbV1U0poKYzTcB6VnWaEPVOpsg39Ct1hCvgH_WsLFj_Cfh3PehWwwnV7h5NNZMaaAmmU0J8gXWRuPlsyYtUrXFAITFw"/><span class="font-headline-sm text-headline-sm text-primary">BrewLite</span></div><p class="font-body-md text-body-md text-on-surface-variant max-w-sm leading-relaxed">Trải nghiệm cà phê thủ công tinh túy Việt Nam, đặt món nhanh chóng và thanh toán không tiền mặt an toàn.</p></div><div class="md:col-span-3 flex flex-col gap-space-sm"><h4 class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-primary uppercase tracking-wider mb-space-xs">Khám phá</h4><ul class="flex flex-col gap-2 font-body-sm text-body-sm text-on-surface-variant"><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="ve-brewlite" href="#">Về BrewLite</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="thuc-don" href="#">Thực đơn</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="khuyen-mai" href="#">Khuyến mãi</a></li><li><a class="hover:text-primary transition-colors" data-path="huong-dan-dat-hang" href="#">Hướng dẫn đặt hàng</a></li></ul></div><div class="md:col-span-4 flex flex-col gap-space-sm"><h4 class="font-title-sm text-title-sm text-primary uppercase tracking-wider mb-space-xs">Liên hệ &amp;
